title: Setup Specialist (Applicants must hold a Bachelor degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Accounting)
description:
Setup Specialist - U.S. Mortgage

Full-Time | Permanent Work From Home | Night Shift



We are looking for a detail-oriented and highly trainable Setup Specialist to join our U.S. mortgage operations team.



No prior U.S. mortgage experience is required. We are open to entry-level applicants who are willing to learn and have strong attention to detail, good communication skills, reliability, and the ability to follow processes accurately.



MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS



- Must be a graduate of Finance, Accounting, Financial Management, Banking and Finance, Business Finance, or another closely related course

- Strong attention to detail and accuracy

- Good written and verbal English communication skills

- Comfortable working with numbers, financial documents, and data

- Good analytical and problem-solving skills

- Able to follow detailed procedures and instructions

- Able to learn new systems and processes quickly

- Dependable, professional, and accountable

- Able to work independently

- Willing to learn U.S. mortgage processes

- Comfortable working a permanent Philippine night/graveyard shift



Previous U.S. mortgage experience is an advantage but is not required.



JOB RESPONSIBILITIES



- Prepare and review U.S. mortgage loan files during the initial setup stage

- Review borrower information and documents for completeness and accuracy

- Enter and verify loan information in the Loan Origination System (LOS)

- Identify missing, incomplete, or inconsistent information

- Review files based on lender and loan program requirements

- Order or coordinate required third-party services

- Maintain accurate and organized loan records

- Coordinate with Account Executives, brokers, and other mortgage operations team members

- Follow established procedures, checklists, and turnaround times

- Perform other mortgage operations tasks as assigned



SALARY



Starting salary: Php 19,715 per month



Salary progression: Up to Php 28,600 per month within the first 5 months, subject to successful training, performance, and evaluation.



WORK-FROM-HOME REQUIREMENTS



Internet:

- Minimum 100 Mbps stable internet connection

- Reliable primary internet suitable for calls, online systems, and file processing

- Backup internet connection or mobile hotspot



Computer/Laptop:

- Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5 or equivalent or better

- Minimum 8 GB RAM; 16 GB preferred

- SSD storage

- Windows 10/11 or another currently supported operating system

- Working webcam and headset with microphone

- Must be capable of running multiple browser tabs and work applications simultaneously



Applicants must also have a quiet and professional work area suitable for calls, meetings, and handling confidential information.



WORK SCHEDULE



Monday to Friday - Philippine Night Shift



This position supports U.S. business hours. Applicants must be comfortable working a permanent graveyard schedule.



BENEFITS



- Permanent work-from-home setup

- Paid training

- Structured salary progression based on performance

- Regular performance and salary reviews

- HMO/Health Card after 3 months

- Paid U.S. holidays

- 3 days paid time off after 5 months

- 7 days paid time off after 1 year

- Training and opportunities for advancement within U.S. mortgage operations

- Long-term employment opportunity



HOW TO APPLY



Please send your updated resume and answer the following questions:



1. What course did you graduate from?

2. Do you have previous U.S. mortgage experience? If yes, briefly describe your experience.

3. What is your current or most recent monthly salary?

4. What is your expected monthly salary?

5. Are you willing to start at Php 19,715 per month, with salary progression of up to Php 28,600 within the first 5 months based on successful training and performance evaluation?

6. Are you comfortable working a permanent Philippine night/graveyard shift?

7. What are your computer specifications (processor and RAM)?

8. What is your internet speed and internet service provider?

9. Do you have a backup internet connection?

10. When are you available to start?



Please review the qualifications, salary, schedule, and work-from-home requirements carefully before applying.

title: Setup Specialist (Applicants must hold a Bachelor degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Accounting)
description:
Setup Specialist - U.S. Mortgage

Full-Time | Permanent Work From Home | Night Shift



We are looking for a detail-oriented and highly trainable Setup Specialist to join our U.S. mortgage operations team.



No prior U.S. mortgage experience is required. We are open to entry-level applicants who are willing to learn and have strong attention to detail, good communication skills, reliability, and the ability to follow processes accurately.



MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS



- Must be a graduate of Finance, Accounting, Financial Management, Banking and Finance, Business Finance, or another closely related course

- Strong attention to detail and accuracy

- Good written and verbal English communication skills

- Comfortable working with numbers, financial documents, and data

- Good analytical and problem-solving skills

- Able to follow detailed procedures and instructions

- Able to learn new systems and processes quickly

- Dependable, professional, and accountable

- Able to work independently

- Willing to learn U.S. mortgage processes

- Comfortable working a permanent Philippine night/graveyard shift



Previous U.S. mortgage experience is an advantage but is not required.



JOB RESPONSIBILITIES



- Prepare and review U.S. mortgage loan files during the initial setup stage

- Review borrower information and documents for completeness and accuracy

- Enter and verify loan information in the Loan Origination System (LOS)

- Identify missing, incomplete, or inconsistent information

- Review files based on lender and loan program requirements

- Order or coordinate required third-party services

- Maintain accurate and organized loan records

- Coordinate with Account Executives, brokers, and other mortgage operations team members

- Follow established procedures, checklists, and turnaround times

- Perform other mortgage operations tasks as assigned



SALARY



Starting salary: Php 19,715 per month



Salary progression: Up to Php 28,600 per month within the first 5 months, subject to successful training, performance, and evaluation.



WORK-FROM-HOME REQUIREMENTS



Internet:

- Minimum 100 Mbps stable internet connection

- Reliable primary internet suitable for calls, online systems, and file processing

- Backup internet connection or mobile hotspot



Computer/Laptop:

- Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5 or equivalent or better

- Minimum 8 GB RAM; 16 GB preferred

- SSD storage

- Windows 10/11 or another currently supported operating system

- Working webcam and headset with microphone

- Must be capable of running multiple browser tabs and work applications simultaneously



Applicants must also have a quiet and professional work area suitable for calls, meetings, and handling confidential information.



WORK SCHEDULE



Monday to Friday - Philippine Night Shift



This position supports U.S. business hours. Applicants must be comfortable working a permanent graveyard schedule.



BENEFITS



- Permanent work-from-home setup

- Paid training

- Structured salary progression based on performance

- Regular performance and salary reviews

- HMO/Health Card after 3 months

- Paid U.S. holidays

- 3 days paid time off after 5 months

- 7 days paid time off after 1 year

- Training and opportunities for advancement within U.S. mortgage operations

- Long-term employment opportunity



HOW TO APPLY



Please send your updated resume and answer the following questions:



1. What course did you graduate from?

2. Do you have previous U.S. mortgage experience? If yes, briefly describe your experience.

3. What is your current or most recent monthly salary?

4. What is your expected monthly salary?

5. Are you willing to start at Php 19,715 per month, with salary progression of up to Php 28,600 within the first 5 months based on successful training and performance evaluation?

6. Are you comfortable working a permanent Philippine night/graveyard shift?

7. What are your computer specifications (processor and RAM)?

8. What is your internet speed and internet service provider?

9. Do you have a backup internet connection?

10. When are you available to start?



Please review the qualifications, salary, schedule, and work-from-home requirements carefully before applying.

description:
About the Position

We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Registered Nurse (RN) to join our Quality Assurance (QA) team as a Hospice Documentation Auditor. This is a fully remote position responsible for reviewing and auditing hospice clinical documentation to ensure compliance with hospice documentation best practices.



The ideal candidate is highly organized, possesses excellent critical thinking skills, and has extensive knowledge of hospice documentation standards. This role plays a vital part in ensuring that our clinical records accurately reflect each patient's condition, support hospice eligibility, and withstand regulatory audits.



Primary Responsibilities

Review and audit hospice nursing documentation for accuracy, completeness, and regulatory compliance.

Identify documentation errors, omissions, inconsistencies, and contradictions within the medical record.

Ensure documentation accurately reflects the patient's clinical decline and disease progression.

Verify that visit notes clearly describe the patient's current condition, symptom burden, functional status, and changes from previous visits.

Review admission, routine, PRN, recertification, discharge, and other hospice documentation for quality and compliance.

Confirm that documentation supports the patient's terminal prognosis and continued eligibility for hospice services.

Identify missing documentation, conflicting information, or incomplete assessments that could place claims at risk during 

Return documentation requiring corrections to clinicians with clear, concise QA feedback.

Collaborate with nursing leadership to improve documentation quality and consistency.

Monitor documentation trends and recommend opportunities for education and process improvement.

Maintain strict confidentiality and compliance with HIPAA requirements.

Qualifications

Required

Active Registered Nurse (RN) license (license does not have to be from the state where the hospice operates).

Strong understanding of hospice eligibility guidelines and documentation requirements.

Excellent written English communication skills.

Ability to identify documentation deficiencies and provide constructive feedback.

Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Proficient computer skills.

We're an e-commerce company running several online stores across Europe, spending on Meta ads every day. We're looking for someone with real Meta ads experience to review our ads, understand what's working and why, and help our manager d
 what to do next.



What you'll do:



Analysing our ads (around 75% of the role)

- Review our Meta campaigns across all our brands and track the numbers each week to spot trends

- Work out which ads and angles are working, which are dropping, and why

- Spot ad fatigue early, looking at frequency, CTR, CPA and ROAS across TOF, MOF and BOF ads

- When a brand drops, find the reason: the creatives, the hooks, the price, the offer, the product page or the competition

- Work with our manager to d

Product research (around 25% of the role)

- Use our custom internal tools to find new products for us to test (does all the research work for you)

- Keep a ranked list of the best products for us to launch next

- Find the best reference videos and image ads for our editors



The product research side is easy to learn, and we'll show you exactly how we do it. The ads side is where we need your experience.



Reporting

- A short daily report and a more detailed weekly report in Google Sheets



You should have:

- Proven experience with Meta Ads Manager, either running ads yourself or analysing them for a brand or agency

- A strong understanding of frequency, CTR, CPM, CPA and ROAS, and how they connect

- Experience with creative analysis: why an ad works, what makes a good hook and angle, and when an ad is fatiguing

- Understanding of TOF, MOF and BOF and how they behave differently

title: BOOKKEEPER/ BUSINESS MANAGEMENT STAFF
description:
## POSITION OVERVIEW



We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Business Management / Bookkeeping Staff member to provide day-to-day accounting and administrative support for one of our key clients. This position will work closely with the client and our accounting team to manage accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, commission reporting, financial records, and other business management responsibilities.



The ideal candidate is highly organized, responsive, able to manage multiple priorities, and comfortable communicating directly with clients, vendors, and employees.



## KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



### Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable



* Manage and maintain accounts payable and accounts receivable.

* Process vendor invoices, payments, and customer receipts.

* Monitor outstanding receivables and follow up on past-due balances.

* Maintain accurate vendor and customer records.

* Assist with cash flow monitoring and payment scheduling.



### Commission Reporting



* Prepare recurring commission reports and calculations.

* Review sales and transaction information for accuracy.

* Coordinate commission payments and resolve discrepancies.

* Maintain supporting documentation for commission calculations.



### Payroll



* Coordinate and process payroll information.

* Review payroll reports for accuracy.

* Maintain employee payroll records and assist with payroll-related questions.

* Coordinate with the payroll provider and accounting team as needed.



### Client Support



* Serve as a primary day-to-day contact for the client regarding accounting and business management matters.

* Respond to client questions and requests in a timely and professional manner.

* Coordinate with vendors, employees, and other third parties on behalf of the client.

* Identify issues and communicate them to the appropriate accounting or management team.



### Bookkeeping & Financial Administration



* Perform bank and credit card reconciliations.

* Maintain accurate and organized accounting records.

* Assist with monthly financial reporting and account analysis.

* Enter and review transactions in QuickBooks Online.

* Assist with budgeting, cash flow tracking, and other financial analysis as needed.



### General Business Management Support



* Handle miscellaneous accounting, business management, and administrative tasks related to the client's business.

* Assist with special projects and financial research.

* Maintain organized electronic records and supporting documentation.

* Coordinate with the tax and accounting teams regarding tax filings, information requests, and year-end matters.

* Take on additional responsibilities as needed to support the client's business operations.



## QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS



* Minimum 2 years of experience working with U.S.-based clients or accounts.

* 2+ years of bookkeeping, accounting, business management, or related experience.

* Strong understanding of accounts payable and accounts receivable.

* Experience with payroll and commission calculations preferred.

* QuickBooks Online experience preferred.

* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills.

* Excellent attention to detail and organization.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

* Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities.

* Ability to maintain confidentiality when handling sensitive financial and payroll information.

* Strong client service and communication skills.



## IDEAL CANDIDATE



The ideal candidate is someone who can become familiar with the client's business and serve as a reliable day-to-day financial resource. This person should be proactive, dependable, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership of responsibilities.



## WHAT TO EXPECT



As a member of our team, you can expect:



* A welcoming and inclusive environment where your opinions and ideas are valued.

* Opportunities for personal and professional growth through ongoing training and development.

* Competitive compensation and benefits to support you and your family.

* Flexibility to achieve a work-life balance that suits your needs.

* An atmosphere that encourages innovation, creativity, and collaboration.

* Regular team-building activities and social events to unwind and build lasting relationships with your colleagues.



## WORK SCHEDULE



**Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Pacific Time (California time)**



## WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?



* Competitive salary, depending on experience

* 24 PTO credits

* Remote opportunity — work from the comfort of your home

* Long-term opportunity with career growth and advancement



## OUR BACKGROUND



We are a **U.S.-based accounting firm** committed to providing exceptional service and value to our clients. We believe our success starts with a strong, qualified team and a supportive company culture.



We value teamwork, professional growth, and a positive attitude. Our core belief is that **attitude is just as important, if not more important, than technical skills**, and we strive to create an environment where our team members feel valued, supported, and empowered to grow.

title: Fractional CFO / Senior Financial Controller
description:
Fractional CFO / Senior Financial Controller



U.S. Construction & Real Estate Development Company | Remote



Company: RISE Homes

Location: Remote (Philippines)

Employment Type: Part-Time or Full-Time

Schedule: Must be available during U.S. Eastern Time business hours

Salary: Negotiable based on experience



About Us



RISE Homes is a growing residential construction and real estate development company based in New Jersey, USA.



We are looking for an experienced, proactive, and highly organized Fractional CFO / Senior Financial Controller to oversee our company’s financial operations, strengthen our financial systems, and provide strategic financial guidance.



We already have a dedicated bookkeeper who manages daily transactions. We are looking for a financial leader who can oversee the bookkeeping function, analyze our company’s financial performance, manage cash flow, and help leadership make informed financial decisions.



This is NOT a bookkeeping position. We are seeking someone with strong financial leadership experience who can help us improve profitability, manage financial risks, and support company growth.



Key Responsibilities



Financial Management & Strategy



Develop and maintain weekly and monthly cash flow forecasts.

Create a rolling 13-week cash flow projection.

Monitor company liquidity, financial obligations, and upcoming expenses.

Provide financial recommendations directly to the CEO and COO.

Assist with financial planning and business growth strategies.

Identify financial risks and opportunities to improve profitability.

Construction & Real Estate Financial Oversight



Monitor budgets and expenses across multiple construction projects.

Track project profitability and budget versus actual costs.

Oversee construction job costing and financial reporting.

Monitor construction loans, draws, and financing expenses.

Analyze project performance and identify cost overruns.

Evaluate the financial feasibility of future development projects.

Financial Reporting



Prepare and analyze profit and loss statements, balance sheets, and cash flow reports.

Develop financial dashboards and performance reports.

Establish weekly and monthly financial reporting procedures.

Provide clear financial insights and recommendations to company leadership.

Accounting Oversight



Supervise and review the work of our existing bookkeeper.

Ensure financial records are accurate and properly maintained.

Oversee QuickBooks Online reporting and reconciliations.

Establish internal financial controls and accounting procedures.

Coordinate with our U.S.-based accountants and tax professionals.

Systems & Process Improvement



Evaluate and improve existing financial processes.

Implement standardized project budgeting and job-costing systems.

Improve financial tracking and reporting efficiency.

Recommend financial tools and software integrations.

Develop scalable financial systems to support company growth.

Required Qualifications



Minimum 7 years of experience in accounting, financial management, or financial leadership.

Previous experience as a CFO, Finance Director, Financial Controller, or similar senior-level position.

Experience working with U.S.-based companies.

Strong knowledge of U.S. accounting practices.

Advanced QuickBooks Online and Excel/Google Sheets skills.

Proven experience with financial forecasting, budgeting, and cash flow management.

Experience overseeing accounting teams or bookkeepers.

Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

Strong English communication skills.

Ability to work independently and take initiative.

Preferred Qualifications



Experience in residential construction, real estate development, or general contracting.

Knowledge of construction job costing and project profitability.

Experience managing multiple LLCs or business entities.

Familiarity with construction loans and draw schedules.

Experience creating financial dashboards and reporting systems.

CPA, MBA, or other relevant financial qualifications.

What We’re Looking For



We want someone who goes beyond preparing financial reports.



The ideal candidate will be able to analyze our company’s financial position, anticipate challenges, identify opportunities, and confidently advise leadership.



We are looking for someone who takes ownership, communicates proactively, pays close attention to detail, and is committed to helping our company succeed.



First 30–60 Days



Our initial priorities include:



Reviewing our existing financial systems and accounting processes.

Evaluating current project budgets and financial reports.

Establishing a reliable company-wide cash flow forecast.

Implementing project profitability reporting.

Identifying financial risks and areas for improvement.

Creating a financial dashboard for company leadership.

Establishing a consistent weekly financial reporting process.

How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



Your updated résumé.

A brief introduction about your professional background.

Your experience working with U.S. construction or real estate companies.

Your experience with QuickBooks Online, financial forecasting, and job costing.

An example of a financial dashboard, budget, or cash flow report you have created (remove confidential information).

Your expected monthly salary or hourly rate.

Your availability during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

IMPORTANT: Please begin your application with the words “RISE Financial Leadership” to confirm you have read the entire job description.



We are looking for a reliable, experienced, and long-term team member who can become a trusted financial partner to our leadership team.

title: Recruitment & Teacher Operations Assistant
description:
WE ARE HIRING

Reports To: Operations Manager

SomStart is a growing online school serving students in the United States, Canada, and worldwide.



We are looking for a highly motivated, organized, and experienced professional to recruit, manage, and supervise 10 or more online teachers and instructors.



We are expanding our educational programs and need someone who can continuously find talented instructors from the Philippines and other countries.



Key Responsibilities



1. Recruitment & Hiring



* Actively recruit at least 10 additional qualified teachers, with ongoing recruitment as we expand.

* Find instructors in AI, coding, programming, technology, English, GED, mathematics, business, career skills, and many other subjects.

* Identify new courses and skills that students would benefit from learning.

* Advertise vacancies on LinkedIn, Indeed,
, and other hiring platforms.

* Track interviews, shortlisted candidates, and hiring progress.

* Keep updated records of all assigned teachers.

* Submit daily teacher attendance and performance reports.

* Provide management with recruitment updates and recommendations.

* Work closely with the Operations Manager to improve teaching quality and reliability.



Qualifications



* Excellent spoken and written English.

* Experience in recruitment, HR, education, or operations management.

* Strong interviewing, leadership, and problem-solving skills.

* Ability to recruit instructors across many different subjects.

* Experience supervising remote employees or teachers.

* Reliable internet connection and ability to work independently.



Our Expectations



We want someone who is proactive, dependable, and results-driven.



Your two main responsibilities are:



1. Recruitment: Continuously find and recommend excellent teachers across a wide range of subjects.

2. Supervision: Successfully manage 10 or more teachers, ensuring punctuality, professionalism, and high-quality instruction.



This is a long-term, full-time position with opportunities for growth as SomStart expands.



How to Apply



Send your resume, relevant experience, and a short introduction describing your experience recruiting and managing remote teachers or employees.

title: Economics Content & Resource Developer | Full-Time Remote
description:

Join an established, leading Australian tutoring company as a full-time Economics Content & Resource Developer. You’ll become part of our academic team, turning strong subject knowledge into clear, accurate questions and learning resources for senior high school students (Years 11–12).



This role suits someone who enjoys explaining Economics, takes pride in precise work, and is looking for a stable position with opportunities to grow.



Position details

• Location: Remote / online

• Hours: Full-time, 40 hours per week

• Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:30 am–5:30 pm, Perth / Philippine time (GMT+8)

• Salary: USD $650+ per month, depending on qualifications and experience



What you’ll do

• Develop senior high school Economics questions and educational resources for Years 11–12.

• Write clear, step-by-step worked solutions and marking keys.

• Create, review and refine course materials, worksheets, and blogs for accuracy, clarity, and quality.

• Collaborate with our instructional design team on academic content projects.

Apply

We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Civil Engineer – Stormwater, Water & Sewer Design (Part-Time, Remote)
description:
Hours per week: 20

Wage/salary: AUD $18–25 per hour, depending on experience



Job description

ABOUT US

TA Project Services is a multi-disciplinary consultancy on the far south coast of New South Wales, Australia. We deliver civil engineering, land surveying, town planning, environmental services and project management, mostly residential and rural subdivisions and small-to-mid regional developments. Our values are Efficiency, Integrity, Continuous Improvement, Open Communication and Reliability. Our mission is simple: Together Achieve.

We already work with a Philippines-based civil engineer as part of our design team, and we’re adding a second engineer to the same model.

THE WORK

Stormwater design for subdivisions and developments: pit and pipe networks, overland flow, on-site detention and water quality

Water supply and sewer reticulation design for subdivisions, including layouts, long sections and calculations

Subdivision road, grading and drainage design in AutoCAD Civil 3D and Civil Site Design, from concept through to detailed design

Design calculations, design statements and design reports, and responses to council comments

Quantities and cost estimates for civil designs, using our estimating template

Working directly with our Australian project managers, surveyors and senior engineers through Asana, Microsoft Teams and SharePoint



WHAT WE NEED

Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering

At least 3 years’ civil design experience, ideally in subdivision and land development

Proficiency in AutoCAD Civil 3D

Demonstrated stormwater drainage design experience

Demonstrated water and/or sewer reticulation design experience

Strong written and spoken English. You’ll deal directly with our team, not through a middle manager

Reliable and self-managing, comfortable working remotely with limited supervision

Careful with your own work, and willing to say when something doesn’t add up



HIGHLY REGARDED

DRAINS (stormwater modelling)

Experience on Australian projects

Familiarity with Australian Rainfall and Runoff (ARR 2019), WSA water and sewerage codes, Austroads and Australian Standards

Civil Site Design (we provide the licence) or MUSIC

Experience preparing quantity take-offs and cost estimates for civil works



WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

You won’t be the engineer of record and you won’t certify designs. All designs are reviewed and signed off by our Australian engineers before issue. You prepare the design; we review and certify it.



THE ARRANGEMENT

Independent contractor, fully remote

Part time, 20 hours a week

Three-month initial engagement, reviewed and extended on performance

Paid weekly

You’ll need your own computer, a reliable internet connection and a licensed copy of AutoCAD Civil 3D. We provide the Civil Site Design licence.



TO APPLY

Send your CV, two or three design samples (a stormwater network, DRAINS output, or a sewer or water long section is ideal), and a short note about a design problem you caught or solved before it became expensive. Start your message with the word “DRAINS” so we know you’ve read the ad.

Shortlisted applicants will complete a short paid test: a small stormwater and sewer design check, with one error planted for you to find.

title: RevOps Specialist: Salesforce

About Levver:

We're Levver, a small revenue operations consulting team. We move fast, use modern tools every day (Slack, HubSpot, ClickUp, Claude and Claude Code) and learn by doing.



Many of our clients run on Salesforce, often alongside HubSpot, and some are moving from one to the other. We're looking for a long-term partner who loves solving these problems and can make Levver their main client.



What you'll do:

- Build and maintain Salesforce: objects, fields, page layouts, validation rules, Flows, permission sets, reports and dashboards

- Set up, monitor and fix the HubSpot and Salesforce integration: field mappings, sync rules, inclusion lists, sync errors and duplicates

- Plan and run data migrations between Salesforce and HubSpot: field mapping, cleanup, imports, and checking that the numbers match

- Keep CRM data accurate: deduplication, record ownership and hygiene

- Join client calls, take clear notes and turn them into tasks in ClickUp

- Keep an eye on Slack during the collaboration window and respond quickly to the team and clients

- Document what you build so the team can run on it



What we're looking for:

- Hands-on Salesforce admin experience: you can show us specific things you built

- A problem solver: you dig into a messy system or a vague request and find the fix

- You love building, and you take pride in clean, simple work

- You love helping people, whether that's a teammate or a client

- You want to be part of a company that's fun and full of challenges

- A proven record of working US hours long-term

- The capacity to make Levver your main client, long-term

- Responsive: you check Slack throughout the collaboration window and reply promptly

- Clear written and spoken English. You'll be on live client calls.

- You work independently: give you a goal and context, and you figure out the how

- You enjoy learning new tools and pick them up quickly



Preferred, not required:

- 2 to 5 years as a Salesforce admin

- Experience with the HubSpot and Salesforce integration, or a migration between them

- Salesforce Administrator certification

- SOQL, Data Loader or Apex familiarity

- HubSpot experience

- Experience with Claude, Claude Code, ClickUp or Clay



How we work together:

- This is a long-term independent contractor engagement, not employment. You invoice Levver in USD twice a month, use your own equipment, and handle your own local taxes and registrations. During the collaboration window you're reachable on Slack and join calls by agreement. Outside it you set your own schedule, and weekend work is not expected.



Our process (so there's no guessing):

- Apply here following the instructions below.

- If it's a potential fit, we send a short form (about 10 minutes) that includes a 2 to 3 minute Loom.

- Strong applicants get one practical task (about 45 minutes), with a short Loom walking us through it.

- A 30-minute call with our team.

- A 30-day paid introductory period, so we can both make sure it works well.

title: Executive assistant

title: 🔥 TEAM LEADER — Can You Turn Performance Around?
description:
Are you the Team Leader people call when a team is missing target and needs a turnaround?



Can you look at a dashboard and immediately start asking:



What changed? Why? Who needs coaching? What are we doing about it TODAY?



If that sounds like you, keep reading.



WHO WE ARE



We’re a fast-growing Customer Experience & Retention agency supporting health, wellness, and eCommerce brands in the U.S. We help our clients protect revenue, retain customers, and deliver exceptional customer experiences.



And we LOVE data.



At ECX, Team Leaders don’t just supervise people or send reports. They move numbers.



YOUR MISSION



You’ll lead a team of retention specialists focused on preventing refunds, blocking cancellations, and upselling/cross-selling.



Your job is simple: Know your numbers. Know your people. Improve performance.



You’ll own KPIs including: SLA | CSAT | QA | AHT | Productivity | FCR | Attendance | Adherence | Closure Rate



When something falls below target, we don’t want someone who simply reports the miss.



We want someone who can figure out WHY and build a plan to fix it.



WHAT YOU’LL ACTUALLY DO



Run daily performance and keep your team on target

Analyze dashboards and spot trends, outliers, and performance gaps

Coach struggling agents and turn performance around

Recognize and develop your top performers

Manage staffing, queues, attendance, adherence, and productivity

Protect SLAs and prevent backlogs before they happen

Partner with QA to turn quality findings into coaching

Build reports that explain what happened, why it happened, and what happens next

Handle escalations and make sound leadership decisions

Find broken processes and help us make them better



We move quickly. You’ll have autonomy, but with autonomy comes ownership.



YOU MIGHT BE OUR PERSON IF...



~ You’ve spent 3+ recent years leading teams in a BPO/contact center and have personally managed 15+ agents.

~ You’re comfortable with Excel/Google Sheets and can actually analyze data, not just copy numbers into a report.

~ You’ve improved an underperforming team.

~ You’ve coached someone from missing targets to hitting it.

~ You’ve identified a problem in the data before someone had to point it out.

~ You’ve made operational decisions that improved a KPI.



That’s the Team Leader we want to meet.



HOW WE LEAD



~ We’re serious about performance, but we don’t believe great leadership means managing through fear.

~ We believe in servant leadership + accountability.



Set clear expectations. Coach people. Give them the tools to succeed. Recognize great work. Address poor performance quickly. Treat people with respect.



Simple.



THE DETAILS



Full-Time | Monday to Friday | U.S. EST Hours | Overnight PH Shift



You’ll need:



Reliable high-speed internet

Professional, distraction-free workspace

Two-monitor setup

Flexibility when business needs require additional coverage

Excellent written and spoken English



ONE LAST THING...



Please don’t send us the same generic application you send to 20 other employers.



We genuinely want to know what you’ve accomplished.



Shortlisted candidates will be asked to share:



A short video introducing yourself and telling us about one team you helped improve

Internet speed screenshot

Photo of your workspace showing your dual-monitor setup

One report or dashboard you personally created

Your DISC profile, if you have one



When you apply, please answer this question:



You inherit a 30-person team that has missed its KPI for three consecutive weeks. What’s the FIRST thing you look at, and why?



If you’re already thinking about your answer... we definitely want to hear from you. 🚀

title: Short-Form Video Editor (Motion Graphics and Effects)
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We sell pet products across several brands on Amazon, Chewy, Shopify, TikTok Shop, Walmart, and through retail partners. We are looking for an inventive, trend-savvy short-form video editor to create scroll-stopping, high-converting video for all of our brands.



You will turn raw phone footage from our in-house team and content creators into organic TikToks and Reels, product videos for Amazon, Chewy, and TikTok Shop, and paid social and Amazon Sponsored Brands video ads.



You won’t just be cutting clips together. You will add creative flair, dynamic masking, kinetic transitions, and sound design to make simple clips feel clever and fun. You should be fluent in TikTok and IG culture, native trend formats, and creative visual editing tricks.



We work AI-first. You should already use AI features in your editing tools (for example, DaVinci Resolve Magic Mask or CapCut auto cutout) to work faster without lowering quality.



Pay: USD 1,500 to 2,000 per month, depending on experience

Schedule: 8:30 AM - 4:30 PM PST

Reports to: Creative Director. You will work day to day with our Social Media Manager and other marketing managers.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Organic Social Video (about 20 hours per week)



Edit 9:16 vertical videos for TikTok and Instagram Reels using raw footage from our in-house social team and content creators.

Apply creative visual effects, including dynamic rotoscoping and masking (sticker peel effects, freeze-frame cutouts, object pop-ins), seamless jump cuts, disappearing and appearing object tricks, match cuts, native collage, paper tear, 2D sticker animations, and seamless loops built for replay value.

Time cuts, transitions, text animations, and effects precisely to the beat of the music.

Design on-screen text with a refined eye: choose and pair fonts, set clear hierarchy and spacing, keep text within platform safe zones, and animate it so it looks polished and premium, not template-based.

Add trending audio licensed for business accounts, sound effects, animated captions, and platform-native text styles.

Bring your own ideas for hooks, pacing, and trend formats instead of only assembling footage.



Marketplace Video (about 10 hours per week)



Create product videos for Amazon (listing and A+ Content), Chewy, and other channels.

Adapt content to each platform’s formats, including 16:9, 1:1, and 9:16.

Follow each retailer’s content guidelines, with clear product benefits and demonstrations.



Paid Ads (about 15 hours per week)



Edit video ads for Meta, TikTok, and Amazon Sponsored Brands.

Produce multiple hook and format variations of each concept for testing.



AI Workflow



Use AI tools throughout your workflow to speed up turnaround, such as AI masking and rotoscoping, auto captions, beat detection, and rough cut assembly, while keeping full creative control of the final edit.

Generate and edit video and visual assets with AI tools such as Seedance, Higgsfield, and Claude, and blend them with live footage.



Across All Work



Manage a steady weekly queue of requests from the Creative Director, Social Media Manager, and marketing managers.

Keep project files organized and deliver final exports in the correct specs for each platform.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



A portfolio of TikTok and Reels edits with creative transitions, masking, and visual tricks. Talking-head videos with subtitles will not be considered.

A precise sense of rhythm. Your edits land on the beat, not near it.

Strong typography and design sense, including font pairing, hierarchy, spacing, color contrast, and adapting text style to different brand identities.



Required



Working proficiency in both CapCut and DaVinci Resolve. Our team uses both for project handoffs.

Advanced motion graphics and effects skills in at least one professional tool, such as After Effects, Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve (Fusion), or CapCut Pro.

Hands-on experience with AI video tools such as Seedance, Higgsfield, or similar.

A strong ear for sound design and audio syncing.

Deep familiarity with current TikTok and Reels trends and humor formats.

Fluent written and spoken English for daily work with a US-based team.

Ability to manage a full weekly queue and meet turnaround times.



Nice to Have



Experience creating product videos for Amazon, Chewy, or TikTok Shop.

Experience editing paid social or Amazon Sponsored Brands video ads.

Ecommerce or consumer products experience.



HOW TO APPLY



Send your application through OLJ with:



Links to 3 to 5 short-form videos you edited that show creative transitions, rotoscoping or masking tricks, or seamless loops. At least one must show beat-synced editing, and at least one must show custom on-screen typography. For each link, add one sentence naming the effect or technique you built, the software you used, and whether it shows beat-syncing or typography.

Any product, marketplace, or ad videos you have edited, if available.

Your main editing and motion graphics software, the AI tools you use, and one example of how AI shortened your turnaround on a specific video.

Your current availability and typical turnaround time per video.

Start your message with the words “ON THE BEAT” so we know you read the full post.



Make sure all links are set to public. Applications that skip any of these will not be reviewed.

title: Creative Video Editor (Meta Ads, High-End B2B)
description:
We are seeking a high-caliber Creative Video Editor to develop and produce premium Meta video ads for a high-end physical product in the U.S. B2B space.



This role goes beyond basic cutting. We need a creative partner who understands performance marketing on Meta, knows how to speak to American B2B buyers and decision-makers, and can bring original, high-converting concepts to the table. The product is the hero. Every asset must reflect its actual scale, proportions, and build quality without looking cheap or gimmicky. AI and 3D tools may be used to enhance production value, but execution must remain realistic and polished.



What We Provide



We provide product photography and reference imagery. In many cases, you will need to build scenes and environments around the product yourself, so experience creating realistic settings from existing product assets is essential.



What You’ll Do



Concept & Direct: Develop original ad concepts with a strong hook in the first 3 seconds.

Execute & Composite: Produce clean, realistic video ads using compositing, 3D/CGI, or refined motion graphics.

On-Screen Typography: Design text overlays built for mobile and sound-off viewing. That means a clear type hierarchy, consistent fonts, proper line spacing, and uncrowded layouts that read instantly on a phone screen. Strong on-screen typography is non-negotiable for this role.

Product Consistency: Ensure the product maintains exact structural details, finish, and proportions across every shot and angle.

Iterate & Scale: Build creative variations (hook swaps, call-to-action changes, alternative framing) for ongoing performance testing.



What We Need From You



Familiarity with Meta advertising and an understanding of what makes ads perform.

Strong video editing and motion graphics skills, with experience in compositing or 3D tools (such as After Effects, Premiere, or Blender).

A strong eye for typography: hierarchy, spacing, and readability in motion.

Strict attention to visual detail and brand standards.

Ability to work on tight deadlines with quick turnaround.

A collaborative approach: open to feedback, comfortable with multiple rounds of revisions, and willing to share your own ideas.



To Apply



Start your application with “CREATIVE TESTING.”



Please provide:



3 to 5 of your top product-focused video ads (Meta B2B or direct-to-consumer preferred).

1 example showing how you maintained exact product accuracy across different environments or composite angles.

1 example of your on-screen text and typography work.

A brief explanation of how you develop hooks and maintain product accuracy.

Your typical turnaround time per ad concept and revision availability.

title: Social Media Manager & Short-Form Video Editor (Part-Time, Growth Bonuses)
description:
THE OPPORTUNITY



Hi, I'm Gabby. I teach kintsugi, the Japanese art of repairing broken ceramics with gold. I've taught over 700 students, from small groups at the San Francisco Zen Center to corporate teams at companies like Meta and Pinterest. Now I'm building my own brand, Repair Studios, and launching kintsugi kits.



I'm starting my Instagram and TikTok from close to zero, and I'm looking for someone to grow it with me. The account will mostly be about kintsugi, and partly about me. People buy from people, so I want it to feel personal. Down the road, that could mean brand partnerships, but only ones that are deeply aligned.



THIS IS NOT JUST AN EDITING JOB. I want someone who's excited about growth: someone who studies what's working, brings me ideas, and wants to watch the numbers climb.



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO



To start, we're aiming for about 3-4 reels a week. Going from zero to consistent is the first big win. We can scale up from there.



1. Research and pitch. Find video formats that are actually performing in kintsugi, craft, art, small business and personal-brand content. Pitch me hooks, angles and video ideas to try. Tell me what to film.

2. Edit. Turn my raw footage into 15-90 second reels with captions, hooks and music. Cut 2-3 versions with different hooks when it makes sense, and learn from what wins.

3. Manage the day-to-day. Upload and schedule posts, write captions, and keep the accounts running smoothly.

4. Help build the footage library. We're starting from scratch. I'll film talking clips and repairs at home, and I'm planning dedicated filming days for workshops. You'll help me plan shot lists so we get what we need.

5. Track and report. Keep an eye on performance, send me a simple monthly report on what's growing and what isn't, and adjust.

6. Keep things organized, so either of us can find any clip or finished video quickly.



HOW YOU'LL BE PAID



- Base: $700 USD/month (about $8/hour) for about 20 hours/week

- Growth bonus: up to $200/month for hitting follower and engagement targets

- Results bonus: up to $200/month when social media drives workshop bookings and kit sales



UP TO $1,100/MONTH TOTAL. We'll set the targets together, in writing, during your first month. Bonuses are paid monthly with your base. Paid via Wise.



If the business grows and we work well together, there's room for this role to grow with it.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



I'm not chasing viral moments. This business doesn't need millions of views. It needs the right people. Success here is steady, consistent growth: numbers moving in the right direction month over month, and an audience that turns into workshop bookings and kit buyers. If you love building something real over time, this is for you.



WHO YOU ARE



- You're genuinely curious about why some videos take off and others don't.

- You have taste. You know the difference between a loud edit and a good one.

- You're proactive. You bring ideas without being asked.

- You're organized and reliable, and you do what you say you'll do.

- You welcome feedback, and you give it too.

- Bonus: you've helped grow an account before and can show the numbers.



We'll work mostly asynchronously across time zones (I'm in California), so clear written English matters.



TO APPLY, PLEASE INCLUDE IN YOUR APPLICATION:



1. Your name and where you're based

2. Why this role interests you

3. 3 links to short-form videos you've edited

4. Any account you've helped grow, with before-and-after numbers if you have them

5. One video idea for a kintsugi account, including the hook

6. Your weekly availability



Finalists will do a short PAID test project.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You’ll work with our marketing and copywriting team to create static and animated ads largely for Meta and Google Display. We need someone who understands how to grab attention, establish a clear visual hierarchy and balance copy, imagery and branding, even in small or awkward formats.

Fast turnaround, strong attention to detail and clear, reliable communication.

Your own licensed design software and the ability to supply editable files.

HOW TO APPLY

Your hourly rate, availability and typical turnaround time (Applicants MUST PROVIDE a portfolio and/or samples of prior work to be considered).

title: AI Video Editor For 8 Figure E-commerce Brand
description:
The Role



We're looking for a DTC AI Video Editor with proven experience working with 7-, 8- or 9-figure e-commerce brands.



You need to understand direct response, not just editing.



Our creative strategists will provide the script, angle and brief — roughly 50% of the ad. Your job is to own the other 50%:



- Choose the strongest footage from our B-roll library.

- Identify where the concept needs stronger or more specific visuals.

- Generate new AI content when existing footage isn't good enough.

- Make every visual congruent with the script, hook and emotional beat.

- Edit for attention, clarity, retention and conversion.

- Proactively improve the visual concept rather than simply executing instructions.



The goal isn't to make videos that look good. The goal is to make ads that perform.



What You'll Own



You'll be responsible for producing a minimum of 12–15 finished concepts per week, with some concepts requiring original AI content generation.



Your responsibilities will include:



- Editing short-form DTC direct-response ads across multiple formats.

- Translating scripts and briefs into strong visual narratives.

- Selecting B-roll based on the psychology and intent of each line.

- Generating missing visuals using AI rather than settling for weak footage.

- Creating high-quality AI UGC, animation and other AI-native creative formats.

- Using tools/models such as Higgsfield, Seedance and Kling to a professional standard.

- Building strong hooks, pattern interrupts, pacing and visual escalation.

- Maintaining script-to-visual congruence throughout every creative.

- Finding ways to increase viewer retention without distracting from the sales message.

- Bringing new visual ideas to the creative strategists.

- Learning from winning and losing ads and improving future execution accordingly.

- Taking ownership of the finished creative rather than waiting to be told exactly what to do.



Who We're Looking For



Non-negotiables



- Proven video-editing experience with successful DTC/e-commerce brands, ideally at 7-, 8- or 9-figure scale.

- Strong knowledge of direct-response advertising fundamentals.

- A portfolio demonstrating performance-focused paid social creative — not only polished brand content.

- High-level AI content generation ability.

- Hands-on experience with modern AI video workflows, ideally including Higgsfield, Seedance and Kling.

- Ability to create convincing AI UGC, animation and other visual formats.

- Strong instinct for matching visuals to copy.

- Understanding of hooks, pacing, pattern interrupts, curiosity, emotion, proof and retention.

- Ability to work at volume without allowing quality to collapse.

- Comfortable receiving a brief and independently solving visual problems.



The mindset



We're looking for someone who is:



- Obsessed with getting better.

- Extremely motivated.

- Proactive rather than reactive.

- Comfortable taking ownership.

- Curious about why an ad works, not merely how it was edited.

- Hungry to become an elite direct-response marketer, not just an editor.

- Excited by a fast-moving environment where standards continue to rise.



If you need every visual decision mapped out for you before you can start editing, this isn't the right role.



What Great Looks Like



A great editor on our team doesn't read a line in a script and ask:



> "What clip should I put here?"

> 



They ask:



> "What does the viewer need to see here for this line to hit as hard as possible?"

> 



If the right clip exists in the B-roll folder, use it.



If it doesn't, create it.



If the brief can be made stronger visually, say so and improve it.



You should be thinking about:



- What stops the scroll?

- Does the first visual strengthen the hook?

- Is every shot supporting what the voiceover is saying?

- Where could attention drop?

- Can this claim be demonstrated instead of stated?

- Is there a stronger visual proof?

- Does the edit build desire, belief or curiosity with every beat?

- What could we generate that would make this concept substantially stronger?



AI Capability



AI generation is a core part of this role — not an optional extra.



You should be comfortable generating production-ready creative across formats such as:



- AI UGC

- Character-led scenes

- Product-integrated scenes

- Cinematic B-roll

- Animations

- Visual metaphors

- Scroll-stopping hook visuals

- Scenes that would be difficult or expensive to shoot traditionally



We want to see real examples of your AI work and understand which tools/models you used to produce them.



Output & Working Rhythm



- Minimum 12–15 concepts per week.

- Mix of traditional editing and AI-assisted/generated concepts.

- Fast iteration based on creative feedback and performance learnings.

- Consistent communication with our creative strategists.

- High standards for both speed and execution.



We care about output, but volume without quality is not the goal. We want someone capable of building a repeatable workflow that delivers both.



Growth Opportunity



This is intended to be a long-term position.



For the right person, there is a clear opportunity to grow into:



- Lead Video Editor, taking ownership of editing standards and potentially helping develop other editors.

- Creative Strategist, if you develop strong enough direct-response, research and concepting ability.



We'll actively coach and train you in direct response while you work with us. We want someone who wants to compound their skill set and become a significantly stronger marketer over time.



Team Environment



You'll be joining a fast-growing DTC e-commerce brand with a highly driven team.



We're ambitious about where we're taking the brand, and creative is one of the most important growth levers in the business.



That means this role comes with real ownership and real expectations.



Only apply if you're genuinely excited by a fast-moving, high-performance environment and want to take responsibility for an area that directly impacts the growth of the company.



Application Process



Start your application with the word “STRATEGIST”



If your application doesn't begin with that word, we'll assume you haven't read the full brief.



Then include:



- A short introduction and the DTC brands you've worked with.

- Links to your 3–5 strongest direct-response ads.

- Links to your best AI-generated video work.

- The AI tools/models you currently use and what you use each for.

- A brief explanation of your goals/vision for role development over the next 1-2 years.

title: L2 Tech Support Engineer
description:
Dear Technology Lover!

We're a small (but VERY efficient) 20-year-old MSP based in Arizona.

As a small company. we're VERY employee-focused, and believe that our team members are our MOST IMPORTANT ASSET!



Here are some of the things you can expect from working with us:

• Ongoing (monthly) manager review and feedback- you should never guess where you are "standing" and what you, AND THE COMPANY, can do better!

• Paid certifications- we will pay for your courses and tests and allocate time during business hours to help you achieve your desired goals

• Paid Time Off- it's important to us that you are happy, healthy, and have a work-life balance!

• Bonuses- when the company wins, you win!

• Raises- As we grow, we believe you should as well. We have to stay competitive as an employer to retain our awesome employees!

• Opportunities to grow- In our industry, we can't be on "cruise control"... We need to push our team members to stay ahead of the technology curve. Help you continually sharpen your skills with a focus on your career aspirations.

• Paid sick days- We understand life happens. We don't want you to feel that you have to drag yourself to work sick if your body tells you to relax...



You're the right fit if you:

• LOVE learning, working with, and experimenting with new technology

• Get excited when you save someone's day and provide great service

• Are a hard-working, fun person, and see yourself being in the IT industry for the foreseeable future

• Want to work in a GROWING environment, with STABLE income, Bonuses, and a great attitude!

• Want the opportunity to advance and learn more!



Some of the responsibilities that your position will include are:

Helpdesk (mostly escalations, but some basic if needed), cyber security related tasks/ audits, cloud hosting and virtualization (HyperV, SonicWall, VPN), MS365 management and automation, BCDR (Axcient), networking (UniFi, SonicWall), IT projects, Servers maintenance (Windows only), scripts creation, testing new technology, and other tasks related to IT.



IMPORTANT:

This position requires AT LEAST 3 years of MSP experience and at least 2 years of experience in an L2 position, supervisory, or lead role. 100% clean background check, highly organized, technologically savvy, and can work diligently with little supervision. Several hiring steps will take place to verify the above requirements, including reference checking, employment verification, technical testing, and more.



Minimum technical level that you will need to be able to pass a test on:

• Explaining to a non-technical person what the "cloud" is

• Consulting with a new client on what BCDR solution you would recommend to an SMB, and why

• Explaining what the differences are between traditional anti-virus and XDR

• Creating a new Virtual Machine on a Hyper-V host, from an ISO file located on a different computer on the network.

• Explaining the differences and commonalities between SharePoint and OneDrive.

• Creating an Intune policy that will install Firefox on an Azure-joined VM, and make Firefox the default browser, with the specific home page we'll provide to you during the test.

• Several other situational and technical questions.

• CCNA certificate candidates preferred but not required.



MORE DETAILS:

• A PRE-EMPLOYMENT BACKGROUND CHECK is performed (at our expense). You must have 100% clean background check. Please do not apply if you don't have 100% clean background check.

• Personality is KEY for us. We are looking for an easy-going, yet professional, friendly, and HONEST person.

• You will be working from home. This means you must have a quiet work environment and no excessive background noise.

• FAST AND RELIABLE INTERNET SERVICE IS REQUIRED with at least 100Mbps download speed and 20+ Mbps upload speed.

• As part of this position requirement, you must have a computer that will be used exclusively for your work with us. This means we will be installing our security software on that computer, will remove admin rights from you, and monitor/ control it for security and compliance reasons. In return, we will pay you additional “rent” fees, on top of your salary, in the amount of several hundred dollars. Details about this “rental” will be discussed during your second interview. There are minimum requirements that your computer must have in order to be employed with us. You must have a Computer/Laptop with at least i5 minimum 9th gen processor (preferably a newer one) with 16 GB RAM or more, or Ryzen 5/7 (MUST include TPM support) as well as Windows 11 OS.

• You must have recently worked on a night shift for 2 consecutive years or more.

• We evaluate/ review employees monthly and provide consistent feedback.

• We offer raises and bonuses according to performance, certifications, attitude, and customer reviews twice/ year.

• Your manager (our IT director) will create a roadmap for your "KPIs" and certifications track. We always push our team to earn certifications and additional knowledge – even allowing “disconnect study time” during business hours!

• On-call rotation (after-hours) for a week at a time, once every 4-5 weeks. It's VERY rare that we get calls after-hours (the average is only twice/ year!).

• We're closed on major US holidays, and at the completion of the first 3 months of employment, you'll qualify for paid holidays.

• Work hours are Mon-Fri at 8 am till 5:30 pm (UTC-07:00 , MST, Arizona time zone)

• Every 4 to 5 weeks, you'll be working 1/2 day on a Saturday (project work/catch-up work) and get 1/2 day off the week after

• Mandatory 1-hour lunch and additional breaks (as you need those) throughout the day.

• Further details and information will be discussed with qualified candidates.



EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:

• REQUIRED: With AT LEAST 2 years of experience in an L2 position, supervisory or lead role.

• REQUIRED: Microsoft Azure AD/ M365 experience

• REQUIRED: Experience working with an RMM and PSA software (DATTO preferred)

Other tools we use:

Barracuda DNS filter, AutoElevate, Cylance, Infocyte, Syxsense, IT Glue, SonicWall, Unifi, and more

title: Podcast and Video Editor + Shorts Producer, Contemplative Podcast (Part Time, Long Term)
description:
About the show



House of Belonging with Laura Thomas is a new weekly podcast launching on 16 November 2026. Short, quiet episodes about the ordinary moments when a person comes home to herself. It is contemplative and gently Zen in spirit, never preachy and never salesy. Laura records on camera in her own room, so every episode goes out as audio, as a full YouTube video, and as short vertical clips.



We are looking for one editor to own the weekly production: the episode, the video, and the clips that bring new listeners to the show. This is a long-term role for the right person.



What you will do each week

1. Assemble each episode in Descript from Riverside's separate audio and video tracks: Studio Sound, filler and false starts removed, intro and outro music, chapter markers, and a clean export. This is a slow show. Natural pauses are part of it and stay in.

2. Edit the full episode video for YouTube, cutting between two camera angles.

3. Cut four vertical Shorts or Reels (30 to 90 seconds) from that week's recording, with captions checked word for word against what Laura actually says.

4. Draft six Substack Notes from Laura's published essays, in her voice, for her approval.

5. Make three Instagram posts in Canva from our templates: a carousel, a quote card and a photo post.

6. Research 12 to 15 podcasts a week that could host Laura as a guest, and add each one to our spreadsheet with its audience size, how you know that, how the show books guests, and a contact link.

7. There are three episode types: solo episodes of about 20 minutes, conversations with Laura's teacher, and interviews. 



Turnaround is 48 hours from raw files to finished episode and clips. Notes are drafted the same day they are requested.



What you need

1. At least two years of podcast editing, with links to episodes you edited

2. Strong Descript skills, including multitrack and video editing

3. A portfolio of vertical short-form clips with clean, accurate captions

4. Excellent written English, because you will draft text in someone else's voice

5. Canva, Google Drive and Google Sheets

6. Reliable internet and a backup plan for power or connection outages

7. Comfort with detailed feedback in the first month, while you learn how the show should sound



Nice to have

1. Experience with Riverside

2. An interest in meditation, mindfulness, poetry or contemplative writing

3. Experience growing a YouTube Shorts channel



Pay and hours

- USD $9 per hour, paid weekly through OnlineJobs.ph EasyPay

- About 12 hours a week for the first three weeks, then about 10 hours a week, ongoing

- Flexible hours and mostly asynchronous work. We are in US Mountain Time, with one short video check-in a week

- A 30-day trial, then a long-term contract



A paid test task: shortlisted applicants are paid USD $30 for a short test of about three to four hours. We pay everyone who delivers, whether or not we hire them



How to apply

- Start your application with the word "Threshold", so we know you read this far.

- Send links to two podcast episodes you edited, and say what you did on each.

- Send links to three vertical clips you cut.

- In two or three sentences, tell us what makes a 45-second clip from a slow, reflective conversation work.

- Tell us your earliest start date. We would like you to start on Monday 2 November.



We review applications on Thursday 29 October and contact the shortlist on Friday 30 October.

title: Property Accountant (RCG Portfolio)
description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented, highly analytical Property Accountant to join our team supporting the RCG Portfolio. In this role, you will oversee multi-entity property accounting, maintain accurate financial records, and manage tenant billing operations across commercial and multi-family real estate assets.



Working directly with AV Leads and Property Managers, you will ensure total ledger accuracy, execute timely bank reconciliations, manage lease financials, and deliver thorough month-end reporting packages tailored to RCG’s operational standards.

You will work closely with our customer service representative, who handles client communications and document collection. Your responsibility will be to process client files, prepare dispute letters, and keep dispute information updated in our systems.



We print and mail all dispute letters ourselves. Once you have processed the client’s file and prepared the letters, our team will handle printing and mailing.



We follow a lawful, evidence-based process. We do not perform credit sweeps, make fraudulent claims, or falsely claim identity theft. We use applicable consumer laws to support legitimate disputes. We use FTC identity theft reports only for inquiries when the client confirms they resulted from actual identity theft and the report is appropriate.



We will train you on our standard operating procedures (SOPs), letter-writing process, and the consumer laws relevant to our work. We have our own system to help generate dispute letters, but you must be able to review, personalize, and write letters based on each client’s credit report and circumstances.

- Keep client records neat, accurate, and organized.

- Communicate with the team and respond promptly through Slack during scheduled work hours.

- Follow company procedures, meet deadlines, and protect confidential client information.

 to manage and update client work.

- Ability to read and understand consumer credit reports.

- Experience applying consumer laws, such as the Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) and Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), to legitimate disputes.

- Experience calling credit bureaus to check the status of disputes and document the results.

- 3+ years of professional video editing experience, ideally with podcasts, interviews, YouTube or advertising

- Hands-on experience creating finished AI-generated videos using Higgsfield or comparable tools

- Ability to take an idea from brief or script through to a polished final video

- Strong sense of story, pacing and what makes US audiences watch and share

- AI ads or promotional videos created for brands, creators or media companies

description:

Responsibilities

Review client financials in QuickBooks Online and make special adjustments at year end

Research Canadian tax issues (Income Tax Act, Excise Tax Act, CRA publications and case law) and write clear memos

Support tax planning for owner-managed businesses (salary vs. dividends, shareholder loans, associated corporations, and similar topics)

Communicate with Canadian clients by phone, video and

Keep organized workpapers and meet firm deadlines

Solid knowledge of corporate tax and financial statement preparation

Excellent written and spoken English; confident speaking with clients

Schedule

We do provide flex hours for example 4 hours during day time in Canada and 4 hours night time in Canada.

A professional, supportive remote team

Social Media Video Editor (Instagram Reels)

About us

We are a small founder-led group of US lifestyle brands: a women’s hair wellness supplement, a natural men’s personal care line, and a luxury fragrance house. We are growing each brand’s Instagram through short, useful, beautiful Reels, and we need an editor who makes people stop scrolling and share.

You’ll work directly with the founder and our content lead. Every Reel arrives with a script, voiceover, b-roll, on-screen text and caption already prepared. Your job is to turn those pieces, plus footage from our creators, into Reels that feel real, polished and made for Instagram.

What you’ll do

Edit about 65 Reels a month across 3 brands: around 25 hero Reels and 40 shorter variants (new hooks, shorter cuts, recuts of top performers).

Cut creator footage for pacing and watch time, add on-screen text, music and sound design, and color-correct so each brand looks consistent.

Deliver every Reel in 9:16, under the length set in the brief, with the hook landing in the first 2 seconds.

Sort and log raw footage from our creators so it can be found and reused.

Turn around feedback within 48 hours and keep a simple tracker of what’s in progress.

Follow each brand’s rules exactly: no competitor products in frame, no disposable cups, products shown at true size, and approved wording only.

Requirements

At least 2 years editing short-form vertical video for brands, with Reels or TikToks you can show and their view counts.

Fluent in CapCut and/or Premiere Pro (After Effects is a plus).

A strong sense of taste: calm, natural and premium, not loud or gimmicky.

Clear written English and reliable communication on Slack.

Available for at least 2 hours of overlap with Tokyo time (UTC+9) on weekdays.

Reliable internet and a computer that can handle 4K footage.

Nice to have

Experience with wellness, beauty, grooming, fragrance or food content.

Basic motion graphics and caption animation.

You understand what makes a Reel get shared, not just watched.

Pay and schedule

Base: $750 to $900 USD a month, depending on experience, for about 25 hours a week

Bonus: $25 for every Reel that beats its brand’s average shares within 7 days

Schedule: Flexible hours, with 2 hours of overlap with Tokyo time on weekdays

Start: Paid trial first (below), then one month on a single brand at a prorated rate, then the full role

Growth: The role can grow to full time as we add a fourth brand

Paid trial

Shortlisted applicants edit 3 Reels from footage and scripts we provide, paid at $60 total. We judge the hook, pacing, polish and how closely you followed the brief.

How to apply

Start your application with the words “SHARE WORTHY” so we know you read this to the end.

Send links to 3 Reels or TikToks you edited for a brand, with their view counts.

In 2 or 3 sentences, tell us which of those 3 performed best and why you think it did.

Tell us your current hours, your weekday availability in Philippine time, and your expected monthly rate.

We reply to every applicant who follows the steps above.

title: Technical Operations Lead (Node.js + AI), Full-Time, US Agency
description:
Pay: $2,500 to $3,000 USD per month

ABOUT US

Scroll to Sold is a US agency that runs Instagram sales for businesses. We run Meta ads that bring in DMs, and our AI bots answer those DMs, qualify buyers and collect phone numbers. Our clients sell high-ticket products like custom jewelry.

Our bots are all custom code we wrote ourselves: Node.js, Claude, and direct API connections to Instagram and Meta. We don't use ManyChat, GoHighLevel or any chatbot builder.



THE JOB

You run delivery for our clients day to day, so the founder can focus on sales. About half your week is client operations and half is code.

Operations:

- Onboard new clients and set up their bots.

- Launch and check Meta ad campaigns using our written rules. Report weekly.

- Script ads from client footage.

- Keep follow-up sequences running.

Code:

- Fix and improve our Instagram DM bots (Node.js, Claude API, Instagram and Meta APIs). Find a bad reply, write a failing test, fix it, open a pull request.

- Anything you do twice, you automate.

You will use Claude Code every day.



NOT A FIT

- Not a fit if you mainly build with no-code tools or chatbot builders.

- Not a fit if you only want to code and don't want client work.



MUST HAVE

- You write JavaScript or Node.js. Real code, not only no-code tools.

- You have built something in code with an AI API (Claude or OpenAI).

- You have run client work end to end: deadlines, reporting, keeping things organized.

- Strong written English.

- Reliable internet and backup power.



NICE TO HAVE

- Meta Ads Manager experience.

- Instagram or Messenger API experience.

- Git and GitHub.

- SQL databases, Render or similar hosting.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the word BOT. Missing any step = deleted, no reply.

1. A 2-minute video (Loom is fine): your face, your screen showing code you wrote, and one bug you fixed. Add a GitHub link if you have one.

2. One client project you ran from start to finish, in 2 to 3 sentences.

function quote(product, qty) {

  const prices = { gold: 800, silver: 400 };

  const price = prices[product] || prices.gold;

  return "That's $" + price * qty;

}



What's wrong, and how would you fix it? 2 to 3 sentences, in your own words.

4. Confirm you can work Tuesday to Saturday, 6 AM to 3 PM Manila time.



Process: 20-minute video call, then a short paid test task (about 5 hours, $100), then a 2-week paid trial ($1,000). If the trial goes well, you move to the full monthly rate. Raises based on results.
