title: Interiors Content Writer & Canva Designer: Blog, Instagram & Newsletter
description:
About the role



A small interior design company in New Zealand is looking for a talented writer and designer to prepare its monthly content.



This is a creation role only. You'll write the content and design it in Canva, then send us upload-ready files. We handle all publishing, so you won't need access to accounts.



The monthly package



Each month there are two topics. Here's everything you deliver in a month:



Topic 1

• 1 blog (300-500 words), written to rank in Google

• 1 Instagram carousel (up to 5 slides, with caption) on the same topic, pointing people to the blog



Topic 2

• 1 blog (300-500 words), written to rank in Google

• 1 Instagram carousel (up to 5 slides, with caption) on the same topic, pointing people to the blog



Flexible Instagram content

• 2 more Instagram carousels (up to 5 slides each, with captions), which may follow the month's topics or cover something different

• Some months, these 2 carousels may be swapped for 4 single-image posts instead



Newsletter

• 1 newsletter (300-400 words) summarising both topics and linking back to each blog



Monthly total: 2 blogs, 4 carousels (or 2 carousels and 4 single posts) and 1 newsletter. Each piece includes relevant images; more on imagery below.



Because each blog and its carousel come from one topic, you only need to research it once. The skill we're looking for is keeping one voice consistent across every format, while adapting the wording naturally to each.



Topics are interiors-related and will be provided, and you're welcome to suggest your own.



Pay



• US$55 monthly retainer for the monthly package.

• Paid within 3 days of final approval, via Wise or PayPal.

• Over time, if all is going well, there is potential for the package and the retainer to grow together.



Imagery



Sourcing beautiful, on-brand images is a big part of this role.



• Use Canva's library or reputable free stock sites, and list the source for each image.

• Never use Google Images, Pinterest or other designers' work.

• Brand or supplier images are used only with our approval, and we'll arrange the permission.



SEO



Each blog needs basic SEO: a meta title and description, a clear heading structure, image alt text and internal links. We provide a target keyword for each topic and a full brief once you're selected.



What you'll deliver



• Carousels and single posts: designed in your own Canva Pro account and exported as upload-ready image files, with captions supplied in a Google Doc.

• Blogs and newsletter: text in a Google Doc, ready to copy and paste, with headings and SEO details clearly marked. Blog images are sent as separate files.



Your own work



We're hiring you for your writing and eye, so all work should be yours: not copied or reworded from someone else's article, and not done by anyone else. Research facts and information as needed, but the writing and design should be your own. AI is fine for research and for checking spelling and grammar, just not for writing or rewriting the content.



You'll need



• Canva Pro (required once hired)

• Fluent written English

• A good eye for composition and a sophisticated, classy aesthetic

• Knowledge of mid-range to high-end interiors, and comfort researching for the New Zealand market

• A basic understanding of SEO writing

• Experience creating AI-generated imagery is a plus



Tone



Friendly, approachable, professional, like a relaxed design columnist.



Timeline and revisions



• Monthly work is due within 2 weeks of the brief. We'll send feedback within 5 days, and revisions are due within one week of feedback.

• Each piece includes one round of revisions. Corrections for factual errors or missed brief points are always included, and anything larger is discussed first.

• New Zealand is about 5 hours ahead of the Philippines, so please allow for this.



How to apply



Please include "Content Writer 26" in your subject line for our records, then send:



1.  Samples of your work. For example, an Instagram post or carousel, a blog on interiors, design or lifestyle, or a short video. A file, a link or a Google Drive link is fine.

2.  A trial piece. Write one blog of 300-500 words and design its matching Instagram carousel of up to 5 slides, on an interiors topic of your choice.

   ◦ Send the blog as a Google Doc and the carousel as exported images.

   ◦ Free Canva and free stock imagery are fine for the trial. List the source for each image.

   ◦ If you're hired, you'll be paid for this trial (US$18), and it counts toward your first month.

3.  A few lines about your content experience.



Applications without samples and a trial piece won't be considered.



The selection process



1.  Application: we review your samples and trial piece.

2.  Short video call: shortlisted applicants are invited to a short 10-15 minute call.

3.  Hire: we start with the monthly package. The first two months are a settling-in period, with a quick check-in at the end to make sure it's working well for both of us. From there, the work grows as it develops.



We look forward to seeing your work!

title: Creator & Advocate Outreach Coordinator — Research, Relationships & Follow-Up
description:
MenoPantry is a growing US food and wellness brand helping women nourish themselves through perimenopause, menopause, and beyond. We are building an advocate program based on credible relationships—not mass spam or generic influencer lists.



We are looking for a thoughtful, highly organized part-time coordinator who can find promising creators and community partners, research them carefully, prepare personalized outreach, maintain follow-ups, and keep every relationship accurately tracked.



This role starts at approximately 10 hours per week with a 30-day paid trial and long-term potential.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



• Find well-matched creators on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, podcasts, newsletters, blogs, and affiliate networks.

• Research offline partners such as dietitians, med spas, yoga and Pilates studios, wellness practices, independent retailers, and women-owned businesses. Oregon and Washington are initial priority markets.

• Evaluate audience fit, content quality, engagement, credibility, brand safety, location, contact information, and potential partnership angle.

• Add qualified prospects to a shared tracker with concise research notes and a recommended next action.

• Prepare personalized outreach from approved templates; avoid generic copy-and-paste messages.

• Send approved routine outreach and follow-ups after the initial training and review period.

• Monitor a dedicated partnerships inbox and social messages, draft replies, and flag conversations requiring the founder's decision.

• Track each relationship from identified to contacted, replied, product offered, product shipped, content posted, affiliate activated, declined, or follow-up due.

• Coordinate approved sample shipments and gather shipping details without promising payment, product, commissions, or commercial terms.

• Provide a short weekly report covering outreach volume, replies, interested prospects, product requests, follow-ups due, and emerging insights.



THE PARTNERS WE WANT



Our best partners are credible, warm, audience-connected people and organizations serving women in midlife. Relevant areas include menopause and perimenopause, plant-based nutrition, registered dietitians, healthy aging, strength after 40, metabolic health, vegan food, realistic wellness, and community-based women's health.



We are not looking for coupon sites, generic deal accounts, fake-engagement profiles, mass affiliate networks, or creators who make irresponsible health claims.



YOU MAY BE A STRONG FIT IF YOU HAVE



• Excellent written English with a natural, friendly, professional voice.

• Experience with influencer, creator, affiliate, UGC, partnership, PR, lead-generation, or community outreach.

• Strong judgment about whether a creator and her audience genuinely fit a brand.

• Confidence researching people and businesses beyond follower count.

• Experience with Google Sheets, Airtable, Notion, or another CRM/tracking system.

• Familiarity with Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, podcasts, and
 research.

• Exceptional attention to detail and consistent follow-through.

• The judgment to follow approved procedures while escalating negotiations, sensitive questions, health claims, fees, contracts, and unusual requests.



Experience with Shopify, 
, consumer wellness, food, women's health, or subscription e-commerce is helpful but not required.



HOW SUCCESS WILL BE MEASURED



• Qualified prospects added—not merely names collected.

• Personalized outreach completed accurately and consistently.

• Reply, product-acceptance, content-posting, affiliate-activation, and sales rates.

• Follow-ups completed on schedule.

• Tracker accuracy and completeness.

• Quality of judgment, writing, and escalation.

• Relationships developed without harming trust or brand reputation.



HOW TO APPLY



Begin your application with the words NOURISH MIDLIFE so we know you read the full description.



Please include:



1. A short introduction and your relevant creator, partnership, research, or outreach experience.

2. One example of a creator or partnership program you supported and your specific responsibilities.

3. The tools you have used to manage outreach and follow-ups.

4. Your hourly rate, weekly availability, time zone, and available hours in US Eastern Time.

5. A link to one creator you believe could be a good fit for MenoPantry, plus two sentences explaining why. Please do not contact the creator.

6. A brief answer: if 30 prospects are waiting on different next steps, how would you ensure nobody falls through the cracks?



Shortlisted candidates will receive a paid, fictional research exercise. Do not contact real prospects as part of the application.
salary: $8–$12 USD per hour, based on experience

title: Remote Recruiter
description:
We are looking for an experienced and results-driven US Light Industrial Recruiter to join our growing recruitment team. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience recruiting for warehouse, manufacturing, logistics, production, and general labor positions within the US market. This role requires strong candidate sourcing, screening, communication, and high-volume recruitment skills.





KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Source, screen, and recruit candidates for light industrial and general labor positions across the US.



• Recruit for roles such as warehouse associates, pickers/packers, production staff, forklift operators, material handlers, and other similar positions.

 

• Conduct initial candidate interviews and evaluate qualifications, experience, and availability.



• Manage high-volume recruitment while meeting hiring targets and deadlines.



• Coordinate interviews, onboarding requirements, and candidate follow-ups.



• Maintain accurate candidate records and recruitment pipelines using ATS and job boards.

Build and maintain a strong pool of qualified candidates for current and future openings.







QUALIFICATIONS



• Proven experience in US staffing and light industrial recruitment.

• Familiarity with US job boards such as Indeed, ZipRecruiter, and CareerBuilder.

• Experience using Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS).

• Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal.

• Ability to handle high-volume recruitment and multiple job openings simultaneously.

• Highly organized, proactive, and results-oriented.

• Willingness to work during US business hours.



Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience working with a US staffing agency.

• Experience recruiting for warehouse, manufacturing, logistics, or general labor positions is a PLUS.

• Familiarity with recruitment metrics, candidate pipelines, and placement targets.





*** IMPORTANT: STRICT APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS ***



Attention to detail and the ability to follow instructions are essential requirements for this position. All applicants must strictly follow the instructions below.



1.
 Subject: Use the exact job title "Recruiter" as your subject line.

2. Cover Letter: Include a professional cover letter highlighting your relevant experience and qualifications.

3. Updated Resume: Attach your most recent resume.

4.
 Address: Make sure to include your active
 address in your application so our recruitment team can contact you.



**STRICT POLICY:** 

Applications that do not follow ALL instructions, have incomplete requirements, or use an incorrect subject line will be automatically disqualified without further review.



**Following instructions is part of our initial screening process.**

title: Freelance Online Launch Planning VA - Google Sheet & Asana Setup
description:
**Freelance Launch Planning VA — Timelines, Milestones & Asana Setup**



I run an established therapeutic yoga education business offering online programs and professional training.



We have multiple launches planned between now and March 2027, with some running at the same time for different segments of our
 database.



I’m looking for an experienced freelance VA with launch planning and Google Sheet and Asana experience to turn our calendar detailed implementation plan.



**The role**



Your role is to map out each launch’s tasks, timelines, milestones, dependencies, and staffing needs.



The plan needs to show how the launches overlap, which database segments each launch serves, and where they require the same team members or resources.



This initial project is focused on building the plan. 



**What I will provide**



I will provide recordings walking you through our launches, what needs to happen, and how the different pieces connect, along with our launch calendar and existing materials.



You will extract and organize that information, identify missing steps, and bring me focused questions where clarification is needed.



**What needs to be mapped**



For each launch, map the work and deadlines for:



- **Social media:** what needs to be created, edited, approved, scheduled, and published—and when.

- **Paid advertising:** copy, creative, landing pages, tracking, campaign setup, approval, testing, and activation.

- *
:** launch
s, audience segments, welcome
s, and automations.

- **Website pages:** home pages, sales pages, registration pages, checkout, thank-you pages, and welcome pages.

- **Upsells and downsells:** required copy, pages, technical setup, and customer journeys.

- **Customer tracking:** how people enter the business, what they sign up for or purchase, and how they are tagged or segmented.

- **Technical setup:** products, payments, integrations, purchase confirmations, and classroom access.

- **Classroom and onboarding:** classroom structure, content uploads, welcome information, participant forms, and program instructions.

- **Testing:** links, checkout,
s, automations, tracking, and classroom access before launch.



You will map who needs to do this work and when. Creating the content, building the pages, and implementing the technical systems are separate responsibilities.



**What you will deliver**



**1. A master timeline through March 2027**



A clear overview of all launches, their audience segments, key dates, production deadlines, and overlapping work.



**2. A detailed plan for each launch that is outlined on Google Sheets that when confirmed you can input into Asana**



Each plan should include:



- Specific tasks and deliverables.

- Assigned owners where confirmed, or the role required where someone still needs to be hired.

- Start dates and due dates.

- Dependencies—what must be completed before another task can begin.

- Milestones for copy, content, design, build, approval, testing, and launch readiness.

- Links to relevant recordings, materials, and existing instructions.



**3. A timeline for shared projects**



Map website updates, customer tracking, automations, and classroom work that supports more than one launch. Show when these need to be completed for the launches that depend on them.



**4. A staffing and hiring plan**



Identify:



- The work our existing team is expected to cover, subject to confirmation.

- Responsibilities that do not yet have an owner.

- The skills or contractors needed.

- When each person needs to begin.

- When hiring needs to start to allow time for selection, onboarding, and production.



**5. A list of gaps and timeline conflicts**



Flag missing information, decisions, assets, overlapping demands on team members, and deadlines that may be unrealistic.



Where segments overlap, flag any audience or
-scheduling decisions that need to be made.



**6. A completed handover**



Provide a recorded walkthrough explaining how the Asana plan is organized, what remains unresolved, and what the person managing execution needs to know.



**How the project will work**



You will review the recordings and materials, then map one launch first so we can confirm the level of detail before you build out the rest.



Work backwards from the launch dates, allowing time for creation, review, revisions, technical setup, and testing.



Identify the nearest deadlines and urgent hiring needs early.



I will provide business direction and approvals. I need you to turn that direction into a practical plan and recognize where information is missing.



**Project milestones**



1. Review the materials and confirm the launch list, audience segments, key dates, and missing information.

2. Complete one detailed launch plan for review.

3. Map the remaining launches, shared projects, and staffing requirements.

4. Complete the Google Sheet and Asana setup, review the full plan with me, make agreed revisions, and hand it over.



**Experience required**



- Experience mapping launches for online courses, education businesses, memberships, or similar offers.

- Strong practical experience setting up detailed projects in Google Sheets and Asana.

- An understanding of how content, sales pages,
, advertising, checkout, and course delivery connect.

- The ability to turn recordings and unstructured instructions into clear tasks and timelines.

- Experience planning overlapping projects with shared resources.

- Attention to audience segmentation and separate
 schedules.

- Clear communication and confidence identifying missing steps or unrealistic deadlines.



**Project terms**



This is a freelance planning, Google Sheet output Asana setup project.



My proposed completion window is two weeks from the start date, subject to agreeing on the scope. 



Ongoing project management, team follow-up, and implementation are outside this initial scope.



**To apply, please include**



1. An example of a launch timeline  with Google Sheet and Asana plan you personally created. Redacted examples are welcome.

2. Your specific responsibilities on that project.

3. An example of turning recordings or unstructured instructions into a detailed project plan.

4. The information you would need from me to begin.

5. How you would map overlapping launches for different segments of an
 database.



Please also answer this question:



**Two launches are happening in the same month for different database segments. They need the same copywriter and website builder, but some offer details are still missing. How would you map the work, dependencies, and deadlines, and what would you flag for me?**

title: Inventory Forecasting Manager
description:
About the role

Amplify AMZ is an Amazon agency that helps brands scale. We manage many client seller accounts, and when inventory runs out, our clients lose sales and rank. We're hiring an Inventory Forecasting Manager to own demand forecasting and replenishment across every brand we manage, so stock-outs stop costing our clients money.

This is a full-time, remote contractor role, based overseas. You'll report directly to the CEO and work closely with our brand owners.



What you'll do

• Build and maintain demand forecasts for every client brand and ASIN, adjusting for seasonality, promotions, ad spend changes, and launches

• Run weekly replenishment reviews and tell brand owners exactly what to order, how much, and when

• Account for supplier lead times, shipping time to Amazon, and FBA inbound limits so stock arrives before it runs out

• Spot stock-out and overstock risk early, and flag it with a clear recommended action

• Create and track replenishment tasks in 
 and follow them through to shipment

• Report monthly on stock-out days, lost sales, and forecast accuracy by brand

• Improve our forecasting process and templates so they scale as we add clients



To filter out the guys who just mass apply to jobs, To apply: Include the phrase “Zero Stockouts” in the first line of your message to me or application. Applications without it won’t be reviewed.



What we're looking for

Required

• 3+ years in Amazon inventory planning, supply chain, or demand forecasting, ideally at an agency or multi-brand seller

• Hands-on experience with FBA replenishment, the Restock Inventory report, and inbound shipment creation

• Strong Google Sheets or Excel skills (lookups, pivots, forecasting formulas)

• Clear written English and the ability to push back with data when a brand owner or client disagrees

• Detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable owning a process with little supervision



Nice to have

• Experience managing multiple seller accounts at once

• Familiarity with Jungle Scout, MerchantSpring, or similar analytics tools

• Experience coordinating with overseas suppliers and freight forwarders

• Experience with 
 or similar project management tools

title: Marketing & Social Media Manager
description:

ABOUT THE ROLE

You’ll develop ideas, write captions, design graphics, edit short-form videos, and publish content that helps business owners understand our services. You should understand how content supports marketing goals, builds trust, and encourages potential clients to reach out.



RESPONSIBILITIES

• Plan and maintain a content calendar aligned with our brand and target audience.  

• Create social media graphics, carousels, short-form videos, and other visual content.  

• Write clear, engaging captions, video scripts, and promotional content.  

• Turn our services, client feedback, and team insights into useful content.  

• Repurpose existing materials into fresh posts across different platforms.  

• Schedule and publish posts, maintain consistent branding, and respond to relevant comments and inquiries.  

• Track content performance and use the results to improve future posts.  

• Coordinate with our team to gather ideas, updates, and materials for content creation.

title: Senior Restoration Estimator — Xactimate | U.S. Water Mitigation & Reconstruction
description:
SENIOR RESTORATION ESTIMATOR - XACTIMATE | U.S. WATER MITIGATION & RECONSTRUCTION

FloodCo USA (RBS NJ Inc.) | Full-time | Remote - Philippines

Recruitment account: Paul Williams ASC. Apply directly on OnlineJobs.ph.



We are hiring a senior estimator with a proven record preparing estimates for U.S. restoration and mitigation work. Direct U.S. industry experience is essential. We value demonstrated estimating ability and real project results over degrees, extra credentials, or a low salary request.



POSITION DETAILS

- Location: Remote, Philippines.

- Schedule: Monday through Friday, 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time, with a one-hour lunch break. The schedule follows U.S. daylight-saving changes. In Philippine Time this is 7:00 PM to 4:00 AM while the U.S. is on daylight time (mid-March to early November) and 8:00 PM to 5:00 AM while the U.S. is on standard time (early November to mid-March).

- Compensation: $1,500-$2,000 USD per month, based on verified experience and demonstrated ability.

- Reports to: Company leadership.

- Work arrangement: Full-time and exclusive to the company during scheduled work hours.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Prepare accurate, well-supported scopes and estimates for U.S. water mitigation, structural drying, mold remediation, demolition, and reconstruction projects.

- Build and revise estimates in Xactimate using the correct U.S. regional price list, documented quantities, labor, equipment, materials, and project conditions.

- Review inspection notes, photographs, moisture records, floor plans, measurements, work logs, invoices, and other job documentation before estimating.

- Prepare clear itemized estimates, change estimates, supplements, and supporting explanations when the documented scope changes or an estimate is reviewed.

- Identify missing information, unsupported assumptions, scope gaps, and pricing issues before an estimate is submitted.

- Coordinate with field staff, project managers, and office staff to resolve estimating questions and obtain complete job documentation.

- Maintain organized job files and status updates in Luxor CRM; use Microsoft Teams for internal coordination, Dialpad when calls are needed, and QuickBooks Online for relevant job-cost or billing documentation.

- Meet agreed turnaround times and keep management informed about workload, deadlines, and estimating issues.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

- Extensive, verifiable experience preparing estimates for actual U.S. restoration or mitigation projects. This is a core requirement.

- Advanced proficiency in Xactimate.

- Experience selecting and applying appropriate U.S. regional price lists.

- Direct experience estimating U.S. water mitigation and structural drying.

- Ability to interpret field documentation, measurements, moisture readings, equipment usage, photographs, and project conditions.

- Ability to prepare defensible, itemized estimates and supplements.

- Excellent written and spoken English, including the ability to explain estimating choices clearly and professionally.

- A reliable computer, high-speed internet, quiet workspace, and dependable backup plan for power or connectivity interruptions.

- Ability to work the stated Eastern Time schedule, attend Teams meetings with camera on when requested, and communicate promptly during the workday.



STRONGLY PREFERRED

- Five or more years of restoration estimating experience, including substantial U.S. project work.

- Employment with a U.S. restoration or mitigation company, including prior remote work.

- Mold remediation and reconstruction estimating.

- Experience preparing estimates for emergency mitigation and reconstruction, including demolition, drying equipment, labor, materials, and subcontractor scopes.

- Working knowledge of IICRC S500 and S520 standards and how they relate to documented restoration scopes.

- Experience with Symbility or other U.S. property-claims estimating workflows in addition to Xactimate.

- Experience identifying unsupported scope items and resolving documentation discrepancies.

- Relevant technical education or certifications. These are useful but do not replace hands-on U.S. restoration estimating experience.



PLEASE NOTE

General construction estimators, insurance customer service representatives, claims processors, and virtual assistants will not be considered qualified unless they can demonstrate hands-on experience preparing estimates for U.S. restoration or mitigation projects.



IMPORTANT ROLE BOUNDARY

This role prepares estimates, scopes, supplements, and job documentation for the company and its customers. It does not authorize the estimator to negotiate claims with insurance carriers, act as a public adjuster, determine coverage, or make settlement decisions.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply directly on OnlineJobs.ph. We will focus on the work you have personally completed. Your initial application should include:



A. Verifiable work history: names of U.S. restoration or mitigation employers, dates of employment, positions held, types of projects estimated, and whether the work was remote.



B. Answers to the questions below. Please give specific, factual answers (company names, dates, numbers, loss types, price lists) rather than general statements.

1. How many years have you personally used Xactimate for U.S. restoration or mitigation estimating?

2. Which U.S. restoration companies have you worked for, and during what dates?

3. Approximately how many U.S. restoration estimates have you personally prepared in the past 12 months?

4. What percentage of your estimating experience involves water mitigation, structural drying, mold remediation, and reconstruction?

5. Which U.S. regional Xactimate price lists have you used?

6. Describe one estimate or supplement where you identified missing documentation, unsupported quantities, or an incorrect scope. What did you do?

7. Have you prepared mitigation estimates using drying logs, moisture readings, equipment logs, and field photographs? Give a specific example.

8. Have you independently handled estimate revisions or supplements? Explain your responsibility and approval process.

9. Can you work Monday-Friday, 7:00 AM-4:00 PM Eastern Time, accounting for U.S. daylight-saving changes?

10. What is your expected monthly compensation in USD, and when could you start?



LATER STAGES (NOT NEEDED WITH YOUR INITIAL APPLICATION)

Work samples (requested from qualified candidates at the next screening stage): three redacted Xactimate estimates you personally prepared. Remove customer names, property addresses, claim numbers, personal information, and confidential client or employer information. For each sample, identify the type of loss, the U.S. region or price list used, and your personal role in preparing the estimate. Do not disclose confidential information or violate any former employer agreement. If sharing an actual estimate is not permitted, you may submit a reconstructed or independently created sample, clearly labeled as such; it will be distinguished from verified past work. If you cannot attach files in OnlineJobs.ph messages, you may share them through a link (for example, Google Drive) with access restricted and all files redacted as described above.



Professional references (requested from shortlisted candidates before final selection): two professional references, preferably from U.S. restoration supervisors, owners, or project leaders who can verify your actual estimating work.



NEXT STEPS

Our selection process has four stages:

1. Application: your work history and answers to the questions above.

2. Work samples: qualified candidates will be asked for three redacted Xactimate estimates.

3. Practical exercise: finalists will complete a supervised practical estimating exercise using a sample loss file. The company will assess accuracy, completeness, documentation, judgment, and communication. Authorized software access will be arranged for the practical assessment.

4. References: shortlisted candidates will be asked for two professional references before final selection.

Claims of experience will be checked against work samples and references.



Applications that do not show direct U.S. restoration estimating experience will not advance to the practical exercise.

description:
Remote | US hours overlap | Long-term role



This is a really great creative opportunity to grow with one of the top restaurant brands in the US. We are looking for the best creatives: people whose food content makes people stop, crave, and show up hungry. The founder is investing in social media properly: a real content calendar, consistent short-form video, and a long-term seat for the person who wants to own this brand's social presence, not just cut clips.



THE WORK

You will be the content engine for a leading US restaurant and tavern brand. Food is the product: the dishes, the drinks, the kitchen, the dining room, the people. Your job is to make people hungry, make the room look alive, and build a social presence that grows with the business.

You will work from a shared content calendar, edit short-form video from raw footage, create trial reel variations to test what performs, and bring ideas every week: menu features, seasonal specials, events, and the moments only a restaurant can capture.



WHO THIS IS FOR

You are already someone who:

- HAS FOOD AND RESTAURANT EXPERIENCE. You have created or edited content for a restaurant, cafe, bar, food brand, or hospitality business, and you can prove it. This is the headline requirement for this role

- Edits strong short-form video (CapCut Pro, Premiere Pro, or similar): hooks in the first 3 seconds, tight pacing, clean captions, trending audio

- Understands food content: close-ups, movement, sound, and what makes a dish stop the scroll

- Can run a content calendar without daily hand-holding: filming days, editing queue, posting schedule

- Is reliable and communicative: flags problems early and hits deadlines without being chased

- Is available for US hours overlap

Bonus: posting and scheduling experience, community replies in a brand voice, basic design in Canva.



This is not for you if

- You have never worked with food, restaurant, or hospitality content

- Your portfolio is only talking-head, corporate, or wedding work

- You need shot-by-shot instructions for every edit



THE STANDARD

Warm, craveable, and premium. Food that looks as good as it tastes. Every edit feels like the room on its best night: energy, detail, and pride in the plate. Sloppy captions, wrong dish names, or cheap-looking cuts never ship.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Edit short-form Reels and TikToks from raw footage: dishes, drinks, kitchen and dining room moments, events

- Build hooks in the first 1 to 3 seconds and create trial variations to test what performs

- Run the content calendar: know what is filming, what is editing, and what is posting each week

- Post and schedule approved content, with captions in the brand voice

- Check captions for accuracy: dish names, specials, dates, and prices

- Keep footage, drafts, and finished videos organised in shared folders

- Bring ideas weekly: menu features, seasonal specials, and trends that fit a restaurant brand

- Use performance data to pitch stronger hooks, angles, and formats



WHY THIS ROLE

- A really great creative opportunity with a top US restaurant brand: real creative ownership, your ideas on screen, not just your edits

- One brand, long-term: you build the look, the rhythm, and the audience, and you see your work perform

- Training, templates, and a clear content system provided

- A founder who is investing in social properly and wants this seat filled for the long run



HOURS AND PAY

Full time, 40 hours per week, US hours overlap

Long-term role

s or DMs. Start your first answer with the word "Pink."

title: Operations and Planning Analyst
description:
About Proper Growth

Proper Growth is the back of house for inventory-heavy consumer brands doing $5M to $50M a

year. We're a small fractional COO and CFO team running operations and finance for brands

that sell physical products across DTC, Amazon and wholesale.



The role

You'll be the link between our client brands' supply chains and our ops lead. Factories, freight

forwarders, 3PLs and warehouses come to you. You keep every PO, shipment and production

run moving, and you turn it all into the weekly reports and decks our clients rely on. You'll own

all vendor communication and all weekly client materials, so our ops lead can focus on planning

and decisions.



What you'll do

● Vendor communication: Own day-to-day communication with factories, suppliers, freight

forwarders, 3PLs and warehouses across all client brands. Confirm pricing, quantities,

ship dates and specs, and chase anything late.

● Liaison across the supply chain: Keep production, logistics, warehouse and our ops

lead in sync. Get every PO from placement through production, shipping, receiving and

stock on shelf.

● Daily summaries: Turn overnight WeChat, WhatsApp and
 threads into a short

morning summary covering what changed, what's at risk and what needs a decision.

● Weekly client materials: Build and deliver each brand's weekly package: sell-through vs.

forecast, inventory position, open POs and WIP, inbound shipments.

● Deck support: Prepare client decks for weekly calls, monthly closeouts and buy reviews.

● Data hygiene: Keep PO trackers, inventory files and planning sheets current. Reconcile

packing lists, invoices and warehouse receiving reports.



What you need

● 1 to 3+ years in supply chain, production, purchasing or operations coordination.

Consumer goods or apparel preferred.

● Experience working with overseas factories or vendors, and comfort chasing them for

answers.

● Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills. Google Slides or PowerPoint for client-ready decks.

● Clear, organized written communication. You can turn a messy vendor thread into three

lines a founder can act on.

● Strong attention to detail across many POs, SKUs and brands at once.

● Availability for some early-morning or evening overlap with Asian vendors.



Nice to have

● Experience with Shopify, ShipHero, NetSuite, Cin7 or similar

● Familiarity with freight terms, customs and landed cost

● Mandarin or Spanish

● Experience using AI tools to draft summaries and reports



How it works

● Start: Contract to start, then full-time once the workload is proven.

● Who you work with: You'll support the Client Operations Manager and our co-founder

across about 8 to 12 client brands.



How to apply

Fill out the application form and include a 45-second video walking us through how you'd track

10 open POs across 3 factories.

title: Claims Specialist – Behavioral Health
description:
Job Summary 



The Claims Specialist is responsible for managing the full lifecycle of behavioral health insurance claims, including claim submission, payment posting, denial resolution, and appeals. This role ensures claims are processed accurately and timely in accordance with insurance payer guidelines, billing regulations, and organizational policies. The Claims Specialist works closely with insurance companies, providers, and internal billing teams to resolve claim discrepancies, reduce denials, maximize reimbursement, and maintain compliance with applicable healthcare billing requirements. 



 



Key Responsibilities 



* Claims processing, denial management 



* Review, prepare, submit, and follow up on behavioral health claims to commercial insurance, Medicaid, Medicare, and other third-party payers, as applicable. 



* Investigate and resolve claim denials, rejections, underpayments, and payment discrepancies. 



* Research eligibility, benefits, authorization requirements, and payer-specific billing guidelines. 



* Prepare and submit corrected claims, reconsiderations, and appeals with appropriate supporting documentation. 



* Monitor outstanding accounts receivable and follow up with payers to ensure timely reimbursement. 



* Verify billing accuracy, including CPT/HCPCS codes, diagnosis codes, modifiers, units, and dates of service. 



* Communicate with insurance representatives, clinical staff, and internal departments to resolve billing issues. 



* Maintain accurate claim records, document follow-up activities, and track claim resolution outcomes. 



* Identify recurring denial trends and recommend process improvements to increase clean claim rates and reduce aging accounts receivable. 



* Maintain confidentiality of protected health information (PHI) and adhere to HIPAA requirements and applicable payer and regulatory guidelines. 



 



Collaboration & Reporting 



* Work closely with billing and collections teams to ensure efficient revenue cycle operations.  



* Maintain accurate, up-to-date financial records and documentation.  



* Prepare and submit daily, weekly, and monthly reports to management.  



Account Management 



* Assist with month-end closing activities and account reconciliations.  



* Ensure compliance with billing regulations and internal policies.  



* Stay current on industry standards, payer requirements, and best practices.  



 



Qualifications 



* Education & Experience 



* High school diploma or equivalent (required).  



* Certification in medical billing or healthcare finance (preferred).  



* 1–2 years of experience in payment posting, medical billing, or a related healthcare finance role. Preferably behavioral health. 



* Knowledge of insurance payer requirements, behavioral health billing practices, and claim denial management. 



* Familiarity with electronic health records (EHRs), practice management systems, and electronic claims platforms. 



* Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills. 



* Ability to manage multiple claims, meet productivity goals, and maintain accuracy in a fast-paced environment. 



* Understanding of HIPAA privacy and security requirements. 



 



Technical Skills 



* Medical Claims Processing: Electronic claim submission, claim scrubbing, claim corrections, and resubmissions. 



* Claims Denial Management: Denial analysis, rejection resolution, appeals, reconsiderations, and root-cause analysis. 



* Insurance Billing: Commercial insurance, Medicaid, Medicare, managed care, and third-party payer billing. 



* Behavioral Health Billing: Knowledge of outpatient mental health, substance use disorder, psychotherapy, and psychiatric service billing. 



* Medical Coding: Familiarity with CPT, HCPCS, ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes, and billing modifiers. 



* Revenue Cycle Management (RCM): Accounts receivable (A/R) follow-up, aging reports, reimbursement tracking, and revenue recovery. 



* Insurance Verification: Patient eligibility, benefit verification, authorization requirements, and referral management. 



* Payer Portals: Online claim status inquiries, payment research, eligibility verification, and authorization tracking. 



* Electronic Data Interchange (EDI): Electronic claim transactions, claim acknowledgments, and remittance advice processing. 



* HIPAA Compliance: Protected health information (PHI) handling, privacy standards, and secure electronic records management. 



* Billing Software and EHR Systems: Experience with electronic health records (EHR), practice management systems, and medical billing platforms. Lightning Step, Availity,  



* Payment and Remittance Processing: Electronic remittance advice (ERA), explanation of benefits (EOB) review, payment reconciliation, and underpayment identification. 



* Reporting and Data Analysis: A/R aging reports, denial trend analysis, productivity tracking, and claims performance metrics. 



* Microsoft Excel: Data entry, sorting and filtering, formulas, spreadsheets, and reconciliation reports. 



* Documentation and Record Management: Maintaining accurate claim notes, appeal documentation, audit trails, and payer correspondence 



 



Soft Skills 



* Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.  



* Strong organizational and time management skills.  



* Ability to work independently in a remote environment.  



* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.  



* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced setting.  



 



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 



The following KPIs will be used to evaluate performance in this role: 



* Maintain greater than 98% clean claims rate in submissions and resubmissions 



* 95% of claims must be resubmitted within 72 hours 



* Maintain less than a 3% rejection rate 



* First pass rate must be greater than 98% 



 



 



Compensation & Benefits 



* Competitive hourly pay based on experience ($8-$9/hour).  



* Opportunity for permanent employment based on performance.  



* Flexible remote work environment.  



* Paid training and onboarding.  



* Access to mentorship from experienced billing professionals.  



 



Work Schedule 



* Full-time (40 hours per week).  



* Monday through Friday, 8-hour shifts within standard business hours.

title: Transaction Coordinator – Non-QM Mortgage (DSCR / Bank Statement / Investor Loans) | AI-Forward Team
description:
We're MV Corporate, a U.S.-based real estate, private lending, and investment company. We fund investor loans (DSCR, bank statement, bridge, fix-and-flip) and we run on an AI-powered team. We're hiring a Transaction Coordinator to keep every file moving from contract to clear-to-close. You'll be the person borrowers, brokers, lenders, and title companies count on for a straight answer.



WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT

We use AI tools every day for inbox triage, condition tracking, document review, and drafting. We are not looking for someone to retype checklists. We want someone who looks at a file, figures out what is actually missing, uses AI to move faster, and then picks up the phone to close the gap. A sharp coordinator who embraces AI will outperform a veteran who resists it.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own non-QM and investor loan files from submission through clear-to-close, handling several files each month

- Track conditions, deadlines, and contract milestones; know what's missing before anyone asks

- Call and
 borrowers, brokers, lenders, title/escrow, insurance, and appraisal contacts

- Review documents for completeness: spot missing pages, signature errors, and mismatched entity details before underwriting does

- Keep GoHighLevel and Google Drive accurate and current

- Use AI tools to draft updates, summarize documents, and automate repeat tasks

- Send a daily end-of-day update: done, pending, needs attention

- Flag at-risk files early, with a recommendation, not just a question



WHAT WE GIVE YOU

- AI tools and workflows already built for the work

- Full SOPs and video walkthroughs

- Your own CRM login and a company

- Training on how we do things, plus real autonomy. We care that files close.



WHAT WE NEED

- 2+ years of U.S. real estate experience, residential mainly

- Background in loan processing at a lending bank, a mortgage office or brokerage, or a real estate firm (bank-level processing experience is a big plus)

- Ability to process several loan files a month with accuracy and speed

- Working knowledge of non-QM, DSCR, or investor loans, and TRID/closing timelines

- Experience with an LOS and a CRM (GoHighLevel is a plus)

- Excellent spoken and written English; this role is on the phone with U.S. borrowers every day

- Comfort using AI tools, and the curiosity to keep learning them

- Organized, decisive, and thick-skinned; you follow up without reminders

- Reliable internet, backup power, and a quiet workspace

- Available during U.S. Central Time business hours



NICE TO HAVE

Entity-borrowing knowledge (LLCs, trusts), title/escrow coordination, private or hard money exposure.



AUTHORITY BOUNDARY

You coordinate and organize. You do not approve loans, quote terms, or give lending advice. Those decisions stay with leadership.



GROWTH

Strong performers move into full pipeline ownership and team-lead roles as we grow.



HOW TO APPLY (follow this exactly)

1. Start your message with the word TRACKER.

2. Tell us where you worked (lending bank, mortgage office, or real estate firm), your years of U.S. residential experience, and roughly how many loan files you process per month.

3. Describe a time you chased a missing condition or document to the finish. What did you do?

4. How do you use AI in your work today? Name the tool, the task, and what it saved you.

5. Include your resume link and a 60-second voice or video introduction.



Applications missing any of these will not be reviewed.

title: Social Media & Content Specialist: Short-Form Video Editor (Youth Soccer Club, USA, Long-Term)
description:
ABOUT US

Barcelona Premier Soccer Club (BPSC) is a youth soccer club in San Antonio, Texas, founded in 2016, with about 500 players across 5 locations. We teach the Spanish Tiki-Taka style of play. We're looking for a creative, fast and reliable video editor to run our
, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube Shorts accounts.



This is a long-term role. We want a steady, reliable person to join our team and grow with us for years, not a short-term freelancer.



SCHEDULE

- Full-time, 40 hours/week, Sunday to Thursday, 7:00 AM-4:00 PM Philippine time (includes a 1-hour break).

- This is a day shift in the Philippines, not a night shift. You'll be online during evenings in Texas, when our families are on social media.

- Days off: Friday and Saturday.



PAY

- $500 USD/month, paid once a month via Wise on the last business day of the month.

- After few months, we can set a performance bonus based on social media growth.

- 60-day trial period, with a pay review at 6 months based on performance.



WHAT WE OFFER

- A stable, long-term full-time position with a growing organization.

- Pay on time, every month.

- Clear guidelines, templates and a supportive team.

- Room to grow your skills and responsibilities as BPSC expands.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Edit 10-14 original short videos per week (Reels, TikToks, Shorts) in CapCut from footage our coaches upload daily. You'll ramp up to this during your first 60 days.

- Post every video on all 4 platforms, plus daily Stories: training clips, game scores, player spotlights, coach tips, holiday posts and event announcements (tryouts, camps, new locations).

- Design graphics in Canva using our templates (score graphics, announcements).

- Use AI tools to work faster and better: auto-captions, background removal, upscaling, B-roll, image enhancement.

- Reply to comments and DMs daily, and pass families asking about our programs to our team.

- Follow our monthly content plan and suggest trends and ideas to test.

- Update our weekly metrics tracker (Excel template provided) every Monday, and send a short monthly report.



REQUIREMENTS

- Looking for a long-term commitment: steady, reliable, and not juggling multiple full-time clients.

- 1+ years editing short-form video for brands or creators, with a portfolio of videos you edited yourself.

- Advanced CapCut skills: hooks, captions, fast cuts, transitions, trending formats.

- Ability to produce at volume without losing quality: templates, batch editing, organized workflow.

- Hands-on experience with AI tools for video and photo. Tell us which ones you use and how.

- Canva skills.

- Good written English. Spanish is a strong plus.

- A computer that can edit 1080p video smoothly, fiber internet, and a backup internet and power option.

- Reliable and organized: you post every day without being reminded.



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with sports, kids' programs or local businesses.

- Experience with Meta Business Suite, TikTok Studio or YouTube Studio analytics.

- Experience growing an account (show us the numbers).



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the words "BPSC GOAL" so we know you read this. Include:

1. Links to 3-5 short videos you edited.

2. One account you helped grow, with before/after numbers.

3. The AI tools you use for video and photo, with one example.

4. How many short videos you can edit per week, and your average time per video.

5. Your computer specs, internet speed, and backup internet/power.

6. Your longest time working with one client or employer, and why it ended.



Shortlisted candidates complete a paid trial task ($25): edit one Reel from our raw footage and create one score graphic.

title: Search Specialist
description:
We're Hiring: Search Specialist (Full-Time Virtual Assistant)

Company: Entrust Housing

Location: Based in San Francisco: Looking for Remote position.

Compensation: Competitive, based on experience

Schedule: Full-time | Must overlap partially with U.S. hours



Hi there!

Entrust Housing helps families who’ve experienced home disasters — like fires, floods, or storms — find temporary homes while their properties are being repaired. We work with insurance companies to quickly match families with available rental housing that fits their needs.



We’re looking for a Search Specialist VA who can take ownership of one of the most important parts of our process: finding suitable homes for displaced families.



Your Main Responsibilities:

Research and find available short-term rental properties that meet each client's needs (location, dates, budget, etc.).



Reach out to landlords and property managers to confirm availability and details.



Communicate clearly and professionally — both spoken and written — with our internal team and with property owners.



Organize search results in spreadsheets and track follow-ups.



Help support urgent and high-stress situations with a calm, solution-focused mindset.



What We’re Looking For:

Excellent English-speaking skills — confident, clear, and professional. This is a must. ** Please do not apply unless you are fluent and comfortable speaking in English **



Strong written English for messages, summaries, and documentation.



Fast and reliable online research skills — you know how to dig, verify, and filter.



A sense of urgency and ownership — you want to get it right and get it done.



Highly organized and reliable — you never leave loose ends.



A good listener who asks smart questions when something’s unclear.



Experience in US real estate, housing platforms, or property coordination.



Why This Role Matters:

This is not just a background task — it’s the heart of what we do. You’ll be the one who helps get families housed during a crisis. The properties you find literally determine the outcome of each case. We need someone who treats this with care, urgency, and pride.



If you are interested in this role, please send a Loom video introduction of yourself.
salary: Up to $2,500 USD per month plus bonus...

title: Real Estate Appointment Setter & Lead Conversion Specialist (Cold Caller)

-Make cold calls and follow up with buyer, seller, and rental leads.

-Proven real estate cold calling experience is mandatory. Miami market experience is a plus.

No beginners. No basic-training candidates. Strong English, speed, initiative, and real estate experience are non-negotiable.

title: Print Ad Designer / Graphic Designer | Work From Home | ₱150–₱250 Per Hour
description:
# Print Ad Designer / Graphic Designer | Work From Home | ₱150–₱250 Per Hour



We are looking for an experienced **Print Ad Designer / Graphic Designer** to join our growing team in a **100% work-from-home position**.



In this role, you will be responsible for creating **grocery store advertisements** using our client's proprietary design platform. The system features an easy-to-use drag-and-drop editor that allows you to create professional grocery ads by arranging product images, prices, promotional offers, and other design elements.



We will provide complete training on the platform, our workflow, and quality standards. However, applicants must already have graphic design experience, including proficiency in **Adobe InDesign and Adobe Photoshop**.



This is a deadline-driven production role where attention to detail, accuracy, and the ability to complete work on time are extremely important.



## What You'll Be Doing



- Creating professional grocery store advertisements using our client's proprietary drag-and-drop design platform

- Importing Excel spreadsheets containing product information, pricing, and other advertisement details into the system

- Arranging grocery product images, prices, promotional offers, and design elements to create visually appealing advertisements

- Working with advertisements containing varying numbers of products and different layout requirements

- Making sure all product information, prices, images, and layouts are accurate

- Reviewing completed advertisements for spelling, formatting, alignment, spacing, and design consistency

- Completing approximately **5 grocery advertisements per week (roughly 1 per day)**

- Managing your workload to consistently meet **daily and weekly production deadlines**

- Making revisions and adjustments based on feedback

- Communicating regularly and working closely with other designers, trainers, and team members



## What We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who:



- **Has previous professional graphic design or print design experience**

- **Has experience using both Adobe InDesign and Adobe Photoshop (required)**

- Has a strong eye for design, layout, typography, spacing, and visual presentation

- Is comfortable working with Excel spreadsheets and importing product data into software platforms

- Has exceptional attention to detail, particularly when working with product images, prices, and promotional information

- Is highly organized and capable of managing multiple assignments with strict deadlines

- Can work efficiently while maintaining consistent design quality and accuracy

- Has good written and verbal English communication skills

- Is comfortable learning new software and following established processes

- Is reliable, dependable, and able to work effectively as part of a remote team

- Has a reliable computer and internet connection suitable for full-time remote work



**Previous experience creating retail advertisements, grocery ads, catalogs, flyers, or other print marketing materials is a plus.**



## Full Training Provided



We provide complete training on our client's proprietary design platform.



We have our own training system and dedicated trainers who will teach you how to use the software, import product information, follow the production workflow, and create advertisements that meet our quality standards.



While Adobe InDesign and Photoshop experience is required, previous experience with our client's specific platform is not necessary.



## Compensation & Work Schedule



**Salary: ₱150–₱250 per hour**



**Location:** 100% Remote / Work From Home



**Schedule:** Full-Time, Monday through Friday



**Working Hours:** Approximately 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time



**Important:** This is an overnight/graveyard shift for applicants based in the Philippines. You must be comfortable working during U.S. business hours.



There will be opportunities for increased compensation and additional responsibilities for team members who perform well and grow with the company.



## How to Apply



Please submit:



- Your resume

- A short introduction about yourself

- A brief description of your previous graphic design or print design experience, particularly with Adobe InDesign and Photoshop

- A portfolio or examples of previous design work, if available



A formal portfolio is not required, but examples of previous print advertisements, promotional flyers, retail designs, or similar work are highly encouraged.



We're looking for dependable designers who have strong visual design skills, communicate well, pay close attention to detail, and can consistently deliver accurate, high-quality work on schedule.

Turn approved direction into real plans with owners, dependencies, and evidence of results

Challenge leadership, including the CEO, constructively when the evidence calls for it

Real, personal sales or business development experience — you have closed deals yourself, not just supported someone who does

title: Land Comper / Land Analyst (Land Insights, LandPortal, Smarter Contact) - Penance Properties
description:
SALARY: $700-$900 USD per month starting base + $100 per closed deal  |  Full time, 40 hours/week  |  Hiring 2



ABOUT PENANCE PROPERTIES

Penance Properties is a US land investing company. We buy vacant land directly from owners across the United States and resell it to land buyers and builders. Every offer we make starts with a comp, so this is a core seat on our acquisitions team, not a side task. We are hiring TWO land analysts who will start and train together in November 2026.



THE JOB IN ONE SENTENCE

Tell us what a vacant lot is really worth and what could kill the deal, quickly, with comp links to back it up.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're not just filling a seat. We're looking for people who want to build a long-term career with us and grow alongside the business. The right person is:

- Coachable: You welcome feedback, apply it quickly, and keep sharpening your skills.

- Diligent: You take pride in getting the details right, every lot, every time.

- Loyal: You're looking for a long-term home, not a short-term gig, and you treat our business like it's your own.

- Driven to grow: You want more responsibility, and you're ready to earn it as we expand.



If this is you, this role can take you where you want to go. We invest in people who invest in themselves. Your skills will grow with every deal, and your income, title, and responsibilities will grow with them. As Penance Properties grows, the people who helped build it grow with it. Bring the right attitude, and we'll give you the opportunity to reach your goals here.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Comp vacant land of every type: rural acreage, builder and infill lots, desert parcels

- Pull sold and active comps, work in price per acre, throw out bad comps, and give a value range plus one best number

- Check every lot for deal killers: access / landlocked, flood zone, wetlands, zoning, soils / septic, utilities, slope

- Note the best exit for each lot (retail land buyer, builder, or land-home)

- Work your own lead inbox and prepare offers for manager approval

- Check in with the team every day in Slack



TOOLS

- Land Insights

- LandPortal

- Smarter Contact



HOURS

- Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Pacific Time

- That is 1:00 AM to 9:00 AM Philippine time, Tuesday to Saturday

- Fixed schedule. No split shifts.

- This must be your only job during these hours



PAY AND GROWTH

- $700 to $900 USD per month starting base, set by your experience and your work sample results

- PLUS a $100 USD bonus for every deal you comped that closes

- Large opportunity to grow within the business. As our deal volume grows, strong analysts can earn raises and move into bigger roles such as acquisitions lead, deal underwriting, or training and managing new analysts.

- Clear written targets for accuracy and volume, reviewed regularly, so you always know what it takes to move up

- We never charge applicants anything, at any step



WHAT YOU NEED

- Hands-on experience comping US VACANT LAND for a land investor or wholesaler (house-only comping is not enough)

- Clear spoken and written English. You will talk with our US team every day.

- Your own computer, stable internet, and a backup for power and internet (UPS, generator, or a second provider)

- WhatsApp for quick contact

- Care with details. A missed flood zone or landlocked parcel costs real money.



OUR HIRING PROCESS (so you know every step before you apply)

1. Apply here with the code word and a fresh video (see HOW TO APPLY).

2. Qualified applicants get a short message asking for: your expected monthly pay in USD, a speedtest.net result link, your power and internet backup, and your WhatsApp number.

3. 30-minute Google Meet call. Part of it is a live comp: we give you a parcel and you comp it on screen share with your normal tools while you talk us through it.

4. Paid work sample: value 8 vacant lots (market value range and best number, 3 comps with links, red flags, confidence, minutes spent). We pay you $25 USD by Wise for the completed sample. Use your own tools plus free sources. We do not provide logins.

5. We choose two analysts, send written offers, and onboard you in Slack.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your application with the word LOTLINE. Applications without it are not reviewed.

2. List the land comping tools you use and how many years on each.

3. Tell us roughly how many vacant lots you comp in a normal day, and for what kind of company (land flipper, wholesaler, etc.).

4. Include a link to a NEW 1 to 2 minute Loom video recorded for this job. Start by saying "LOTLINE" and today's date, then tell us about your land comping experience. Speak naturally and do not read a script. Old or reused videos are not reviewed.

title: Experienced QuickBooks Online Bookkeeper — U.S. Restoration Company
description:
EXPERIENCED QUICKBOOKS ONLINE BOOKKEEPER — U.S. RESTORATION COMPANY

RBS NJ Inc. / FloodCo USA | Full-time | Remote — Philippines



This is a hands-on accounting position, not a general virtual assistant role. We are looking for an experienced bookkeeper who owns the integrity of our QuickBooks Online records: keeping the books current, reconciling accounts so every balance can be supported, and investigating discrepancies until the real cause is found.



ABOUT US

FloodCo USA / RBS NJ Inc. is a U.S. restoration company: water mitigation, mold remediation and reconstruction. We run many jobs at once, each with its own materials, subcontractors, crews, fuel and insurance-related billing, and our books need to reflect that accurately.



POSITION DETAILS

- Schedule: Monday-Friday, 7:00 AM-4:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time, with a one-hour unpaid lunch break.

- Philippine time: 7:00 PM-4:00 AM PHT during U.S. Daylight Time (mid-March to early November); 8:00 PM-5:00 AM PHT during U.S. Standard Time (early November to mid-March). Next changes: Nov 1, 2026 and Mar 14, 2027.

- Exclusive to our company during scheduled working hours.

- Compensation: $900 USD/month and up, based on verified experience and demonstrated ability. Full-time, 40 hours/week.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Daily and ongoing bookkeeping in QuickBooks Online.

- Review bank and credit card transactions; match bank-feed items to existing checks, bills and payments so nothing is duplicated.

- Complete accurate bank, credit card and balance-sheet account reconciliations.

- Support accounts payable and accounts receivable; track invoices and payments.

- Follow up on customer payments and document collection activity.

- Categorize expenses correctly: company overhead vs job-specific materials, fuel, subcontractors, employee costs and transfers.

- Identify and resolve duplicate or incorrectly posted transactions, with documentation.

- Review outstanding checks and unreconciled items.

- Maintain vendor and customer records.

- Track job costs and project-related expenses.

- Record intercompany transfers with proper documentation.

- Support the monthly close; prepare accurate financial and exception reports.

- Keep supporting documentation and a clear audit trail.



REQUIRED

- Hands-on QuickBooks Online experience you can demonstrate in a practical test.

- At least 3 years of substantial bookkeeping experience, preferably with U.S. businesses.

- Independently completed bank and credit card reconciliations.

- Strong understanding of debits/credits, account classifications and basic accrual accounting.

- Ability to investigate discrepancies and report facts, not guesses.

- Excel proficiency: formulas, lookups, filters, SUMIFS/pivots, reconciliation workbooks.

- AP, AR and financial reporting experience.

- Clear written and spoken English.

- Strong confidentiality and data-handling habits.

- Ability to work the Eastern Time schedule consistently.

- Reliable internet, suitable equipment, and backup power/connectivity.



NICE TO HAVE

- Bookkeeping for U.S. construction, restoration, property management or project-based service companies.

- Job costing experience; collections on insurance-related invoices.

- QuickBooks certification (helpful, but we hire on demonstrated ability).



HOW WE WORK

Investigate before changing anything. Never delete or void records just to make a balance agree. Document every adjustment and get approval for material or unsupported changes. Protect confidential information and respect access controls. Report mistakes promptly, including your own.

We will never ask you for a current or former employer's banking credentials, confidential files or client information as a work sample. Please do not send any.



HOW TO APPLY - ANSWER ALL 12 QUESTIONS

For each answer, tell us what you personally did versus what a supervisor reviewed or completed.

1. How many years have you worked directly in QuickBooks Online?

2. What U.S. companies or industries have you supported?

3. Have you independently reconciled bank and credit card accounts? How many accounts and how frequently?

4. Explain the difference between matching a bank-feed transaction to an existing check and adding it as a new expense.

5. How would you investigate a difference between a bank statement and a QuickBooks reconciliation?

6. Describe a bookkeeping error you discovered and corrected.

7. Have you handled accounts receivable, overdue invoices and customer payment follow-ups?

8. Have you performed job costing or allocated expenses to individual projects?

9. What financial reports have you prepared or reviewed?

10. Which Excel functions do you regularly use?

11. Can you work our Eastern Time schedule consistently?

12. What is your expected monthly compensation and earliest start date?



Applications that skip the questions will not be reviewed. Shortlisted applicants complete a 45-60 minute practical bookkeeping assessment (fictional data), then an interview. Experience is verified before any offer.

title: Social Media Operations Manager
description:

They are published by a growing network of “social media content posters,” freelancers who run their own Instagram and TikTok accounts and post the content we send them. Hiring new posters is going well. Now we need one person to own the whole posting operation as it scales.



The role

You’ll be the single point of ownership for our poster network. When something goes wrong, content creators and content posters come to you, and you fix it. Our goal is simple: every post goes out, every account stays healthy, and posters know exactly what to do next



What you’ll do



- Make sure all scheduled posts go out on time, every day, across all poster accounts 

- Monitor account health: shadowbans, problems with posting, reach drops

- Spot posters who aren’t performing or aren’t reliable, follow up with them, and report to HR if needed

- Troubleshoot day-to-day issues:
/Meta connection problems, wrong content sent, missed posts, account access

- Be the go-to contact for content posters' questions about posting, and follow up until issues are closed

- Keep the operation structured: clear processes, trackers and checklists so nothing slips as we grow

- Proactively suggest improvements if you see the possibility to do things better. 





Who you are



- High agency: you see a problem, d
 and act without waiting to be told

- Very organized and structured; you build systems instead of firefighting the same issue twice

- Responsible and reliable; when something is yours, it gets done

- A clear, proactive communicator in written English, comfortable following people up

title: Marketing Manager—Book Publishing
description:
Remote | Full-Time Preferred | Long-Term Position



Forest City Publications is looking for a creative, thoughtful, and experienced digital marketer to join our publishing team.



We're an independent American publishing company with 10 years of experience helping authors bring their books into the world. We work closely with our authors throughout the publishing process, providing personalized guidance, professional book design, publishing, distribution, and marketing support.



Our company is growing, along with our YouTube channel, The Guerrilla Publisher, which has more than 16,000 subscribers and nearly 700,000 views.



We're expanding our book marketing services and would love to find someone who enjoys working with people, developing creative marketing ideas, and helping authors succeed.



About the Position



This is a combination of marketing strategy, research, and author support.



You'll work directly with authors, helping them understand their readers, explore marketing opportunities, and develop practical plans for getting their books into readers' hands.



You'll also work with our publishing team to help develop and deliver marketing services for our clients.



Some of your responsibilities will include:



- Conducting one-on-one marketing strategy meetings with authors via Zoom

- Helping authors identify their target audiences and discover where to reach them

- Researching book markets, competing titles, and promotional opportunities

- Developing practical, individualized 90-day book marketing plans

- Advising authors on
 marketing, social media, YouTube, podcasts, speaking opportunities, and other promotional channels

- Helping authors establish their online presence and build relationships with readers

- Supporting book launches and Amazon bestseller campaigns

- Helping us create and improve our marketing packages and resources

- Tracking marketing activities and results to identify what's working

- Working closely with our team to support authors throughout their publishing and marketing journey



What We're Looking For



A good understanding of marketing and its application to new ventures is important. Our authors typically have no current audience for their books. 



You don't need previous experience in book publishing. We're happy to teach you how the publishing industry works and share the marketing systems we've developed.



We would love to find someone who has experience in digital marketing and enjoys thinking about the bigger picture—not just creating posts or managing accounts, but understanding what a client is trying to accomplish and helping them find a practical way forward.



Our ideal candidate:



- Has at least 2–3 years of experience in digital marketing, content marketing, or social media marketing

- Understands how to build an online audience and connect with potential customers

- Has excellent written and spoken English

- Is comfortable meeting with American clients via Zoom

- Enjoys research, planning, and creative problem-solving

- Can explain marketing concepts clearly to people who are new to marketing

- Is organized, dependable, and attentive to details

- Is comfortable working independently while collaborating with a small team

- Enjoys learning new skills and exploring new marketing approaches



Experience with
 marketing, sales funnels, YouTube, or marketing automation would be helpful.



Working With Us



Forest City Publications is a small, established, and growing company. We take pride in the quality of our work and the relationships we develop with our authors.



Many of our clients are first-time authors who have spent years writing their books. Marketing can feel unfamiliar or overwhelming to them, so patience, encouragement, and an ability to explain things simply are important parts of this position.



We value good ideas, independent thinking, clear communication, and a willingness to learn.



This position will begin part-time, with the possibility of growing into a larger role as our author marketing services expand.



You'll have the opportunity to learn more about the publishing industry, develop your marketing strategy and consulting skills, and become a valued member of our team.



Because we work primarily with American authors, you'll need some availability during U.S. business hours for scheduled Zoom meetings.



Compensation will depend on experience and qualifications.



How to Apply



Please send us a brief introduction describing your marketing background and why you're interested in working with authors.



Include your relevant experience, the types of marketing projects you've worked on, your familiarity with digital marketing tools, your availability, and your desired hourly rate.



We'd also like you to answer one question:



Imagine you're meeting with an author who has written a wonderful nonfiction book but has almost no social media following, no
 list, and a limited marketing budget.



What are the first three things you'd want to know about the author and their book before recommending a marketing strategy, and why?



We're interested in how you approach marketing challenges. You don't need publishing experience to answer.



We look forward to hearing from you!



Lara Helmling

Forest City Publications
