title: AI Smart - Operations Manager / Advanced VA — GoHighLevel Experience Required
description:
I'm looking for the person who has probably had this career path:



You started as a VA.



Then you became the VA everyone trusted with more stuff.



You started managing projects, clients, calendars, systems, team members, SOPs, and the random problems that come up every day in a small business.



Somewhere along the way, you learned GoHighLevel — and got pretty good at it.



**That's who I'm looking for.**



This is NOT a job for someone who only wants to build funnels.



And it's not an entry-level VA position where I'll give you a checklist of tasks every morning.



I'm looking for a smart, resourceful, organized person who can become a key part of running my video marketing business.



## ABOUT THE ROLE



You'll work directly with me and help keep the business moving.



Some days you'll be inside GoHighLevel.



Some days you'll be coordinating with editors or checking the status of client projects.



Some days you'll be setting up a funnel, fixing an automation, scheduling
s, organizing client information, documenting a process, or figuring out why something isn't working.



I don't need you to know everything.



I need you to be the kind of person who can **figure things out.**



## GOHIGHLEVEL



You should already be comfortable inside GHL.



You don't have to be the greatest GoHighLevel developer in the Philippines, but you should understand the platform well enough that I'm not teaching you the basics.



You should be comfortable with things like:



- Funnels and landing pages

- Forms and calendars

- Workflows and automations

-
 campaigns

- SMS

- Tags and custom fields

- Pipelines

- Contacts

- Products and payments

- Domains

- Snapshots

- Troubleshooting automations

- Testing funnels and customer journeys



Bonus points if you've worked inside an agency account with multiple subaccounts.



## OPERATIONS



This is the bigger part of the role.



I want someone who notices things.



A client hasn't submitted something we're waiting on? You notice.



An editor is missing a file? You notice.



An automation stopped working? You investigate it.



A project hasn't moved in three days? You ask why.



I don't want to be the only person in the business who knows what needs to happen next.



Over time, I want you to understand the business well enough that you can help manage the moving pieces without waiting for me to tell you what to do.



That could include client onboarding, project tracking, team coordination, documentation, scheduling, checking deliverables, organizing files, maintaining systems, and improving processes.



## THE PERSON I'M LOOKING FOR



You are organized without being rigid.



You're comfortable with technology.



You communicate clearly.



You don't disappear when you hit a problem.



You don't need instructions for every tiny decision.



You'll ask questions when necessary, but you'll also Google it, watch a video, test something, and try to solve it.



You understand that a growing small business can occasionally be messy — and part of your job is helping make it less messy.



And you genuinely like being the person who keeps things moving.



## OUR BUSINESS



I'm a video marketing strategist and producer based in the United States.



I've been doing this for more than 25 years and have worked with thousands of businesses, entrepreneurs, and professional service companies.



We produce video marketing campaigns, client content, funnels, lead generation campaigns, workshops, and other marketing projects.



We have editors and other team members, so you won't be doing everything yourself.



Your job is increasingly to help **connect the pieces.**



## THIS COULD GROW INTO A BIG ROLE



I'm not looking for someone who wants to bounce between five clients forever.



I'm looking for someone who would enjoy becoming an important part of one business.



If you're good, I expect this role to grow.



More responsibility.



More decision-making.



More ownership.



And more compensation as your value to the business grows.



## HOW TO APPLY



Please don't send me a generic AI-written cover letter.



Instead, tell me:



1. What was your first VA or online job, and how has your role evolved since then?



2. What kinds of operations or project-management responsibilities have you handled?



3. How long have you used GoHighLevel, and what do you actually do inside it?



4. Tell me about one problem you discovered and fixed without your boss having to tell you to fix it.



5. What software do you use regularly besides GHL?



6. Send me a short Loom video introducing yourself and showing me something you've built or managed inside GoHighLevel.



And somewhere in your application include the phrase:



**"I keep things moving."**



That tells me you actually read the post.

title: Guest Experience & Operations Manager
description:
About the Role



Adventure Awaits Stays is a short-term rental portfolio across Texas and the Gulf Coast. It includes Canyon Lake Retreat (eight lakeview suites plus a three-bedroom home), Hilltop Haven in Leander, a Jonestown Hill Country estate and Surfside and Duneside on the Gulf. We sell memorable stays, not just beds. Right now our operations aren't living up to that.



This hire is the person who gets the portfolio back on track. You will own the guest experience from inquiry to review, keep the operational machine running in OwnerRez, and make sure pricing, cleaning, maintenance and communication all work together. The founder is based in Italy, so you need to run the day-to-day without hand-holding and flag only what needs a decision.



Hours of Operation: 6 PM to 6 AM CST/ 5 days per week (Tue, Wed off)



Mission for the First 90 Days



1. Stabilize guest experience: fast responses, fewer complaints, and a rising review average.

2. Clean up the operational backlog at Canyon Lake Retreat, where guest reviews have surfaced recurring problems (Wi-Fi, lockouts, cleaning consistency, maintenance, pests, and safety items).

3. Get calendars, rates and listings accurate and consistent across Airbnb, VRBO and direct booking.

4. Put in place repeatable systems (SOPs, checklists, reporting) so the portfolio doesn't depend on one person remembering everything.



Core Responsibilities



A. Guest Support and Communication

- Respond to inquiries, booking questions and in-stay issues across Airbnb, VRBO, direct booking and text, within our response-time standards.

- Own pre-arrival, check-in, mid-stay and check-out messaging. Maintain and improve the templates and automations in OwnerRez.

- Handle complaints, refund and compensation requests, and service recovery with empathy and good judgment, inside approval limits set by the founder.

- Work with the AI guest-inquiry agent we are building in OwnerRez: review its answers, correct them, and flag gaps in its knowledge.

- Monitor reviews on every channel. Respond to public reviews professionally and log recurring themes.



B. OwnerRez Administration

- Manage the full reservation lifecycle: bookings, modifications, cancellations, payments, deposits and quotes.

- Keep channel connections, calendar sync, listings, fees, taxes and house rules accurate. Catch double-bookings and sync errors before guests do.

- Maintain property data, guest-facing guidebooks, and automated messages and tasks.

- Pull and prepare reports on occupancy, revenue, ADR, lead time and channel mix.



C. Pricing and Revenue Support (PriceLabs)

- Monitor PriceLabs daily across all listings: base prices, minimum stays, orphan-day rules, gap fills, last-minute and far-out discounts, and local events.

- Identify underperforming properties and dates, and bring recommendations to the founder. Base-price changes require founder approval.

- Support the pilot where an AI revenue manager reviews performance against the market and proposes PriceLabs updates. You are the human check on those recommendations.

- Keep pricing consistent across channels, and track pricing against market comps.



D. Field Operations and Vendor Coordination

- Coordinate cleaners, handymen, landscapers, pest control and other vendors. Schedule turnovers around the OwnerRez calendar.

- Run a consistent quality-control process for each turnover: photo checklists, supply levels, and inspections.

- Triage maintenance requests by urgency. Safety and access issues (locks, smoke and CO detectors, plumbing, pests) come first.

- Lead the Wi-Fi and connectivity fix at Canyon Lake Retreat in coordination with vendors.

- Manage the issue tracker: assign owners, set deadlines, follow up, and close items with proof.



E. Systems, Reporting and Continuous Improvement

- Document SOPs for check-in and check-out, turnover standards, emergency response, and owner or partner reporting.

- Send the founder a weekly summary covering performance, open issues, decisions needed, and risks.

- Prepare monthly summaries for partners and joint-venture stakeholders as needed.

- Recommend and implement tools that reduce manual work.



4. Qualifications



Required

- 5 or more years in short-term rental management, hospitality or guest services

- Hands-on experience with a property management system (OwnerRez strongly preferred; Hospitable, Guesty or Hostaway is a fair substitute)

- Working knowledge of dynamic pricing (PriceLabs or Wheelhouse): base prices, min stays, minimum-night rules, and customizations

- Strong written communication, with a warm and professional tone

- Fast decision-making and ownership: you fix problems, not just report them

- Comfort working across time zones with a remote founder



Preferred

- Experience with Airbnb and VRBO host tools

- Experience managing multi-unit or multi-property portfolios

- Familiarity with Texas or Gulf Coast markets, including seasonal and event-driven demand

- Experience with smart locks, noise monitors and remote-access tech

- Comfort using AI tools in workflows

- Basic spreadsheet and reporting skills



5. Tools You'll Use

OwnerRez, PriceLabs, Airbnb and VRBO host dashboards, Wheelhouse (if retained), smart-lock systems, messaging and
, spreadsheets and trackers, and AI assistants.



6. Schedule and Coverage

- Full-time, remote

- Core hours overlapping Central Time, with guest-response coverage from morning through evening

- Rotating or on-call coverage for urgent issues (lockouts, safety, no-heat or no-water) on weekends and holidays



8. 30/60/90-Day Plan



First 30 days

- Learn all properties, systems and vendors.

- Audit OwnerRez: listings, calendars, automations and templates.

- Audit PriceLabs settings against actual performance.

- Clear the critical items on the issue tracker.

- Establish daily and weekly routines.



Days 31 to 60

- Roll out SOPs and turnover checklists.

- Replace underperforming vendors where needed.

- Complete the Wi-Fi and safety fixes at Canyon Lake Retreat.

- Improve messaging automations and give the AI agent corrections.

- Deliver the first full performance report with pricing recommendations.



Days 61 to 90

- Run the portfolio day-to-day with minimal founder involvement.

- Show measurable gains in review scores, response times and occupancy or revenue.

- Propose a Q1 improvement roadmap.



10. How to Apply

Send a résumé and a short note on a time you turned around a struggling property or guest experience. Include your experience with OwnerRez and PriceLabs.

title: PAID ADS SPECIALIST
description:
We are a fast-growing SEO and e-commerce company in the health and wellness space, managing multiple successful online brands. We are looking for a Paid Ads Specialist to plan, execute, and optimize high-performing digital advertising campaigns that drive traffic, leads, and revenue growth.



This role is ideal for a performance-driven marketer who is highly analytical, detail-oriented, and experienced in scaling paid acquisition campaigns across multiple platforms, with strong experience in budget management, audience targeting, keyword research, ad creative testing, A/B testing, and campaign optimization. The role requires continuous monitoring of performance metrics and delivering actionable insights to improve conversion rates and cost efficiency (CPL/ROAS). Develop and execute paid advertising strategies across platforms like Google Ads, Meta 
/Instagram), TikTok Ads, LinkedIn, and other relevant channels, with a strong understanding of platform algorithms and ad compliance



Key Responsibilities:

Plan, launch, and manage paid ad campaigns across Google Ads, Meta 
/Instagram), and LinkedIn, and develop multi-platform paid strategies, including TikTok and other relevant channels.

Conduct keyword research, audience targeting, and competitor analysis to improve campaign performance

Develop, test, and optimize ad creatives, copy, and landing page alignment

Manage advertising budgets efficiently to maximize ROI and reduce acquisition costs

Perform continuous A/B testing on ads, audiences, and campaign structures

Monitor, analyze, and report on key performance metrics (CPC, CPL, ROAS, CTR, conversions)

Identify scaling opportunities and implement data-driven optimization strategies

Collaborate with design and marketing teams to ensure high-performing creatives and messaging.

Leverage hands-on experience with platform algorithms and ad compliance to optimize campaign performance while ensuring strict adherence to advertising policies, platform guidelines, and regulatory standards.



What We’re Looking For

At least 2 years of experience in e-commerce or digital marketing is highly preferred.

Strong understanding of paid media fundamentals, including attribution, conversion tracking, and campaign optimization

Ability to quickly learn and adapt to new advertising platforms, AI tools, and evolving digital marketing systems, with a proactive approach to staying updated on and exploring emerging industry trends.

Experience using CRM, tracking tools, analytics, and reporting platforms (Google Analytics, Pixel setup, conversion tracking)

Experience with retargeting, lookalike audiences, and scaling campaigns

Knowledge of creative strategy for paid ads (hooks, angles, ad copy frameworks)

Experience using AI tools, automation platforms, reporting dashboards, or workflow software to improve marketing operations



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) improvement and consistency

Click-Through Rate (CTR) optimization across campaigns

Conversion Rate improvement from paid traffic

Cost Per Acquisition (CPA) efficiency

Campaign scaling performance without loss of ROI

Accuracy and consistency of reporting insights

Nice to Have

Experience with health & wellness or DTC e-commerce brands

Experience optimizing
 revenue and customer retention funnels

Familiarity with A/B testing tools and conversion optimization strategies



Schedule

Full 8-hour graveyard shift required

Must be fully available for US hours



What We Offer

Full-time remote role

Training provided

Growth opportunity into a higher leadership role





How to Apply

Please submit a complete application that includes your resume and a thoughtful, original cover letter. In your cover letter, naturally incorporate the phrase “I love coffee” and share something about yourself that isn’t reflected in your resume. Also answer the following screening questions.





1. Describe your experience with paid advertising, particularly on TikTok Ads. What does your typical daily workflow look like when managing and optimizing e-commerce campaigns? Please include the platforms you’ve worked with (e.g., TikTok Ads, Meta Ads, Google Ads, etc.).

2. Do you have experience working with platform algorithms and ensuring ad compliance while optimizing performance? If yes, briefly provide an example.



All applications will be carefully reviewed to assess alignment with the role’s requirements. The shortlisted will receive an
 invite for the next steps.

title: Level 2 IT Support Engineer (MSP)

We don't micromanage. This role requires a disciplined self-starter who takes personal pride in clean documentation, fast response times, and honest communication with both internal teams and US-based clients.

Core Traits We Are Looking For

• High Motivation: You proactively grab tickets out of the queue and take ownership of problems without needing a manager to nudge you.

• Communication: Exceptional, fluent English communication skills (written and verbal) for seamless daily interaction with US clients.

How to Apply

If you are an honest, fast-moving Level 2 Engineer with excellent English skills, we want to hear from you! Please submit your resume to 
 Tech360 Inc. is an equal-opportunity employer and welcomes applications from individuals of all backgrounds.

title: Media Buyer (Paid Social & Search)
description:
We're Not Hiring Someone to Simply "Spend the Budget."

We're Hiring Someone Who Scales Ecommerce Brands Profitably Across Meta, Google, and TikTok, and Proves It With Data.



PLEASE DO NOT REPLY DIRECTLY TO THIS POST. TO APPLY, FOLLOW THE STEPS AT THE END.

Pay: Negotiable flat rate per two-week period in USD, based on experience

Pay Timing: Paid once every two weeks. Approximately 80 hours per pay period, agreed upon at hire

Location: Remote, Philippines-based applicants only

Role Type: Full-time, long-term

Team Scope: Manages paid media across multiple ecommerce client brands, working with the paid social ad designer, copywriting,
, website, and strategy teams



This role starts with performance. If you do not already have hands-on experience managing Meta, Google, and TikTok ad accounts across multiple brands, with ROAS as your north star, this probably is not the job for you.



Why This Role Exists

Most ad accounts do not fail because the product is bad or the budget is too small.

They fail because:

Campaigns are launched and then left alone

Budget keeps flowing to ads that stopped working weeks ago

Nobody notices creative fatigue until results have already dropped

Tests are planned but never actually run, or run without a clear question

Pixel and tracking issues quietly corrupt the data every decision is based on

Winning ads are found by luck instead of by a repeatable process

Designers get vague requests instead of clear, data-backed creative briefs



At EcomIgnyte, we run paid media for multiple ecommerce brands, and every one of them depends on paid traffic to grow. We want ad accounts that are:

Structured clearly

Tracked accurately

Tested constantly

Scaled deliberately

Measured honestly

Built around ROAS and profitable growth



We're hiring a Media Buyer who can build, manage, and optimize campaigns across Meta, Google, and TikTok, read performance data with confidence, find the creative worth scaling, and run a testing program that actually gets executed.



This role exists so:

Every client's ad accounts are actively managed, not set and forgotten

Budget moves toward what is working and away from what is not

Every brand has a steady pipeline of creative and audience tests

The paid social ad designer receives clear briefs based on real performance data

Tracking and attribution issues get caught early

Leadership and clients get clear, honest reporting on what is happening and why

This is not about boosting posts or chasing vanity metrics.

It is about turning ad spend into profitable, repeatable growth.



What You'll Actually Be Doing

You will not only be launching campaigns. You will own the paid growth engine for each client brand you manage, from account structure to creative testing to reporting.

Campaign Management

Build, launch, and manage campaigns across Meta, Google (Search, Shopping, Performance Max, YouTube), and TikTok

Design clear account and campaign structures for each brand

Manage daily budgets and pacing across multiple client accounts

Scale winning campaigns and cut underperformers quickly

Manage full-funnel campaigns, including prospecting, retargeting, and retention audiences

Monitor accounts daily for spend issues, delivery problems, disapprovals, and sudden performance changes

Testing and Optimization

Plan and run structured tests on creative, hooks, angles, audiences, offers, and campaign structures

Write a clear hypothesis for every test: what you are testing, why, and what result you expect

Spot creative fatigue early and plan refreshes before performance drops

Identify winning creative and d
 how to iterate on it and scale it

Maintain a testing roadmap and results log for each brand so learnings are never lost

Tracking and Data Quality

Audit pixel, Conversions API, and conversion tracking setups

Check that attribution settings and windows match how each brand should be measured

Compare platform-reported results with Shopify data and flag gaps

Make sure every decision is based on data you trust

Creative Briefing and Collaboration

Write clear, data-backed creative briefs for the paid social ad designer and copywriters

Share what is working, what is fatiguing, and what to test next

Give fast, specific feedback on creative before launch

Work with the website team when landing pages are hurting ad performance

Reporting

Track ROAS, CPA, CPM, CTR, conversion rate, AOV, and spend for every account

Prepare clear weekly performance reports for leadership and clients

Explain what happened, why it happened, and what you are doing next

Organize tasks, tests, briefs, and approvals inside ClickUp



You are not expected to design the ads yourself.

You are expected to:

Live inside Ads Manager, Google Ads, and TikTok Ads Manager

Make decisions based on data, not hunches

Run the tests you plan, consistently, for every brand

Give designers briefs clear enough to produce the right creative the first time

Manage several brands and budgets without losing track

Report honestly, even when results are not good



This Role Is for Someone Who…

Has actively managed Meta, Google, and TikTok ad accounts with clear, measurable results

Treats ROAS as the north star and understands how it connects to profit

Understands full-funnel testing, ad sequencing, creative fatigue, and attribution windows

Can build campaign structures, audit pixel setups, and evaluate data quality

Turns numbers into tactics and runs the tests they plan

Is constantly curious about what is working, what is not, and why

Can brief creative teams clearly and help refine what gets produced

Can manage several brands, budgets, and deadlines at the same time

Accepts losing tests as useful learning, not failure

Can take feedback without ego

Communicates clearly on camera, in writing, and in ClickUp



This Role Is Not for Someone Who…

Has only boosted posts and never run real paid campaigns

Dabbles in ads but does not live in Ads Manager

Avoids performance data or struggles to interpret it

Needs a strategist to tell them what to do

Cannot juggle multiple brands or manage deadlines

Is "almost fluent" in English

Experience That Helps

Managing ad accounts for multiple ecommerce brands at once

Agency or multi-client media buying

Meta Ads, Google Ads (Search, Shopping, Performance Max, YouTube), and TikTok Ads

Pinterest or other paid channels

Pixel, Conversions API, and Google Tag Manager setup

Shopify analytics and Google Analytics

Attribution tools such as Triple Whale or Northbeam

Creative strategy and writing creative briefs

Offer, landing page, and audience testing

ClickUp or similar project management tools

Simple design skills in Figma, Canva, or Photoshop (a bonus, not a requirement)



You do not need to be a "marketing genius."

You do need:

Real, hands-on media buying experience

Comfort with data, testing, and evidence

Strong judgment about when to scale, hold, or cut

Clear communication with designers and non-marketers

The discipline to keep accounts monitored and tests running every week

How You'll Work With the Team

Leadership and strategists set client goals, budgets, and priorities. You turn them into campaign plans, testing roadmaps, and results.

The paid social ad designer produces static ads and variations. You give them clear, data-backed briefs, fast feedback, and performance results so every round of creative gets better.

The copywriting team provides hooks, headlines, and angles. You tell them which messages are winning and which are fatiguing.

The website and
 teams own the landing pages and follow-up. You flag when a landing page is hurting ad performance and share what customers respond to.

The project manager keeps work moving in ClickUp. You keep your tasks, tests, and briefs up to date so nothing gets stuck.

You are not buying media in isolation. You are part of a system built to turn every client's ad spend into profitable, repeatable growth.



Why You'll Like Working Here

Ownership over the paid growth engine for multiple ecommerce brands

Real budgets and fast feedback loops

A dedicated ad designer to produce the creative you brief

A steady testing program where you see your ideas measured every week

Clear workflows and expectations

Organized project management

Leadership that values evidence over opinion

Long-term opportunities for growth

A team that cares about quality, clarity, and execution

We do not reward spending for its own sake.

We reward clear thinking, consistent testing, and growth that is proven in the numbers.



Application Process

PLEASE DO NOT JUST REPLY TO THIS POST ON THE JOB BOARD. To be considered, you must complete all the steps below.



Step 1: Take a Short Online IQ Test

We respect intelligence, curiosity, and the ability to learn quickly.

Go to the Fast Learner Free IQ Test

Complete the test

Create a free account at the end

Save your results URL for Step 3

Applicants without a valid results link will not be considered.



Step 2: Record a Two-to-Three-Minute Loom Video

Camera must be on. Create a free Loom account and record a short introduction in clear English.

Tell us:

About your media buying experience, especially for ecommerce brands

Which platforms you have managed (Meta, Google, TikTok, others) and your monthly spend levels

How you manage budgets and d
 when to scale or cut

A creative or audience test you ran and what it taught you

How you spot creative fatigue and what you do about it

How you brief designers on new ad creative

Why you believe this role would be a good fit

Save the Loom URL for Step 3.



Step 3: Complete the Online Interview

The Google Form is your online interview. No AI-generated answers. We want to hear from you.

In the application form:

Enter your contact details

Paste your IQ test results link

Paste your Loom video link

Upload your resume

Share examples of results you have driven

Answer every question honestly and thoughtfully

Your answers matter more than perfect formatting.



Step 4: Live Video Interview

The final stage is a live video interview with your camera on. This is where we learn more about how you think, read data, make decisions, and handle pressure across multiple accounts.

Every completed application will be reviewed personally. Candidates who appear to be a strong fit will be contacted directly.

If this role speaks to you, good. That probably means you care about more than spending budget.

Bring your best thinking.

We'll bring the brands.



Link to Online Interview Form:

title: Transaction Coordinator
description:

Key Responsibilities

title: Paid Social Ad Designer
description:
We're Not Hiring Someone to Simply "Make Pretty Ads."

We're Hiring Someone Who Designs Ads That Stop the Scroll, Communicate in Seconds, and Get Better With Every Round of Data.



PLEASE DO NOT REPLY DIRECTLY TO THIS POST. TO APPLY, FOLLOW THE STEPS AT THE END.

Pay: Negotiable flat rate per two-week period in USD, based on experience

Pay Timing: Paid once every two weeks. Approximately 80 hours per pay period, agreed upon at hire

Location: Remote, Philippines-based applicants only

Role Type: Full-time, long-term

Team Scope: Designs paid social creative for multiple ecommerce client brands, working closely with the media buyer, copywriting, and creative teams



Why This Role Exists

Most paid social ads do not fail because they look bad.

They fail because:

The hook does not stop the scroll

The message takes too long to understand

The product, offer, or benefit gets lost in the design

The ad looks like an ad, and people skip it

The same creative runs until it is exhausted

One concept gets made once instead of tested in several variations

Designers never see the performance data, so the next round repeats the same mistakes



At EcomIgnyte, we run paid media for multiple ecommerce brands across Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, and other platforms. Creative is the biggest lever in every one of those ad accounts. We want ads that are:

Scroll-stopping

Clear in under three seconds

Native to each platform

On-brand

Built in testable variations

Improved by real performance data



We're hiring a Paid Social Ad Designer who can turn briefs and performance insights into high volumes of clean, conversion-focused ad creative, and who gets better with every round of results.



This role exists so:

The media buyer always has fresh creative ready to test

Every concept is produced in enough variations to find a winner

Winning ads are iterated on quickly before they fatigue

Each platform gets creative built for how people use it

Brands stay consistent across every ad and format

Performance data shapes every new round of design



This is not about making trendy graphics.

It is about designing ads that get attention, communicate fast, and drive action.



What You'll Actually Be Doing

You will not only be making ads. You will help d
 what every brand's paid social creative says, how it looks, and what gets tested next.

Ad Creative Production

Design static ads for Meta 
 and Instagram), TikTok, Pinterest, and other paid social platforms

Create ads in every size and placement needed: feed, stories, reels, and carousels

Turn creative briefs, copy, and product photos into clean, scroll-stopping ads

Design common ecommerce ad formats, such as product benefit ads, offer and promo ads, before-and-after, comparison, testimonial and review ads, UGC-style graphics, and "us vs. them" layouts

Edit and resize product images and lifestyle photos for ad use

Create simple motion graphics or edit short video hooks when needed

Variations and Iteration

Produce multiple variations of each concept, such as different hooks, headlines, visuals, offers, and layouts

Iterate on winning ads quickly so the media buyer can keep scaling them

Refresh fatigued creative with new angles while keeping what worked

Adapt one campaign concept across several platforms and formats

Working From Data

Review performance feedback from the media buyer on which ads are winning and why

Learn which hooks, layouts, and visual styles perform best for each brand

Use those learnings to make every new round of creative stronger

Suggest your own creative ideas and angles worth testing

Organization and Quality

Follow brand guidelines for every client

Build reusable ad templates and components in Figma

Check every ad for spelling, alignment, readability, safe zones, and platform text and size requirements

Name, organize, and export files so the media buyer can launch them without guessing

Organize briefs, revisions, feedback, and approvals inside ClickUp



You are not expected to run the ads.

You are expected to:

Think about what makes someone stop scrolling

Communicate one clear message per ad

Produce high volumes of quality creative on deadline

Design for each platform, not one size for all

Learn from performance data instead of personal taste

Work across several brands without losing consistency



This Role Is for Someone Who…

Has designed paid social ads for ecommerce brands

Understands that an ad has about three seconds to get attention

Has strong instincts for hierarchy, contrast, typography, and layout

Can make one idea work across many sizes, formats, and variations

Is comfortable designing in Figma, and in Photoshop or Canva when needed

Is fast without being sloppy

Wants to see performance data and enjoys learning what actually works

Can work within existing brand guidelines

Can take a clear brief and deliver, and asks questions when a brief is not clear

Accepts losing ads as useful learning, not failure

Can take feedback without ego

Communicates clearly and works well inside organized systems



This Role Is Not for Someone Who…

Only designs for how things look, not how they perform

Struggles to produce volume on deadline

Gets attached to one version and resists testing alternatives

Ignores platform specs, safe zones, or brand guidelines

Is "almost fluent" in English

Experience That Helps

Paid social ad design for Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, or Snapchat

Ecommerce or direct-to-consumer brands

Creative testing and producing ad variations

Figma components and reusable templates

Photoshop for product image editing and retouching

Simple motion design or short video editing (After Effects, CapCut, Premiere Pro)

UGC-style and native-looking ad formats

Working with media buyers, copywriters, and performance teams

Agency or multi-brand work

ClickUp or similar project management tools



You do not need to be a "creative genius."

You do need:

Strong design instincts

Attention to detail

Marketing awareness

Speed and consistency

The ability to learn from performance data

The discipline to follow briefs, brand standards, and feedback



How You'll Work With the Team

The media buyer runs the ads and reads the data. They give you creative briefs, testing needs, and performance feedback, and you turn that into new concepts, variations, and iterations.

The copywriting team provides hooks, headlines, and angles. You organize that copy visually so the message lands in seconds.

The creative and website teams provide brand assets, product photos, and guidelines. You keep every ad consistent with the brand.

The project manager keeps work moving in ClickUp. You keep your tasks, revisions, and deliverables up to date so nothing gets stuck.

You are not designing in isolation. You are part of a system built to find winning creative faster and scale it across every client brand.



Why You'll Like Working Here

A variety of ecommerce brands and creative challenges

Real performance data on the ads you design

A media buyer who gives you clear briefs and honest feedback

A steady pipeline of creative work

Clear workflows and expectations

Organized project management

Leadership that values thoughtful, performance-driven design

Long-term opportunities for growth

A team that cares about quality, clarity, and execution



We do not reward decoration.

We reward clarity, speed, strong creative judgment, and ads that prove themselves in the numbers.

Application Process



PLEASE DO NOT JUST REPLY TO THIS POST ON THE JOB BOARD. To be considered, you must complete all the steps below.

Step 1: Take a Short Online IQ Test

We respect intelligence, curiosity, and the ability to learn quickly.

Go to the Fast Learner Free IQ Test

Complete the test

Create a free account at the end

Save your results URL for Step 3

Applicants without a valid results link will not be considered.



Step 2: Record a Two-to-Three-Minute Loom Video

Camera must be on. Create a free Loom account and record a short introduction in clear English.

Tell us:

About your experience designing paid social ads, especially for ecommerce brands

Which platforms you have designed for (Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, others)

What makes an ad stop the scroll and communicate quickly

How you create variations of one ad concept for testing

An ad you designed that performed well, and why you think it worked

Your experience with Figma, Photoshop, Canva, or video editing tools

Why you believe this role would be a good fit

Save the Loom URL for Step 3.



Step 3: Complete the Online Interview

The Google Form is your online interview. No AI-generated answers. We want to hear from you.

In the application form:

Enter your contact details

Paste your IQ test results link

Paste your Loom video link

Upload your resume

Share your portfolio of ad creative

Answer every question honestly and thoughtfully

Your answers matter more than perfect formatting.



Step 4: Live Video Interview

The final stage is a live video interview with your camera on. This is where we learn more about how you think, communicate, respond to feedback, and approach creative work.

Every completed application will be reviewed personally. Candidates who appear to be a strong fit will be contacted directly.

If this role speaks to you, good. That probably means you care about more than decoration.

Bring your best work.

We'll bring the data.

title: [EXPERIENCED] [Female] Klaviyo Email Marketing Specialist for a fast growing female fashion dropshipping store
description:
Hi there, nice to see our vacancy has caught your attention.



We are currently operating 3 fashion dropshipping stores focused solely on women in the US. As all 3 stores are beginning to scale, we are looking for a FEMALE dedicated Klaviyo
 Marketing Campaign Specialist to take responsibility for our
 campaigns.



Our core flows are already set up and managed internally. Your role is focused on planning, creating, scheduling and analyzing approximately 3–5 campaigns per week, per store.



We don't need someone who waits for us to say "send 20% off today." We need someone who actively looks at our stores, previous campaigns, competitors and customer behavior and comes up with ideas herself.



Because all 3 stores target a very similar audience, you don't need to reinvent the wheel three times. If something works well on Store 1, we want you to recognize it, adapt it and test it on Stores 2 and 3.



A proactive, commercial and data-driven mindset is your main skill needed for this role.



HOW A TYPICAL DAY LOOKS:



You start your day by checking the campaigns scheduled for our 3 stores and making sure everything was sent correctly.



You then check the performance of campaigns sent the previous day. You look at revenue, clicks, conversions, unsubscribes and other important metrics to understand what worked, what didn't and what we can learn from it.



While doing this, you're already working on the next campaigns.



You check what's currently happening inside our stores. Which products or categories are selling well? What have we
ed recently? Which previous campaigns performed particularly well?



You also regularly check
s from other large fashion and dropshipping stores to see what they're sending. Which products are they promoting? What angles are they using? Are they sending discounts, bestsellers, new arrivals, seasonal campaigns or something completely different?



We don't need to reinvent the wheel. If successful stores repeatedly use certain concepts, we can use that as inspiration and combine it with our own data.



You then d
 what campaign to create and how it should look.



For example, dresses are performing particularly well and you d
 to build a campaign around them. You select the products, create the angle and subject line, write the copy, select the right audience and build the campaign in Klaviyo.



You also d
 whether a more designed product-focused
 or a simple text-only
 makes more sense. We want someone who understands that different campaigns require different approaches and is willing to test both.



Once the campaign is created, you adapt and schedule it across our other stores where appropriate. Since the audiences are similar, a winning idea can often be reused without creating three completely different campaigns.



The next day, you make sure everything was sent correctly and evaluate the first results while already creating your next campaign.



If something performs exceptionally well, you try to understand why and use that information for future campaigns.



This process continuously repeats: create, schedule, check, analyze, learn and improve.



The goal is to consistently generate additional revenue through
 while building more and more knowledge about what our customers respond to.

-Strong hands-on experience with Klaviyo

-You're organised, structured and have an eye for detail

 campaigns

-Excellent written English

-Comfortable managing multiple Klaviyo accounts

-Strong promotional and direct-response copywriting skills

-A good eye for clean, conversion-focused
 design

-A self-starter who can work independently without constant supervision

-Proactive - you bring ideas instead of waiting for instructions



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the words:



 LEGEND



Then answer (In as much as your own words as possible):



How many years of hands-on Klaviyo experience do you have?



Which eCommerce/fashion/dropshipping stores have you managed
 marketing for? (INCLUDE NAMES)



Why are you no longer working there?



How many campaigns did you typically send per week per store?

? Separate flows and campaigns if possible.

 list sizes of the stores you managed?

title: Executive Assistant and Operations VA (GoHighLevel, Social Media Scheduling) | Full-Time, US Central Hours
description:

We build brands, websites, and systems for trainers, clinicians, and equine businesses, and we run on our own software, Horse Business Manager, a white-labeled GoHighLevel platform.

We are a team, not a task list. We want people who join for the long haul. Our video editor has been with us for over two years, and that is the kind of team we are building. We support every person on the team in reaching their personal and professional goals.



Our Christian values drive this company, and we see our business as a ministry: we exist to serve people. If you want to give your all to serve others and be part of a business that operates differently, we would love to meet you.

You will have a real say. You will own your area, and we expect you to help improve our systems, workflows, content, and the way we serve clients.



About this Role-

You will be the assistant to the founder and to the business. You are the person who keeps the back end of the company running so the rest of the team can focus on clients. Your work is structured, checklist-driven, and measured. You will not be asked to create content from scratch or guess what we want. You will assemble work using approved templates, calendars, and playbooks.



Your core responsibilities:

• Schedule approved social media content in Horse Business Manager across
, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube, following a weekly content framework

• Pull monthly analytics (social and
) on day 28 and deliver a clear report

• Run first-line client support inside GoHighLevel accounts by
, chat, and text (Monday to Friday, 8am to 5pm Central), including user removals and cancellations

 sequences

s, timestamps, tags)

• Take on other tasks as the business needs them

Schedule and pay

• Full-time, Monday to Friday, 8am to 5pm US Central Time. This is a firm requirement.

• Independent contractor, long-term position

• $900 USD per month

You are a fit if you

• Have hands-on GoHighLevel experience: workflows, automations, calendars, social planner, and full system setup. This is required. We do not train on GoHighLevel.

• Write clear, professional English

• Follow written instructions exactly and double-check your work

• Take initiative: look at your responsibilities, see what needs to be done, and act without being told every step

• Solve problems on your own first, and ask when you are truly not sure

• Can work Central-time hours reliably, with a backup plan for internet and power outages

• Have a servant attitude: you do what the business needs, not only what is in the job description

• Want to be part of a team for the long term



Nice to have: familiarity with automation tools like Zapier, n8n, or Pabbly. Horse or agriculture industry experience is a plus but not required.



How we use AI

We use AI heavily to serve people faster, and you will too. We expect you to be competent with AI tools and to use them to work faster and with higher quality. We will give you access to our tools and resources.

One rule is not negotiable: nothing we publish or send may sound like AI. Social posts,
s, and client replies must sound like a real person who cares. We build personal relationships, and people get wary and distrustful of anything that looks, sounds, or smells like AI. You will need the judgment to know where AI helps and where it hurts quality.

This is not a fit if you want a fixed list of tasks that never changes, wait to be told what to do next, or cannot solve problems on your own. This is not a creative role, but if you have a creative skill we want to know about it, and we will look for ways to use it.



How we work

• Daily end-of-day report and a weekly report

• Clear targets with checkpoints at Day 30, Day 60, and Day 180. We tell you the standards up front and support you in hitting them.



How to apply

Start your application with the words READY TO SERVE so we know you read this post. Then answer the questions in the application form and attach your resume. Make sure your DISC results are showing on your OnlineJobs profile. If you have not taken the DISC test yet, take it before you apply. If we want to move forward, you will hear from us within 24 to 48 hours. Shortlisted applicants will complete a work sample project, recorded as a Loom walkthrough, before interviews.

title: SEO & GEO Specialist - AI Search & Content
description:
## About CONTENU



CONTENU is a U.S.-based creative and growth marketing agency working primarily with healthcare, dental, construction, insurance, and professional-service brands.



We combine brand strategy, content, SEO, GEO/AI Search, websites, social media, and performance marketing to help businesses become more visible and generate qualified leads.



We are expanding our SEO/GEO capabilities and are looking for a hands-on specialist who can execute SEO and AI Search strategies as part of our team.



**This is not a general content-writer position.**



We are looking for someone who already understands SEO, has practical experience with GEO/AEO/AI Search, writes excellent English, and knows how to use AI tools intelligently without producing generic AI content.



## What You Will Do



* Conduct keyword, search-intent, topic, competitor, and query research

* Research topics and questions relevant to both traditional search and AI-generated answers

* Write and optimize high-quality English-language SEO/GEO articles

* Use ChatGPT and other AI tools for research and content production while maintaining human editorial judgment, fact-checking, and quality control

* Optimize content for Google Search as well as AI Search / GEO / AEO

* Work with entities, topical authority, citations, questions, and content structures that can improve visibility in AI-generated answers

* Optimize existing website pages and articles

* Create titles, meta descriptions, headings, FAQs, internal links, and other on-page SEO elements

* Publish and properly format content in WordPress

* Work with SEO and AI-visibility platforms such as Search Atlas, SEMrush, Google Search Console, and related tools

* Review SEO and AI Visibility performance

* Track rankings, queries, visibility, citations/mentions, competitors, and content performance

* Prepare concise reports explaining what was completed, what changed, what the data shows, and what should be optimized next

* Follow established client strategy and brand positioning using CONTENU's internal ChatGPT workspace and company resources

* Identify opportunities and problems proactively rather than simply completing assigned tasks



## Required Experience



* **2+ years of hands-on SEO experience**

* Demonstrable experience with **GEO, AEO, AI Search, or optimization for AI-generated answers**

* **Excellent written English — essential**

* Experience writing and editing professional English-language content for U.S. or other English-speaking markets

* Strong understanding of keyword research, search intent, on-page SEO, internal linking, and content optimization

* Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT as part of a professional SEO/content workflow

* WordPress experience

* Experience with Google Search Console and SEO analytics/reporting

* Ability to analyze results rather than simply collect data

* Ability to work independently from a strategy or assignment and take a task through completion

* Strong attention to detail and fact-checking

* Ability to work reliably in a remote international team



Experience with **Search Atlas, SEMrush, Ahrefs, AI visibility platforms, schema/structured data, local SEO, healthcare SEO, or U.S. local-service businesses** is a strong advantage.



You do not need previous Search Atlas experience if you have strong experience with comparable SEO platforms and can learn new tools quickly.



## What We Are Looking For



We want someone who thinks like an SEO/GEO specialist, not someone who simply generates articles with AI.



A strong candidate should be able to receive a topic or strategic direction, research it independently, determine the appropriate search and AI-search approach, produce and publish the content, review the results, and identify opportunities for further optimization.



We value people who complete the assignment but also notice opportunities, identify problems in the data, and recommend what should happen next.



Initiative, curiosity, ownership, and willingness to continue learning are important to us.



## Schedule & Compensation



* Approximately **20 hours per week**

* Remote

* Philippines-based candidates preferred

* **Starting rate: $7/hour, depending on experience**

* Opportunity for additional hours and increased responsibility as the role and our AI Search practice grow



## How to Apply



Please include:



1. How many years of hands-on SEO experience do you have?

2. Describe your experience with **GEO, AEO, AI Search, Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, or other AI-search environments**.

3. Send **2–3 examples of English-language articles or pages** you personally researched, wrote, or optimized. Explain exactly what part of the work you performed.

4. Share **one SEO case study or example** where your work produced a measurable improvement. Include the starting situation, what you did, and the result.

5. If you have a GEO/AEO/AI Search case, share it and explain how you measured the result.

6. Which SEO and AI tools have you used?

7. Briefly describe your process for creating an SEO/GEO article using AI. We specifically want to know what **you** do beyond generating the first AI draft.

8. What is your current availability and preferred hourly rate?



**Important:** Please do not send only a generic résumé or an AI-generated cover letter. We will prioritize applicants who provide specific examples, links, results, and clear explanations of their own work.



Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a small practical SEO/GEO assignment before the final interview.

description:

Elite Fleet Hauling LLC / Freight First Trucking LLC



Location: Philippines – Remote Position

Employment Type: Full-Time

Work Schedule: 40 Hours Per Week

Weekly Compensation: $150 USD

Hourly Equivalent: $3.75 USD



We are seeking highly motivated, organized, dependable, and experienced Virtual Assistants to join our growing U.S.-based trucking and logistics companies.



This is a long-term opportunity for individuals with experience in U.S. trucking operations, freight dispatching, driver recruiting, website management, administrative support, and business development.



We are looking for individuals who can multitask, work independently, communicate professionally, and contribute to the continued growth of our companies.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES – TRUCKING DISPATCH & OPERATIONS



* Search trucking load boards, negotiate competitive freight rates, and book profitable loads for assigned drivers.

* Coordinate pickup and delivery appointments and ensure drivers complete assigned loads on schedule.

* Update spreadsheets with driver assignments, load information, freight rates, mileage, pickup and delivery locations, and delivery status.

* Answer incoming telephone calls and
s from freight brokers, shippers, and customers.

* Answer driver calls and assist with dispatching, routing, breakdowns, delays, and operational concerns.

* Prepare and submit invoices for completed loads, including collecting rate confirmations, Bills of Lading (BOL), and Proof of Delivery (POD).

* Follow up on unpaid invoices, detention, layovers, and additional freight charges.

* Contact shippers, manufacturers, warehouses, and distribution centers to offer direct freight transportation and brokerage services.

* Research and pursue dedicated freight lanes, direct shipper opportunities, and additional trucking contracts.

* Maintain accurate daily dispatch records, driver schedules, and revenue reports.



DRIVER RECRUITING & ONBOARDING



* Actively scout, identify, and recruit qualified U.S.-based CDL Class A truck drivers.

* Post recruiting advertisements on job boards, social media, trucking groups, and employment websites.

* Conduct telephone interviews with prospective drivers to evaluate experience, qualifications, availability, and driving history.

* Assist management with interviewing, selecting, and hiring qualified drivers.

* Collect required driver information, including Social Security information, driver’s licenses, CDL credentials, medical certification, employment history, and onboarding documents through approved secure systems.

* Coordinate Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) checks and verify driving qualifications through authorized screening providers.

* Arrange DOT-required pre-employment drug testing and other required screenings.

* Maintain driver qualification files and ensure onboarding documents are completed.

* Send newly hired drivers links and instructions to download required trucking, tracking, ELD, and load board applications.

* Follow up with new hires to ensure they are prepared to begin working.

* Maintain recruiting spreadsheets to track applications, interviews, hiring decisions, and onboarding progress.

* Continuously recruit drivers to support company expansion.



WEBSITE MANAGEMENT & DRIVER RECRUITING FUNNEL



* Update and maintain company websites with accurate business information, trucking services, employment opportunities, and contact details.

* Manage and improve the company’s website recruiting funnel to attract qualified CDL drivers.

* Monitor driver applications submitted through the website and promptly contact applicants.

* Ensure employment application forms, website links, and submission processes function properly.

* Update recruiting advertisements, job descriptions, and hiring requirements.

* Organize applicant information and follow up with candidates who have incomplete applications.

* Assist with website content updates to promote trucking, hauling, and freight services.

* Coordinate with website developers or technical support when changes are required.

* Identify ways to improve recruiting results and increase qualified driver applications.



TRAINING & SUPERVISING OTHER VIRTUAL ASSISTANTS



* Assist with interviewing, onboarding, and training additional virtual assistants as the company expands.

* Train new virtual assistants on trucking load boards, dispatching procedures, recruiting processes, invoicing, and customer communication.

* Develop and maintain written training materials, company procedures, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

* Monitor task completion and accuracy of work assigned to other virtual assistants.

* Assist management with organizing workflows and assigning daily responsibilities.

* Provide management with updates regarding VA training, productivity, and operational performance.

* Ensure company policies, confidentiality requirements, and professional communication standards are followed.



ADDITIONAL ADMINISTRATIVE & BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT RESPONSIBILITIES



* Maintain organized company
s, files, contracts, and operational records.

* Create and update Excel spreadsheets, Google Sheets, and tracking reports.

* Research government trucking contracts, dedicated freight opportunities, and private-sector transportation agreements.

* Assist with carrier packets, vendor registrations, and customer onboarding documentation.

* Contact potential customers to develop new freight transportation relationships.

* Follow up with brokers and shippers regarding available freight and future opportunities.

* Track driver availability, truck locations, and upcoming loads.

* Prepare daily and weekly reports covering booked loads, gross revenue, recruiting activity, and business development.

* Complete additional operational and administrative duties assigned by management.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



* Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

* Experience with U.S. trucking operations, freight dispatching, or logistics strongly preferred.

* Familiarity with DAT, Truckstop, Amazon Relay, JB Hunt 360, and other freight platforms is a plus.

* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets,
 management, and online recruiting platforms.

* Ability to negotiate freight rates and communicate professionally with brokers and shippers.

* Excellent organizational, multitasking, and problem-solving skills.

* Reliable computer, high-speed internet, and a quiet professional workspace.

* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

* Strong attention to detail, punctuality, and accountability.

* Ability to maintain strict confidentiality of company information and driver records.



COMPENSATION & WORK SCHEDULE



WEEKLY PAY: $150 USD



WORK SCHEDULE: 40 HOURS PER WEEK



EMPLOYMENT TYPE: FULL-TIME



Employees are required to:

* Remain available and responsive throughout scheduled working hours.

* Dedicate all scheduled working hours to company-related responsibilities.

MANDATORY SCREEN SHARING & WORK-HOUR ACCOUNTABILITY



ALL EMPLOYEES ARE REQUIRED TO PARTICIPATE IN SCREEN SHARING DURING THEIR ASSIGNED WORKING HOURS.

BY APPLYING FOR THIS POSITION, YOU ACKNOWLEDGE THAT SCREEN SHARING AND WORK-HOUR ACCOUNTABILITY ARE MANDATORY CONDITIONS OF EMPLOYMENT.



MANDATORY VOICE AUDIO SUBMISSION – REQUIRED TO APPLY

* Must be your actual speaking voice.

* AI-generated voices, text-to-speech recordings, and written responses will NOT be accepted.

* Upload an audio file in MP3, M4A, or WAV format.

This requirement allows us to evaluate your English communication skills, professional presentation, and relevant experience before the interview.

title: Outbound Appointment Setting Call Center Needed
description:
Battery Backup  / Power Outage Leads – Texas Focus

We are looking for an established call center or BPO partner to provide dedicated full-time outbound appointment setters. This is not a search for individual callers.



Why Our Leads Are Different

We identify homes the moment they lose power and make contact within minutes. These are high-intent, time-sensitive leads — not aged lists or cold data. Homeowners are dealing with an active outage, so conversations are relevant and timely. We provide the leads, the CRM, the scripts, and the qualification criteria. Your team’s job is to call quickly, follow the process, and book clean appointments.



The Role

Your agents will make outbound calls to homeowners using our provided leads and scripts. The goal is to qualify homeowners and book clean appointments for our closer team (solar + battery or battery-only consultations).

Primary markets: Texas (Oncor and other utilities) with potential expansion into California.

Lead types: Real-time outage-triggered leads (primary), plus targeted zip-code lists and other homeowner data we supply.

Appointment types: In-home or virtual evaluations for backup power / solar + battery.

Speed requirement: Calls must be made within minutes of the outage being identified.



What We Need

•  Dedicated agents (not shared or rotating teams)

•  Full-time coverage during US business hours (CST preferred)

•  Ability to scale agent count based on lead volume

•  Strong English communication skills (clear, professional, neutral or American-friendly accent)

•  Experience with outbound appointment setting, preferably in solar, battery, home services, or similar consumer campaigns

•  Compliance-aware dialing (TCPA, DNC scrubbing, proper calling hours, opt-out handling)

•  Ability to work fast when fresh outage leads come in



Tools & Process

We provide the leads and operate in GoHighLevel (GHL). Your team can use your dialer or integrate with ours (Mojo or similar). We will supply:

•  Real-time outage leads and other homeowner data

•  Approved scripts and objection handling

•  Qualification criteria (homeowner, no existing battery, basic credit filters when applicable, etc.)

•  CRM access and appointment booking process

Performance Expectations

•  Consistent daily dialing volume with priority on fresh outage leads

•  Qualified appointments that show and meet our criteria

•  Accurate notes and dispositions in the CRM

•  Low no-show and disqualification rates

•  Fast response times on new outage alerts

Compensation

•  Hourly wage: $5–$8/hour

•  Plus bonuses based on performance (appointment quality, show rates, speed, and consistency)

Exact hourly rate and bonus structure will be confirmed based on experience level and results.



Requirements to Apply

Please include the following in your response:

1.  Company overview and how long you’ve operated as a call center

2.  Experience with solar, battery, home services, or similar outbound appointment setting

3.  Typical agent capacity you can dedicate

4.  Dialer/CRM platforms you use

5.  How you handle TCPA/DNC compliance

6.  Average show rates and quality metrics from similar campaigns

7.  References or case studies (if available)

8.  Ability to respond quickly to real-time lead flow



We are hiring call centers only. Individual agents or freelancers will not be considered.



Reply with the information above and we will follow up with next steps.

Project Coordination & Operational Support

Dynamic, supportive environment with opportunities to lead key operational initiatives.



Fully remote work model with stable US shift schedules.



Competitive compensation package and professional growth opportunities.

title: Marketing Agency Project Manager
description:
We're Not Hiring Someone to Simply "Check In on People."

 We're Hiring Someone Who Keeps Client Work Moving, Visible, and On Time.



PLEASE DO NOT REPLY DIRECTLY TO THIS POST. TO APPLY, FOLLOW THE STEPS AT THE END.

Pay: Negotiable flat rate per two-week period in USD, based on experience

 Pay Timing: Paid once every two weeks. Approximately 40 hours per pay period (about 20 hours per week), agreed upon at hire

 Location: Remote, Philippines-based applicants only

 Role Type: Part-time, long-term, with the potential for more hours as the agency grows

 Team Scope: Manages marketing projects across multiple ecommerce client brands, working with creative, copywriting, ads,
, development, and operations teams

 Agency Experience: Strongly preferred



Why This Role Exists

Most agency projects do not fail because the team lacks talent.



They fail because:

Client requests arrive faster than they get organized

Nobody is sure who owns the next step

Deadlines exist in someone's head instead of in the system

Work gets stuck between design, copy, and approval

One client's urgent request quietly delays three others

Blockers are discovered after the client is already waiting

Leadership cannot see what is actually happening across accounts



EcomIgnyte is a marketing agency serving multiple ecommerce brands. At any given time, we have designers, copywriters, media buyers,
 marketers, and developers working on campaigns, launches, and deliverables for different clients. That only works when the work is:

Clearly scoped and assigned

Tracked in one place

Moved through production without stalling

Followed up on consistently

Visible to leadership

Measured honestly



We're hiring a Marketing Agency Project Manager who lives inside ClickUp, keeps client work moving through our production pipeline, communicates clearly with every team member, and owns our Hubstaff time-tracking and reporting processes.



This role exists so:

Every client deliverable has an owner, a due date, and a clear status

Campaigns and launches ship on time across every brand

Work moves smoothly from brief to design, copy, review, and approval

Competing client priorities are managed deliberately, not by whoever asks loudest

Blockers are surfaced early, not after deadlines pass

Leadership gets accurate, organized reports on progress, time, and productivity



This is not about micromanaging people.

It is about running an agency production system where good people can do good work for many clients at once without confusion.



What You'll Actually Be Doing

Client Project and Campaign Management

Turn client requests, campaign briefs, and launch plans into organized projects and tasks in ClickUp

Manage marketing deliverables across multiple client brands, including ads,
s, landing pages, website updates, and creative assets

Move work through each production stage: brief, design, copy, internal review, revisions, client approval, and launch

Build realistic timelines that account for revisions and approval time

Track dependencies so one team is never waiting on another without anyone noticing

Balance competing priorities across clients and flag conflicts to leadership early

Keep campaign calendars and launch dates visible and up to date

ClickUp and Task Management



Make sure every task has a clear owner, due date, priority, and description

Monitor task statuses daily and identify anything overdue, stuck, or unclear

Keep ClickUp spaces, folders, and statuses clean and consistent across client accounts

Organize revisions, feedback, and approvals so nothing gets lost

Build and maintain templates and checklists for recurring agency work such as campaign launches,
 sends, and ad refreshes

Team Communication and Follow-Up

Message team members daily to check progress, confirm deadlines, and surface blockers

Follow up on overdue or stalled tasks clearly and professionally

Relay information and feedback between creative, copywriting, media buying,
, development, and leadership

Make sure client feedback reaches the right person in a clear, actionable form

Escalate issues to leadership when a client deliverable is at risk

Run or support short check-ins and keep notes on decisions and next steps

Hubstaff Processes and Reporting

Monitor Hubstaff daily for missing time, irregular hours, or low activity

Follow up with team members about gaps or inconsistencies in their tracked time

Manage Hubstaff member setup, projects, and to-dos as the team and client list change

Review and reconcile hours for each two-week pay period

Prepare the weekly team update for leadership, covering time worked and productivity for each team member

Flag patterns that need attention, such as consistently low hours or activity



You are not expected to design, write copy, run ads, or code.

You are expected to:

Know what everyone is working on, for which client, and when it is due

Understand how marketing work gets produced well enough to plan it realistically

Notice when something is off before it becomes a client problem

Communicate clearly, directly, and kindly

Keep systems organized without being told

Report honestly, even when the news is not good



This Role Is for Someone Who…

Has worked at a marketing, creative, or digital agency, or managed agency-style client work

Understands how campaigns, creative, and marketing deliverables move from brief to launch

Can work a consistent daily schedule, since daily follow-ups and Hubstaff checks matter more than total hours

Is naturally organized and gets satisfaction from a clean system

Can juggle many clients, deadlines, and team members at once

Is comfortable following up with people without being awkward or aggressive

Writes clear, concise messages in English

Notices small inconsistencies and wants to fix them

Is comfortable working with numbers, hours, and reports

Stays calm when a client changes direction or a deadline moves up

Takes ownership instead of waiting for instructions

Communicates early when something is behind or unclear



Experience that helps:

Project management at a marketing, advertising, creative, or digital agency

Managing multiple client accounts at the same time

Coordinating creative production (design, copy, video, ads,
)

Campaign and product launch planning

Ecommerce brands or Shopify stores

ClickUp, Asana, Monday, Trello, or similar project management tools

Hubstaff, Time Doctor, or similar time-tracking software

Managing remote teams

Google Sheets or Excel reporting

Slack or other team messaging tools



You do not need to be a certified project manager.

You do need:

An understanding of how agency work actually runs

Strong organizational instincts

Consistency and follow-through

Clear written communication

Attention to detail

The confidence to follow up with people

The discipline to keep systems updated every day



How You'll Work With the Team

Leadership and strategists set client goals, priorities, and campaign direction. You turn those into organized, scheduled, trackable work.

Designers, copywriters, media buyers,
 marketers, and developers produce the work. You make sure they know what to do, when it's due, who it's for, and who to talk to when they're stuck.

Clients depend on us to deliver on time. You make sure deadlines are realistic, work moves through review and approval smoothly, and nothing ships late without leadership knowing in advance.

Leadership needs visibility. You provide accurate updates on client work, time worked, and productivity so decisions can be made quickly.



You are not managing from a distance.

You are the connection point that keeps every client account and every team member aligned.



Why You'll Like Working Here

Clear workflows and expectations

A variety of ecommerce client brands and marketing projects

Organized tools and systems you can help improve

A team that values accountability and communication

Leadership that listens to process improvements

Long-term opportunities for growth

A team that cares about quality, clarity, and execution

We do not reward busywork.

We reward clarity, follow-through, and people who make the whole agency run better.

Application Process



PLEASE DO NOT JUST REPLY TO THIS POST ON THE JOB BOARD.

To be considered, you must complete all the steps below.



Step 1: Take a Short Online IQ Test

We respect intelligence, curiosity, and the ability to learn quickly.

Go to the Fast Learner Free IQ Test

Complete the test

RESPONSIBILITIES



Analyze competitor backlinks to identify legitimate link-building opportunities.

 communication.

Paid backlink placements or link packages.



Guest-post networks or bulk guest posting.

Automated or mass
 outreach.



Directory submissions or citation building.



Artificial backlinks created to manipulate search rankings.

Quality is more important than quantity.



WORKLOAD & COMPENSATION

Compensation may increase as responsibilities and results grow.
