title: Executive Assistant to CEO
description:
Executive Assistant to the CEO

Location: Remote

Schedule: Full-time, 8:15am to 5:15pm US Central Time

Reports to: CEO

Compensation: $1,800 to $2,500 USD/month, depending on experience

The role

Our CEO runs a fast-growing U.S. investment firm and moves quickly. He has more ideas, projects and
 than one person can handle. We're looking for someone smart enough to get inside his head and take work off his plate.

This is not a traditional admin role. You'll live in his inbox, learn how he thinks and what he's working on, and handle things the way he would. Over time you'll become the person who knows the context, makes the call, and only brings him what truly needs him.

We're a small team of five, so your work will be visible and it will matter.

What you'll own

His inbox. Read everything, sort what matters, and handle what you can. At first you'll meet with him a few times a day to agree on what to delete, what to answer and what needs him. The goal is for you to reply in his voice so he only sees what truly needs him.

His calendar. Keep it clean, protect his time and prepare him for what's next.

Open-ended projects. He'll hand you a one-line idea. You'll ask the right questions, research it, and turn it into a finished result.

Loose ends. Bills, follow-ups, documents and requests that land on his desk. Track them and close them.

Travel. Not frequent, but when he travels, get it exactly right.

Better systems. Spot what's manual or repeated and fix it, using AI and automation where it helps.

Who you are

Seriously smart. You pick things up fast and connect the dots without needing everything explained.

Highly organized. Nothing falls through the cracks, even with many things moving at once.

You ask before you assume. When something's unclear, you ask a sharp question rather than guess and go down the wrong path.

You speak up. When the workload is too much or something's off, you say so early.

Comfortable with speed and change. Priorities shift, and you shift with them without getting rattled.

Discreet. You'll see sensitive business and personal information. It stays with you.

Wants to grow. You see this as a path to becoming a true business partner, not just a job.

This role is probably not for you if you prefer clear, fixed routines, want detailed instructions for every task, or are mainly looking for property management, customer service or data entry work.

Requirements

Excellent written English. You'll write
s as the CEO.

A track record of high performance: promotions, awards, academic results or work you can point to.

Experience supporting a CEO, founder or senior executive is a plus, but not required. Intelligence and judgment matter more.

Strong with Google Workspace and comfortable learning new tools quickly.

Daily use of AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT.

Able to work US Central hours full-time, long term.

Reliable internet, backup power and a quiet place to work.

Hiring process

Online skills assessment

Short personality assessment

Call with our COO

Interview with the CEO

Reference calls with people you reported to directly

We move quickly and will keep you updated at each step.

title: Senior Project Manager | Digital Marketing Agency | SEO | Paid Ads | Website Development
description:
About Us:



We are a digital marketing agency with a 20-year track record specializing in SEO, paid advertising, and website development. We deliver measurable growth and reliable results for our clients nationwide. We are seeking an experienced Website Project Manager to oversee digital marketing, SEO campaigns, paid advertising campaigns, website design and development projects from initial planning through launch. This role will serve as the primary coordinator between clients, team, designers, developers, content teams, and agency leadership to ensure projects are delivered on time, on budget, and according to scope.



** We will hire a highly organized leader who is passionate about client service, project execution, process improvement, and delivering exceptional websites.



** Our current team in PH consists of over 14 people - many of them have been with us 10-15 years! This is a long term stable employment opportunity



Position Summary:



The Senior Project Manager will be fully responsible for managing the agency's deliverables across SEO, Paid Ads, and website development pipeline. This is a project leadership role requiring strong communication skills, technical understanding, organizational discipline, and the ability to coordinate multiple concurrent projects across various platforms and stakeholders.



The ideal candidate will be capable of independently managing project timelines, client communications, deliverables, scope management, quality assurance, and launch coordination while ensuring a consistent and professional client experience throughout the development process.



Key Responsibilities:



- Project Management & Delivery: Manage many client accounts and website projects simultaneously from discovery through launch while ensuring timelines, deliverables, and client expectations are met.

- Client Relationship Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for campaigns and website development process, providing regular updates, gathering feedback, managing approvals, and facilitating communication.

- Scope & Timeline Management: Define project requirements, establish timelines, track milestones, manage scope changes, and proactively identify project risks or delays.

- Team Coordination: Coordinate designers, developers, content writers, SEO specialists, and other stakeholders to ensure efficient project execution.

- Planning & Strategy: Participate in discovery sessions, sitemap planning, content organization, user experience discussions, and website architecture development.

- Developing SOP's, ClickUp task liss, instructions, process documents

- Holding the team accountable, owning all deliverables, improving processes, reporting on deficiencies.

- Quality Assurance: Conduct comprehensive QA reviews to identify issues related to design, functionality, responsiveness, forms, integrations, SEO implementation, and user experience.

- Launch Management: Coordinate website launches, migrations, redirects, DNS changes, tracking implementation, and post-launch testing.

- Documentation & SOP Development: Create and maintain project documentation, workflows, templates, checklists, and operational procedures.

- Resource Planning: Manage project workloads, priorities, and resource allocation across the website development team.

- Reporting: Provide leadership with project status updates, pipeline reports, resource forecasts, and operational recommendations.



Technical Responsibilities:



- Coordinate projects built on WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, Wix, Squarespace, and other CMS platforms.

- Manage design collaboration utilizing Figma, Adobe Creative Cloud, Canva, and related design tools.

- Coordinate implementation of SEO best practices, conversion optimization recommendations, analytics tracking, and third-party integrations.

- Facilitate communication regarding hosting, domains, DNS, SSL certificates, website migrations, and deployment requirements.

- 3+ years of website project management experience in a digital agency, web development company, or related environment.

- Experience managing multiple website projects simultaneously.

- Strong understanding of website development processes, timelines, and common technical requirements.

- Experience working with WordPress and other major CMS platforms.

- Excellent organizational and time management skills.

- Strong verbal and written communication abilities.

- Ability to manage client expectations and navigate challenging conversations professionally.

- Experience utilizing project management software such as ClickUp, Asana, 
, Jira, Trello, Basecamp, or similar platforms.

- Strong attention to detail and quality assurance processes.

- Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.



Preferred Qualifications:

- Experience working with WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, Wix, and Squarespace websites.

- Experience reviewing and collaborating on Figma designs.

- Familiarity with HTML, CSS, website hosting, DNS, SSL certificates, and website deployment processes.

- Understanding of SEO, CRO, website analytics, call tracking, and lead generation strategies.

- Experience managing offshore design and development teams.

- Digital marketing agency experience strongly preferred.

Why are you the best person to hire for this position?

How many years of website project management experience do you have?

You've grown an account's views before and can show the numbers

Links to 2–3 short-form videos you edited (your best, not your most recent)

The tools you work in

Your fastest realistic turnaround for a 30-second edit

title: AI Video Editor & Automation Specialist (Part-Time, Full-Time Potential)
description:
We're a fast-scaling US DTC health & wellness brand looking for an AI video editor who already has AI production workflows, reusable prompts and automation systems set up.



We don't want someone who simply knows how to use AI tools. We want someone who can produce AI ads FAST and proactively automate repetitive work.



AI ECOM ads only — no traditional UGC editing OR Youtube editors. Direct response experience is must.



WHAT YOU'LL CREATE



- AI human ads (Jack D Films-style)

- AI animated skits

- AI animated songs

- Other fully AI-generated ad concepts



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- Existing AI workflows, reusable prompts and systems for producing 5+ mins ads FAST

- Experience with tools like Higgsfield, Veo, Sora, Runway or similar MCPs

- Ability to turn scripts into complete AI-generated ads with minimal manual work but great quality

- Strong hooks, pacing, storytelling and creative instincts

- Someone who actively experiments with new tools and builds better workflows WITHOUT being asked



Experience connecting tools through Claude, MCPs, APIs or other automation systems is a major plus.



Knowing the tools isn't enough. Show us what you've automated.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Produce AI ad concepts using your existing workflows

- Turn scripts into finished ads with minimal manual work

- Review generations, fix inconsistencies and polish final edits

- Build and improve reusable prompts and automation systems

- Proactively find ways to increase production speed without sacrificing quality



TOOLS



- AI video generation: Higgsfield, Sunra MCP or similar

- Editing: CapCut or similar

- Automation: Claude, MCPs, APIs or similar



REQUIREMENTS



- You already have working AI ad-production workflows

- You can demonstrate your actual workflow, from script to finished ad

- You're proactive, reliable and fast

- You communicate clearly and meet deadlines



WORK ARRANGEMENT



- Starting part-time, with potential to move to full-time based on performance and workload

- Long-term opportunity for the right person



HOW TO APPLY



Applications missing any of the following will be rejected.



- Start your application with "AI Workflow Ready"

- Share 2–3 AI ads you've personally created, including an AI human ad or animated ad

- Send a short Loom showing your actual workflow, tools, prompts and automations. Blur anything confidential.

- How long does it take you to produce a 5-7 minute AI ad? What is automated versus manual?

- Share one AI workflow you've built proactively and how much time it saved



Generic applications and candidates who only use AI tools manually will not be considered.



Cheers!

Ash, Co-Founder

title: Female Part-Time Chat & Community Assistant for my Women's Coaching Business (2 hours/day)
description:
ABOUT ME

I'm Sokuntha Eam, founder of Sovereign Queen™, a coaching business for high-achieving professional women. I'm a certified coach based in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. My business grows through warm, personal conversations on
 Messenger, and I'm looking for someone who can hold those conversations with the same care I would.



THE ROLE IN ONE SENTENCE

You will hold Messenger conversations on my behalf, in my voice, and help each woman take the next step that is right for her.



Because you will be writing as me, in private conversations with women about personal and sometimes sensitive topics, this role is for a female assistant.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Continue conversations with women who have connected with me on
. This is most of the role.

- Read each conversation carefully and reply to what the person actually said, not just follow a script

- Invite women to my free
 community, challenges, workshops and events when the moment is right

- Recognise when a conversation needs me personally, and pass it to me with a short summary

- Keep my CRM in GoHighLevel up to date: move each woman to the right stage of the client journey and leave one clear note per conversation, every day

- Send me a short end-of-day report

- Edit one short reel a week from footage and a brief I provide

- Support each of my online challenges (every 1 to 2 months): approve participants into the challenge
 group, reply to their daily homework posts, and upload session recordings to GoHighLevel



YOU ARE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

- Write natural, warm English messages and adapt your tone to each person

- Notice details: names, what someone said last week, a missing link, a wrong date

- Think before you reply, and ask me when something is unclear

- Tell me straight away when you make a mistake, fix it, and learn from it

- Work independently and manage your own time without daily reminders

- Have basic video editing skills (CapCut, Canva or similar) for short reels



EXPERIENCE THAT HELPS

Customer relations, community management, appointment setting, or social media engagement for a coach or service business. Experience keeping a CRM up to date, ideally GoHighLevel, is a strong plus. A portfolio or example messages are a plus.



SCHEDULE AND PAY

- 2 hours per day, Monday to Friday, at $3 per hour

- About 1 hour over the weekend when needed

- Live bootcamps once or twice a year: Saturday and Sunday, about 6 hours a day, supporting me online

- A weekly Monday team meeting where I train you and give feedback, which is not counted in paid hours

- Selection includes a short paid trial task. I make all payments, including the trial, through Wise, so you will need a Wise account



HOW TO APPLY

To show you have read this post carefully, start your message with the words "Chat & Community" and answer this question in 3 to 5 sentences:



A woman you have been chatting with replies: "Sorry for the late reply, I only check Messenger now and then." What would you write back, and why?



I read every application myself. Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.

title: Content Operations & Quality Control Specialist
description:
The Job Description Template

Job Title: Content Operations & Quality Control Specialist



Employment Type: Full-Time, Remote (Philippines)



Reporting To: Founder, Head of marketing.



About the Role

We are looking for a meticulous, highly disciplined, and systems-oriented professional to take complete ownership of our content publishing and distribution pipeline.



We do not need you to write copy, invent creative strategies, or design graphics. Our leadership team produces all finalized text, video, and audio assets. Your sole focus is flawless execution and quality control. You will be the final line of defense before our brand speaks to the world, ensuring that every post, link, tag, and asset is published with zero errors, on time, every single time.



If you are someone who naturally double-checks their work, finds satisfaction in immaculate organization, and takes deep pride in personal accountability, this is a stable, high-trust, long-term role.



What You Will Own (Responsibilities)



Zero-Defect Publishing: Take pre-approved assets and exact copy, format them natively, and publish/schedule them across [LinkedIn, Instagram, X, YouTube, etc.] with 100% operational accuracy.



Meticulous Quality Assurance: Run a strict pre-publish checklist. Verifying correct account tagging, working link shorteners, bug-free formatting, proper line breaks, and error-free copy alignment.



Asset Hygiene & Database Management: Keep our cloud drives (Google Drive, Notion, Asana) impeccably organized. Maintain strict file-naming conventions and status tracking so any team member can find any asset instantly.



Platform Monitoring & Verification: Verify that scheduled posts publish correctly without technical platform failures. Immediately triage, log, and resolve any formatting or delivery issues.



Process Improvement: Help us refine and optimize our publishing SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) to make the operational workflow smoother, faster, and more foolproof over time.



What You Bring to the Table (Requirements)



Obsessive Attention to Detail: You are naturally bothered by small errors (a dead link, a misaligned margin, a missing tag). Precision is your default state, not something you have to force.



High Conscientiousness & Accountability: You do not wait to be micromanaged. Once a process is assigned to you, leadership can consider it completely handled with absolute peace of mind.



Platform Literacy: Deep familiarity with native publishing features across major platforms (e.g., knowing how link previews generate on LinkedIn vs. X, or character limits per platform).



Systems-Minded: Experience utilizing project management and scheduling software (e.g., Notion, Asana, Buffer, Metricool, Airtable).



Professional Maturity: High respect for confidentiality, strict adherence to deadlines, and clear written English communication.



Why Join Us?



Clear Expectations: Zero guesswork. You will always have exact assets, copy, and established protocols.



Respect for Structure: We appreciate people who love systems, and we won't throw last-minute chaotic demands at you without clear direction.



High-Trust Environment: We hire diligent professionals and give them total autonomy over their workflow.



Competitive Compensation: High diligence and extreme reliability are rare; we offer top-of-market compensation to reward long-term accuracy.



How to Apply



To demonstrate the level of care this role requires, please follow these instructions carefully:



Send your application with the exact subject line: "Flawless Execution Specialist - [Your Name]".



Attach your resume.



Include a brief, 3-step checklist of the exact things you double-check before hitting "publish" on a high-stakes social media post.



(Note: Applications that skip these instructions will not be reviewed.)

title: Real Estate Phone Expert
description:
About the role:

We're a townhome development company actively acquiring land in Arizona, and we're looking for a full-time acquisitions specialist who is genuinely great on the phone — someone who builds instant rapport, earns trust fast, and knows how to close deals. This is a full-time, long-term remote role with room to grow as we scale into new markets.



You'll be the voice of our company on the phone — reaching out to property owners, connecting with real estate agents and brokers, building relationships, handling objections, and guiding sellers all the way to a signed agreement.



This role is for a skilled closer who thrives on rapport and loves getting deals done.



What you'll do:



Outbound calls to property owners, agents, and brokers

Build genuine rapport and earn trust fast

Qualify sellers (motivation, timeline, property details)

Handle objections and drive conversations toward a deal

Present offers, negotiate, and close signed agreements

Handle inbound calls and same-day callbacks

Persistent follow-up via call, text, and

Keep notes organized in our CRM



What makes you a fit — you're an acquisitions specialist who:



Builds rapport instantly — people trust you and open up within the first minute

Closes — you move a hesitant seller from "maybe" to "yes" and get it signed

Is confident on the phone — you enjoy the work and don't get rattled by rejection

Handles objections smoothly and keeps deals moving

Knows the acquisitions game — real estate, land, or development acquisitions experience strongly preferred (wholesaling, land acquisition, investor call teams, US real estate calling)



What we're looking for:



Excellent, clear spoken English with a warm, confident, trustworthy phone presence

Experience calling US property owners and agents strongly preferred

A natural relationship builder and closer — this is your core strength

Proven acquisitions / sales results — you can point to deals you've closed

Self-motivated, resilient, and persistent — never lets a lead go cold

Reliable, dedicated, and looking for a long-term home

Comfortable with CRM tools, texting, and

Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet, professional calling environment



Hours & Schedule:



Full-time, Monday–Friday

9:00 AM – 5:00 PM PST

Long-term, ongoing role for the right person



To apply: Please include a short 1–2 minute voice recording so we can hear your phone presence.



We're building something for the long term and want a dedicated acquisitions specialist who's a natural at rapport and closing, wants a stable full-time role, and takes pride in getting deals done. If that's you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Remote PI & Litigation Support Specialist
description:
Contract Position | California Law Office | Remote

A small and growing California law office is seeking an experienced, highly organized, and dependable Remote PI & Litigation Support Specialist to provide ongoing administrative and case-support services for personal injury matters, civil litigation, and general law-office operations.

This is a start-up / growing law practice, not a high-volume law firm. The current caseload is manageable, and the position is not expected to involve the volume or pace typically associated with a large personal injury firm. The goal is to find a reliable long-term professional who can help the attorney manage the existing caseload efficiently and grow with the practice over time.

The ideal candidate will have prior experience supporting a U.S. law firm, preferably in personal injury and/or civil litigation.

The contractor will work closely with and under the supervision of a California attorney. The role requires excellent spoken and written English, professional client communication skills, strong attention to detail, and substantial availability during California business hours.

Primary Responsibilities

Client and Prospective Client Communications

Answer incoming law-office telephone calls during agreed coverage hours.

Professionally identify yourself as law-office support staff.

Communicate with existing clients regarding appointments, document requests, treatment updates, scheduling, and other administrative matters.

Conduct preliminary intake of prospective clients using attorney-approved questionnaires and procedures.

Obtain factual information from prospective and existing clients.

Schedule consultations with the attorney.

Follow up with clients concerning requested records, documents, photographs, treatment information, insurance information, and other case-related materials.

Maintain accurate notes of telephone calls,
s, messages, and client communications.

Promptly escalate substantive legal questions, settlement questions, complaints, emergencies, or unusual issues to the supervising attorney.

Personal Injury Case Support

Communicate with medical providers, treatment facilities, record custodians, and billing departments.

Request and follow up on medical records and itemized billing.

Obtain treatment status and appointment information.

Track medical providers, treatment dates, outstanding records, bills, balances, and liens.

Communicate with providers regarding lien documentation and attorney-authorized lien-reduction requests.

Convey attorney-approved settlement or lien proposals without independently determining legal strategy or settlement terms.

Organize medical records, billing records, photographs, insurance documents, correspondence, and other case materials.

Prepare treatment chronologies, billing summaries, and case-status summaries for attorney review.

Communicate with insurance companies and adjusters regarding administrative matters, claim status, records, correspondence, and attorney-approved requests.

Track claim numbers, adjuster information, insurance correspondence, outstanding requests, and deadlines.

Assist in preparing personal injury demand packages under attorney supervision.

Assist with settlement documentation, releases, lien resolution, settlement checks, and case-closing procedures as directed by the attorney.

Civil Litigation and Court Support

Maintain litigation calendars and deadline-tracking systems.

Calendar hearings, case management conferences, discovery deadlines, filing deadlines, service deadlines, and other dates identified by the attorney.

Assist with preparation and formatting of pleadings, motions, declarations, notices, discovery documents, correspondence, exhibits, and other litigation materials.

Prepare document shells and drafts from attorney instructions and approved templates.

Assemble, organize, paginate, bookmark, and label exhibits.

Prepare routine proofs of service and filing-related documents.

Electronically file court documents after attorney review and authorization.

Coordinate electronic and other service of documents.

Monitor e-filing confirmations and rejected filings and promptly report any filing issue to the attorney.

Monitor court dockets and case activity when requested.

Communicate with court clerks and e-filing providers regarding procedural or administrative filing matters when appropriate.

Assist with discovery organization and document production.

Assist with deposition, hearing, mediation, arbitration, and trial preparation.

Maintain complete and organized electronic litigation files.

Law Office Administration

Maintain the attorney's calendar and task-reminder system.

Monitor designated law-office
 accounts and telephone messages.

Maintain organized electronic client files.

Prepare routine correspondence from attorney instructions or approved templates.

Coordinate electronic signatures and document execution.

Track outstanding tasks and follow-ups for active matters.

Assist with opening and closing client files.

Perform other administrative and case-support functions reasonably related to the services described above.

Required Qualifications

Excellent spoken and written English.

Clear, professional telephone communication skills.

Strong organizational ability and attention to detail.

Ability to manage multiple active matters, deadlines, and follow-up tasks.

Reliable high-speed internet connection.

Quiet and professional remote working environment suitable for confidential client communications.

Strong proficiency with Microsoft Word,
, PDF software, cloud-based document systems, and online portals.

Ability to learn and use California court electronic-filing systems.

Ability to follow detailed written procedures and attorney instructions.

Strong judgment regarding when an issue must be escalated to the attorney.

Commitment to strict confidentiality and professionalism.

Reliable availability during agreed service hours that substantially overlap with California Pacific Time business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

Preference will be given to candidates with:

Prior experience supporting a U.S. law firm.

Personal injury law-firm experience.

California law-firm experience.

Civil litigation experience.

Experience speaking with U.S. clients by telephone.

Experience communicating with medical providers and insurance adjusters.

Experience requesting medical records and itemized billing.

Experience with medical liens and lien-resolution administration.

Experience preparing or organizing personal injury demand packages.

Experience with litigation calendaring and deadline management.

Experience formatting and electronically filing California court documents.

Experience using law-practice-management or case-management software.

Work Arrangement

The position is fully remote.

Because the role includes communications with California clients, medical providers, insurance companies, courts, and other law offices, the contractor must have substantial availability during agreed California Pacific Time business hours, including reliable telephone coverage during the agreed service window.

The specific schedule and scope of services will be discussed with the selected candidate.

Compensation; $5 per hour

Application Requirements

Please submit:

Resume or CV.

Brief description of prior U.S. law-firm experience.

Description of personal injury experience, if any.

Description of civil litigation and court-filing experience, if any.

Description of experience communicating with clients, medical providers, insurance companies, or courts.

Availability during California Pacific Time.

Expected compensation.

Brief description of home-office and internet setup.

Professional references, if available.

Shortlisted candidates may be asked to participate in a video interview and complete a brief practical exercise involving client communication, case organization, or document preparation.

title: Customer Success Representative- Remote
description:
DreamStart Labs is seeking a remote-based contractor to help us scale up an exciting mobile app called DreamSave in the Philippines market. DreamSave, which targets village savings groups and informal community banks, is currently in production in multiple countries in Africa, Asia, and Latin America. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants to work for an exciting technology company, helping millions of people around the world achieve their dreams of a better life. 



ABOUT DREAMSTART LABS 

DreamStart Labs is a social impact technology startup headquartered in the United States. Our mission is to help people in developing countries realize their dreams of a better life. We deliver world-class mobile and cloud solutions that help these amazing dreamers break the cycle of poverty through entrepreneurship, financial inclusion, and smart investments. 



ABOUT DREAMSAVE 

Our flagship product is an award-winning mobile app called DreamSave. It runs on a smartphone and is used by bookkeepers of savings groups to manage every aspect of a group. Today, groups use paper ledger books to record savings and loan transactions for their group. DreamSave acts as a “digital ledger”, replacing paper and ensuring accurate record-keeping. Individual members can also use DreamSave to view their savings groups and see their balances at any time. 



ROLE DESCRIPTION 

As our Customer Success representative, you will serve as the primary presence of DreamStart Labs in the Philippines market. You will report to the Regional Manager based in Uganda and work closely with our partner staff members and local savings groups in the Philippines  Market. Your responsibilities will be divided into a few main areas: 

Training – You will be the primary person responsible for training the local partner staff on how to use DreamSave, including setting up groups, running meetings, answering questions, and troubleshooting problems. 



Support – The most important aspect of your role will be supporting our partners and our groups with excellent service as they use the DreamSave app. This will require being highly responsive when questions arise and helping to resolve them quickly. Some of these problems will require simple user education, while others will involve troubleshooting technical issues and working with the DreamStart Labs team to ensure users get a resolution promptly. 



Represent DSL—The Customer Success Representative will act as our business representative in the Philippines, occasionally speaking or presenting at conferences, workshops, stakeholder meetings, and sometimes on local radio and television programs or advertisements. The Customer Success Representative must be professional and enthusiastic about DreamStart Labs and our products in all interactions with current and potential clients and other stakeholders.



Translation – Preferably, the Customer Success Rep should be fluent in speaking and writing in Tagalog, on top of English. Throughout this role, there may be a need to translate materials for training or support purposes. When this is needed, we may ask you to translate materials for the local market or record videos in a local language for local partners and groups. 



DESIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE 

- The ideal candidate will have a good cross-section of the following skills and experience: 

- Passionate believer in our mission to help people in need 

- Great people skills, with a proven ability to solve problems 

- Ability to remain calm and patient in stressful situations 

- Mindset of friendly service and supportive mentoring 

- Excellent trainer with good communication skills 

- High integrity and hard-working with less supervision 

- Good project planning and project management skills 

- Good skills with Android smartphones and is very comfortable using them 

- Comfortable using web-based tools for collaboration, support, and working from home

- College degree strongly preferred 

- General knowledge of savings, lending, and microfinance

- Demonstrate strong written and spoken English proficiency. All interviews and assessments will be conducted in English. 



KEY SUPPORT SUCCESS CRITERIA 

Key success factors for the support part of this role will include the following: 

- Be a DreamSave Expert. To be successful in this role, you will need to become an expert with the DreamSave app. You will spend time using the app yourself, engaging in ongoing discussions and training with the global Customer Success team, learning all the support tools, and staying current with the latest features, bug fixes, tips, and tricks. Our partners and groups in the Philippines Market should be able to look to you as the #1 expert on how to excel with DreamSave. 

- Be Positive and Professional. You will be the face of DreamStart Labs with our strategic partners and end-users. The way you treat our users will be a reflection of us. It is critical that our users feel loved, appreciated, and respected. Every interaction should be respectful, encouraging, and supportive. It’s not just about providing support, it’s about going above and beyond to delight our partners and end users.

- Be Responsive. In this kind of role, it is important to be responsive and available when a team member, partner, or end user contacts you. For most day-to-day communications, you will need to respond the same day whenever possible. For urgent support issues, the response time may need to be quicker. For example, if a group has everyone gathered together for a meeting and there is a problem with the app, they may need someone who can answer a support call and help them while they are at their meeting. If they can’t reach our support representative during a time of need, they will not feel supported. This is especially important in the first few months when everything is new, and partners and groups are forming their first impressions about DreamStart Labs. 

- Be Proactive. You will be our representative in the Philippines regions, so you will need to be proactive in watching what is happening in the field and keeping DreamStart Labs informed. If you see potential problems or have ideas for improvement, you should bring them to our attention ASAP. This role is not just about waiting for a task list of action items. It’s your role to be passionate about the success of DreamSave and constantly look for opportunities to help us succeed together. 

- Listen and Learn. When you talk with partners and users about problems or questions, your first job is to listen and make sure you understand the situation. The better you understand the situation, the better you will be able to help them. It’s also important to make sure they know we care about them and want them to succeed. 

- Help Solve Problems. Some users may contact you with a problem with the app or a question about something they don’t understand. In these cases, your job is to help them solve these issues as quickly as possible, working with the rest of the DreamStart Labs team. 

- Report Ideas, Suggestions, and Bugs. Savings groups will undoubtedly have ideas for improvements in DreamSave. Since software is always evolving, there will also be problems discovered along the way. Your job will be to collect all these ideas and issues, document them clearly in the support tools we provide, and follow up on them as needed. 



LOCATION OF ROLE

We prefer someone located in or near Cebu, Manila, and Iloilo cities. However, the right candidate will need to have the flexibility to travel within all Philippine regions. It will also be important to be connected with our internal team, partners, and end-users. To be successful, you will need to attend internal team meetings, be active on our Slack-based workspace, ask questions and share your ideas and experiences, attend field training in person when possible, and visit groups when possible to learn from them and make sure they feel like they are getting excellent service.



TERM OF THE ROLE 

Our intent is for this to be an ongoing role in the Philippines Market space. The best way to ensure this is to delight our partners and end users. If the partners and groups you support are successful and our business grows, this role will continue as a long-term position.



TIME EXPECTATIONS 

While there is no firm hourly commitment, to be successful in this role, most CS reps starting in a new country spend an average of about 30 hours a week. Some weeks it will be fewer hours and some weeks more, but you should expect to spend about this much time, on average.



COMPENSATION

Salary Range: US $350 monthly

Health benefits of up to US $700 per year

Communications stipend: approximately US $50 per month

Job Aid allowance: US $100 per year

Opportunity for performance-based bonuses based on exceptional job performance and proactive initiative-taking.

Costs for transportation, meals, and accommodation while traveling shall either be pre-arranged or be covered through an advance/reimbursement.



HOW TO APPLY

To apply for this position, fill out the application form from this link: 



NOTE: The deadline to submit applications for this role is 13th November, 2026.

title: CEO
description:
About the Role



This is not a virtual assistant position. You will run our online channels the way a general manager runs a business. You will report directly to our CEO, lead a small team of platform specialists, and be responsible for one clear goal: building our online business to USD 3 million in annual sales within 18 months. If you have ever wanted to be treated as the owner of a business instead of a task worker, and you have the experience to hit a target like this, this role is built for you.



Our 18 Month Goal



- Month 6: online sales of USD 100,000 per month

- Month 12: online sales of USD 175,000 per month

- Month 18: online sales of USD 250,000 per month, a USD 3 million annual run rate

- All growth must be profitable, with advertising spend kept within agreed limits



Compensation



- Base salary of PHP 120,000 to 130,000 per month, based on experience

- Quarterly performance bonus based on growth in online gross profit

- Milestone bonuses paid when each of the month 6, 12, and 18 targets is reached

- Eligibility for a long term profit sharing arrangement after 12 months for the right person

- Paid time off and holidays

- A direct relationship with the CEO and real authority to make decisions



We currently sell one brand online and are preparing to launch our second brand along with several new products. Your mission is to lead that expansion and build our online business into a major sales channel for the company. Within your first six months, we expect our second brand and new products to be live across our online channels. By month 12, we are targeting online sales of USD 70,000 to 110,000 per month. By month 18, our committed goal is USD 125,000 per month, with a stretch goal of USD 250,000 per month, which represents a USD 3 million annual run rate. All growth must be profitable, with advertising spend kept within agreed limits, and bonuses are significantly larger for reaching the stretch goal.



Your base salary will be PHP 120,000 to 130,000 per month, based on experience, plus a 13th month payment each December. When our second brand and new products are successfully launched within your first six months, you will receive a USD 1,500 launch bonus. Starting in month 7, you will earn a quarterly bonus equal to 5 percent of the growth in our online contribution profit, which is net sales after product costs, platform fees, fulfillment, advertising, and returns. You will also earn milestone bonuses of USD 2,000 for reaching the month 12 committed goal or USD 4,000 for reaching the stretch goal, and USD 4,000 for reaching the month 18 committed goal or USD 10,000 for reaching the stretch goal. After 12 months, the right person will also become eligible for a long term profit sharing arrangement in the online business. If we reach USD 3 million together, your total earnings will place you among the best compensated ecommerce leaders in the Philippines.

How to Apply



Please send:

- Your resume

- A short summary of 2 to 3 online stores or brands you managed, including what you grew sales from and to

- A 2 to 3 minute video introducing yourself and explaining how you would approach growing a food and beverage brand to USD 3 million in online sales in 18 months

Phoenix is committed to multiplying leaders, not simply adding staff. Here, you’ll be part of a mission-driven culture with high expectations, strong support, and room to grow.

title: SEO Specialist  On-Page SEO - GMB & Weekly Reporting
description:
Salary: $800–$1,000 USD/month, based on demonstrated skill

Hours: 40 hrs/week · 

Type: Full-time, long-term



About us

Local Interactive is a New York–based SEO agency, in business since 2007. We run search programs for healthcare, behavioral health, and multi-location brands. We’re a small team with real accounts and no link packages or ranking guarantees.



The problem I’m hiring to solve

Daily on-page work and weekly client reporting across my accounts all run through me, and that’s why strategy work isn’t getting done.



What you’ll actually own



- Daily on-page optimization in WordPress (Rank Math/Yoast): titles, metas, headings, internal links, content refreshes



- Structured data: writing, implementing, and validating JSON-LD schema 

   (LocalBusiness, MedicalOrganization, FAQ, Article, Breadcrumb, Service) and fixing errors flagged in Search Console



- Finding the pages that are one good edit away from page one, using Search Console query data



- Keyword mapping and content briefs our writers can execute without asking questions



- Spotting technical issues (indexing, redirects, canonicals) and flagging them with a clear recommendation



- A weekly written update per client: what moved, what you did, what’s next



You’ll work directly with me. Your changes go live, and you’ll see what they do.



Who this is for

You have three or more years of hands-on SEO, ideally at an agency, managing several sites at once. You can open a GSC query report and tell me which pages to work on this week and why. You can write JSON-LD by hand, not just toggle a plugin setting, and you know how to validate it with the Rich Results Test and Schema Markup Validator. You’re fast and clean in WordPress, and you use Ahrefs or SEMrush and Screaming Frog in your real workflow, not just on your resume. You write clear English; we work across a 12-hour time difference, so almost everything is written. When you apply, please use the exact subject line “Pandesal — SEO Specialist” so I know you read the full posting. You use AI tools with judgment and can tell me where they help and where they don’t.



Who this is not for

If your approach includes guaranteed rankings, bulk backlink packages, PBNs, or “high DA” links, we’re not a fit. The same goes if you need a task list handed to you every morning.



Good to know: programmatic SEO (templated pages at scale, e.g. location or service pages) · local SEO and Google Business Profiles · healthcare or addiction-treatment experience · automation (Make/Zapier) · AI search visibility



What we offer



Paid via PayPal

Long-term, stable work with a growing team

Paid skills assessment ($30 for about 90 minutes) and a paid first week. I don’t ask for free work.



How to apply



1- Your resume, plus two sites you’ve worked on, with what you specifically did on each



2- Answers to the three questions below, in your own words. Short is fine; vague is not.



3- A Loom video, 3 minutes max (
, free), sharing your screen. Show me:

       -One SEO case study you personally delivered. Open the client’s live Google Search Console with the date range visible     

         and show the traffic increase, before and after. Then show the rankings you moved, live in Search Console or 

         Ahrefs/SEMrush. Tell me what you did that caused it.



     - One piece of technical work you’re proud of, such as structured data you implemented, shown in the page source or the 

        Rich Results Test, or a technical fix and its result.

         

You may blur client names or domains if you’re under NDA. Screenshots alone won’t be accepted; I want to see the live account.



Questions



1. A client’s service page ranks #9 for its main term, with 1,200 monthly impressions and a 0.8% CTR. You have 90 minutes on it today. What do you do, in order?



2. What’s one piece of SEO advice you see repeated constantly that you think is wrong or overrated? Why?



3. How would you put together a weekly SEO update for a client? What goes in, what do you leave out, and which part, if any, would you use AI for?

description:

Turn your negotiation skills into serious income.

Build and manage a pipeline of qualified acquisition leads

What You Bring

Sharp negotiation and people skills — you can build trust fast

An eye for property value and investment potential

Self-discipline to manage your own pipeline remotely

Why SB Home Buyers

Ready to Close Your Next Deal?

Send your resume and a short video telling us why you're the right fit

title: Senior Mental Health Biller
description:
Position: Senior Mental Health Biller

Employment Type: Full-time

Hours: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM CST



About Us:

Blue Kite Wellness is a reputable and rapidly expanding behavioral health organization dedicated to providing high-quality services to individuals and communities. We provide mental and behavioral health care to clients across Illinois. We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Senior Mental Health Biller to join our offshore team. This role requires strong English communication skills, as you will interact with U.S. insurance agencies, clinicians, and administrative staff.



Responsibilities:

> Prepare and submit claims for mental health services (telehealth, diagnostic evaluations, psychotherapy, IM+CANS, H codes).

> Manage primary and secondary claim submissions across multiple insurance carriers.

> Ensure claims include proper documentation and modifiers according to payer guidelines.

> Track and manage follow-up tasks, including claim corrections, pending authorizations, and missing documentation.

> Support submission of appeals within timely filing limits.

> Collaborate with U.S.-based clinical and administrative teams to resolve billing questions and discrepancies.

> File appeals and rejections.

> Mentor or guide junior billing staff as needed.



Qualifications:

> Proven experience in mental health billing, including outpatient and clinic services.

> Knowledge of CPT, ICD, and mental health-specific codes (IM+CANS, H codes, psychotherapy, telehealth).

> Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple billing tasks and deadlines.

> Excellent English communication skills for interacting with U.S. teams and insurance agencies.

> Available to work within the 8AM - 5PM CST timeframe.

Preferred:

> Familiarity with U.S. Medicaid, MCO, or commercial insurance billing.

> Experience with wraparound programs or behavioral health-specific billing procedures.

> Prior experience in a senior or leadership role in billing.

title: eCommerce Virtual Assistant
description:
Our remote team is growing, and we need an eCommerce VA who is reliable, self-driven, and sharp with details, someone who wants a real career with us, not just a stopgap. We run the daily operations of online brands for clients around the world, and you'll support several of them at once. No two days look alike. Expect busy task lists, last-minute changes, fast turnarounds, and priorities that shift quickly. We need someone who stays organized, follows our processes, handles pressure well, and keeps quality high when things get hectic.



Role details:

- Start date: as soon as possible

- Full-time, long-term

- Graveyard shift (Philippine time), Monday to Friday

- Weekends off

- Occasionally, we may ask for extra hours for urgent client requests or deadlines. It won't be every day, but flexibility matters in our fast-paced setting.



What you'll do:

- Run and maintain Shopify, WooCommerce, and Amazon stores

- Build, edit, and optimize product listings

- Research products, competitors, and market trends

- Help with customer support and order handling

- Keep websites updated and take care of general admin

- Support our marketing and content work

- Create simple graphics and marketing visuals in Canva

- Make basic layout and design improvements to websites

- Use ChatGPT and other AI tools to work faster and more accurately

- Follow our systems, SOPs, checklists, and instructions

- Manage tasks across multiple client accounts

- Respond quickly to updates and requests during your shift

- Keep your work organized and on time during busy periods



As you prove your reliability, we'll give you more: greater independence with client accounts and bigger, higher-value projects.



Who we're looking for:

- You have hands-on Shopify experience: product listings, store updates, theme edits, and order management

- You learn fast and can figure things out on your own

- You're highly organized with a sharp eye for detail

- You own your work and take accountability for results

- You follow instructions closely and meet deadlines

- You communicate clearly and professionally

- You're hardworking and proactive

- You thrive in a fast-moving environment

- You stay calm and professional with urgent requests

- You have a reliable laptop or desktop and a stable, fast internet connection

- You're fully available for the entire shift

- You have no other job, clients, business, or personal commitments that could affect your availability, focus, or performance



Bonus skills (not required):

- Experience with WooCommerce, Amazon, or TikTok Shop

- Canva or basic graphic design skills

- A good eye for clean layouts and visual presentation

- Experience with ChatGPT or other AI tools

- Basic video editing in CapCut

- A background in virtual assistance, eCommerce, customer service, or admin work



Beyond Shopify, experience isn't everything. We value discipline, attitude, consistency, honesty, and reliability over years on a resume. We can teach you the other platforms and tools, but the right mindset and commitment have to come from you on day one.



Pay and growth:

- Monthly salary: ₱28,000 to ₱32,000

- Monthly performance incentive: up to ₱5,000, based on performance

- ₱1,500 signing bonus after completing the probationary period

-₱2,500 referral bonus for every person you refer who gets hired and passes probation 

-Regular salary increases based on performance

- A clear path to promotion and bigger responsibilities

- Room to grow into senior and leadership roles

- Long-term stability for consistent top performers



Why join us:

- Build a stable, long-term career with an established eCommerce agency

- Work within clear systems and processes

- Get proper guidance, training, and regular performance feedback

- Gain hands-on skills in Shopify, Amazon, WooCommerce, and TikTok Shop

- Work with AI, automation, and modern digital tools

- Get real experience with international eCommerce brands

- Develop skills that lead to senior and leadership positions



This isn't for everyone

We're not looking for someone who waits to be told what to do and does only the minimum. We want someone who takes initiative, works smart, thinks critically, stays focused, and owns the outcome. The work can get intense and priorities can change fast, so you need to be comfortable adapting and handling several responsibilities at once without letting quality drop. Above all, we want someone who plans to grow with us for the long haul.



If you're after a temporary gig, side income, an easy job, or something to do on top of another commitment, this probably isn't the right fit.



How to apply

Please send us:

- Your updated resume

- A screenshot of your internet speed test

- Your computer specs: device or model, processor, RAM, and storage

- A short cover letter introducing yourself, sharing your relevant experience (especially your Shopify work), and telling us why you're the right person for this role



Important: Put "ECOMMERCE VA - (YOUR NAME)" in your
 subject line. Applications without it may be skipped, since it shows us you read the full post.



One last thing

This is a long-term role with real room to grow. We're looking for someone ready to fully commit and become a reliable part of our team. You must not have other jobs, clients, or commitments that could get in the way of your schedule, availability, focus, productivity, or performance.



If you're disciplined, driven, eager to learn, and ready to build a serious career in eCommerce, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Onboarding and Listing Manager (Short Term Rental)
description:
We are a short-term rental co-hosting company managing roughly 56 properties across 15 states. We operate under a co-hosting model — property owners retain their listings, reviews, and branding while we handle operations, guest experience, pricing, cleaning, maintenance, and reporting. We compete on quality, not quantity, and we onboard 1–2 new properties per month with a target of scaling to 200 properties by 2028.



Onboarding is the foundation of every client relationship. A property that is onboarded correctly generates clean, stable operations for years. A property that is onboarded poorly generates ongoing friction that drains the entire operations team. We are hiring for an Onboarding & Listing Specialist who owns this function end-to-end.



Role Mission

Take every new property from signed contract to first booking in a defined, repeatable, high-quality process. You are the first operational touchpoint for every new owner and the architect of the conditions under which every other tea
mber succeeds or struggles.



Key Outcomes (What Success Looks Like in 90 Days)

• Time from signed contract to first live booking: under 21 days on 90%+ of new properties.

• Owner satisfaction score on onboarding: 9/10 or higher measured via post-onboarding survey.

• Zero listing errors at go-live — amenities, photos, pricing, house rules, and descriptions verified and correct.

• Pricing strategy configured correctly on day one — dynamic pricing tools set up with appropriate base rates, seasonality, and event-based adjustments.

• Full operational handoff document complete for every new property before go-live — cleaning, maintenance, guest experience, and pricing teams receive complete information.

• Onboarding SOP maintained and improved quarterly based on what worked and what broke.



Core Responsibilities



Owner-Facing Onboarding

• Conduct the kickoff call with every new owner — welcome, process walkthrough, expectations, timeline.

• Collect all property-specific information: access, utilities, insurance, HOA rules, owner preferences, existing bookings to honor.

• Set and manage owner expectations on timeline, pricing strategy, and what they can expect from Divergent through onboarding and beyond.

• Serve as the primary contact for the owner during the onboarding period, then warm-handoff to ongoing management.

Listing Build & Optimization

• Build new listings on Airbnb, VRBO, and direct booking platforms (owner retains listing ownership in the co-hosting model).

• Coordinate professional photography when needed; optimize photo order for conversion.

• Write compelling listing titles, descriptions, house rules, and amenity tagging.

• Verify all listing details against the actual property — amenities present, safety items in place, access instructions accurate.



Pricing Setup

• Configure dynamic pricing tools (PriceLabs, Wheelhouse, or equivalent) with correct base rates, minimum stays, and seasonality curves.

• Identify local events and demand patterns; configure event-based pricing rules.

• Partner with the pricing lead on mid-term rental (MTR) strategy when applicable.

• Set and document pricing assumptions so ongoing management can adjust as data comes in.

Operational Handoff

• Document everything the cleaning, maintenance, and guest experience teams need: supply PAR levels, cleaner assignment, maintenance vendors, guest communication templates, property-specific quirks.

• Ensure the first cleaning, first inspection, and first supply order are complete before the first guest arrives.

• Walk the ongoing management team through the property in a formal handoff meeting within the first 14 days.

Process Improvement

• Maintain and improve the onboarding SOP — what worked, what broke, what changed.

• Build reusable templates, checklists, and automations that reduce onboarding time without reducing quality.

• Report monthly on onboarding pipeline, time-in-process, and any bottlenecks.



Required Experience & Skills

• 2+ years of short-term rental operations experience — hands-on, not adjacent.

• Demonstrated experience building or launching Airbnb, VRBO, or 
 listings from scratch.

• Working knowledge of a PMS (Hostaway, Guesty, Hospitable, or OwnerRez).

• Hands-on experience with a dynamic pricing tool (PriceLabs, Wheelhouse, Beyond).

• Strong written English and excellent spoken English — you will be on owner-facing calls.

• Project management discipline — you can manage 3–5 simultaneous onboardings without dropping details.

• Comfort with checklists, SOPs, and repeatable processes.



Preferred (Not Required)

• Prior experience in hospitality, property management, or client onboarding.

• Experience with Breezeway, Slack, Salesmsg, and GetClearing.

• Design eye for listing photos and descriptions.

• SEO or listing optimization experience on major OTA platforms.



Non-Negotiable Traits

• Organizational discipline. You manage multiple onboardings without letting any slip.

• Owner-facing confidence. You can hold a call with a $500K+ property owner and make them feel informed, respected, and confident in Divergent.

• Process thinker. You build systems, not one-offs.

• Ownership mindset. When onboarding breaks, your reflex is "how do I fix this and prevent it," not "who told me to do this."

• Professionalism under owner pressure. Owners can be anxious during onboarding. You stay steady, clear, and solution-oriented.



What We Offer

• Competitive hourly rate for a qualified STR operator.

• One of the most strategically important roles in the company — onboarding directly drives growth and retention.

• Quarterly performance reviews with bonus opportunities.

• Direct access to the owner (Nick) for strategic decisions.

• Long-term role with growth potential as we scale to 200+ properties.

• Professional development, coaching, and 1:1 time with leadership.



Hiring Process

1. Resume and written application — confirm STR onboarding experience.

2. 2-minute Loom video introduction — walk us through a property you onboarded from scratch.

3. First interview (30 minutes) with Divergent leadership.

4. Paid trial project ($75–100): Draft a 5-step onboarding plan with timelines for a sample property, write the owner welcome email, and identify the top 3 risks for this specific property.

5. Reference checks — minimum 2 written references with specific questions.

6. Owner call with Nick — cultural fit and final decision.

7. 30-day paid trial starts.
